items.summary_en: This article explains how a liquid-foundation spreading effect was implemented with Three.js. The effect was developed for a Japanese cosmetics brand’s promotional project released in 2021. It builds on an earlier article about fluid simulation and supports trying different foundation textures and color variations.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章介绍了如何使用 Three.js 实现液体粉底扩散效果。该效果最初为一个日本化妆品品牌在 2021 年发布的宣传项目开发。文章延续了作者此前关于流体模拟的介绍，并支持体验不同的粉底质地和颜色变化。

items.title_en: Anthropic's growth just flattened
items.title_zh: Anthropic 的增长停滞了
items.summary_en: The available context consists only of the phrase “Look at the monthly numbers...” and does not establish specific growth figures or causes.
items.summary_zh: 现有资料只有“看看月度数据……”这一句话，无法确定具体增长数据或原因。

items.title_en: GitHub's new Git storage architecture
items.title_zh: GitHub 的新 Git 存储架构
items.summary_en: GitHub has built a new Git storage architecture designed to let thousands of agents push to a single repository at the same time. The architecture describes how GitHub supports this concurrent access pattern.
items.summary_zh: GitHub 构建了一套新的 Git 存储架构，目标是让数千个代理同时向同一个仓库推送代码。该架构介绍了 GitHub 如何支持这种并发访问模式。

items.title_en: We know 15k websites are infected. how do we tell them?
items.title_zh: 我们知道有 1.5 万个网站被感染，如何通知它们？
items.summary_en: Researchers identified 15,579 websites currently infected with malicious JavaScript. Together, the sites are conservatively estimated to receive more than 135 million visits per month. The researchers say they have evidence of the infections but face the practical problem of notifying all the affected site operators.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员发现，目前有 15,579 个网站感染了恶意 JavaScript。这些网站合计每月接收的访问量保守估计超过 1.35 亿次。研究人员表示，他们掌握了感染证据，但面临如何通知所有受影响网站运营者的实际难题。

items.title_en: Electrification Could Cut Global Energy Use in Half
items.title_zh: 电气化可能让全球能源使用量减半
items.summary_en: Professor Jan Rosenow says electricity currently represents only about 20% of the global energy picture, with transport and heating still dominated by fossil fuels. The current system wastes roughly two-thirds of its energy inputs as heat. The discussion argues that large-scale electrification could halve total global energy demand.
items.summary_zh: Jan Rosenow 教授表示，电力目前只占全球能源格局的约 20%，交通和供暖仍主要依赖化石燃料。现有系统会将约三分之二的能源输入以热量形式浪费掉。讨论认为，大规模电气化可能使全球总能源需求减半。

items.title_en: September in Servo: <progress>, rounded rectangles, and more
items.title_zh: Servo 九月进展：<progress>、圆角矩形及更多更新
items.summary_en: Servo 0.7.0 includes the changes merged during September, totaling 527 commits. The release adds new CSS functions and WebGL2 improvements. Its developer-tools console now eagerly evaluates JavaScript input for faster feedback.
items.summary_zh: Servo 0.7.0 包含九月合并的改动，共计 527 个提交。该版本加入了新的 CSS 函数并改进 WebGL2。开发者工具控制台现在会积极求值 JavaScript 输入，以提供更快反馈。

items.title_en: Frontier Airlines Likely Breached
items.title_zh: Frontier Airlines 可能遭到入侵
items.summary_en: The title says that Frontier Airlines was likely breached. It does not establish the scope, cause, or consequences of the possible incident.
items.summary_zh: 标题称 Frontier Airlines 可能遭到入侵。标题未说明这起可能事件的范围、原因或后果。

items.title_en: The Lisp curse, now coming to your ecosystem
items.title_zh: Lisp 诅咒，如今正来到你的生态系统
items.summary_en: The “LISP curse” describes how the language's flexibility makes it easy for developers to build custom solutions instead of reusing shared libraries. This can lead to duplicated work, fewer central frameworks, and poorly documented code that others prefer not to adopt. The discussion now extends to large language models, which may make generating new code easier than using existing abstractions.
items.summary_zh: “Lisp 诅咒”指的是：语言的灵活性让开发者很容易编写定制方案，而不是复用已有库。这可能导致重复造轮子、缺少中心化框架，以及文档不足、他人难以理解的代码。如今，这一讨论也延伸到了大语言模型，因为生成新代码可能比使用现有抽象更容易。

items.title_en: Leaking Secrets from Air-Gap Computers by Spelling Radio Signals from RAM (2024)
items.title_zh: 通过从 RAM 拼写无线电信号，从气隙计算机窃取秘密（2024）
items.summary_en: Researchers describe an attack in which malware on an air-gapped computer generates radio signals through memory buses. The signals can encode files, images, keystrokes, biometric data, and encryption keys, which an attacker can intercept using software-defined radio and an inexpensive antenna. The paper presents the attack's design, implementation, and evaluation.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员描述了一种攻击：气隙计算机上的恶意软件通过内存总线生成无线电信号。这些信号可以编码文件、图像、键盘记录、生物特征数据和加密密钥，攻击者则可使用软件定义无线电和廉价天线进行拦截。论文介绍了该攻击的设计、实现和评估结果。

items.title_en: Unlocking any car from X brand in most of the world
items.title_zh: 解锁全球大多数地区某品牌的任何汽车
items.summary_en: The author and Sam Curry examined the connected-car systems of a major automaker after the author bought a four-wheel-drive SUV from the brand in 2023. The author had previously been skeptical about the security of connected-car platforms and suspected weaknesses in this one. The investigation focuses on whether the automaker’s vehicles could be unlocked through its connected services, although the available excerpt does not give the technical findings.
items.summary_zh: 作者在 2023 年购买该品牌的一辆四驱 SUV 后，与 Sam Curry 一起研究了一家大型汽车制造商的联网汽车系统。作者此前一直对联网汽车平台的安全性持怀疑态度，并认为该系统可能存在弱点。调查关注的是能否通过这家车企的联网服务解锁其车辆，但现有摘录没有提供技术结论。

items.title_en: AI, Lean, and the Future of Formal Verification, with Lean Creator Leo de Moura
items.title_zh: AI、Lean 与形式验证的未来：对话 Lean 创造者 Leo de Moura
items.summary_en: Leo de Moura, creator of Lean and an AWS distinguished scientist, discusses how AI could make formal verification more accessible. The conversation covers specifications, machine-checked proofs, trust in AI-generated code and autonomous agents, and the prospect of a verified software stack. It also considers how these developments could affect mathematics and the careers of engineers and researchers.
items.summary_zh: Lean 创造者、AWS 杰出科学家 Leo de Moura 讨论了 AI 如何让形式验证更易于使用。对话涉及规范、机器检查证明、如何信任 AI 生成的代码和自主代理，以及构建经过验证的软件栈的可能性。内容还讨论了这些发展对数学以及工程师和研究人员职业的影响。

items.title_en: Nasdaq plummets 4% into correction territory
items.title_zh: 纳斯达克暴跌 4%，进入回调区域
items.summary_en: The Nasdaq fell 4% and entered correction territory. Investors continued rotating out of technology stocks and into more defensive parts of the market.
items.summary_zh: 纳斯达克下跌 4%，进入回调区域。投资者继续撤出科技股，转向市场中更具防御性的板块。

items.title_en: How I Fight AI Brain Fry
items.title_zh: 我如何对抗 AI 脑疲劳
items.summary_en: The author describes the mental overload caused by running multiple Claude Code or Codex tasks from a terminal at once. Follow-up questions and side tasks spread work across many tabs, forcing the user to track numerous separate contexts. The result is exhaustion, lost focus, and difficulty remembering the original task or intended outcome.
items.summary_zh: 作者描述了同时在终端运行多个 Claude Code 或 Codex 任务所造成的心理负担。后续问题和支线任务会把工作分散到许多标签页中，迫使用户同时追踪大量独立上下文。最终结果是精力耗尽、注意力下降，并难以记住最初的任务和目标。

items.title_en: The oldest ice disappears and the Stone Age emerges from it
items.title_zh: 最古老的冰层正在消失，石器时代由此重现
items.summary_en: Archaeologists in Innlandet, eastern Norway, have spent 20 years recovering artifacts emerging from melting mountain ice. Earlier finds were mostly no more than 2,000 years old and often dated to the Viking Age, but 6,000-year-old arrowheads are now appearing. The researchers describe the melting ice as rapidly changing the archaeological landscape.
items.summary_zh: 挪威东部因兰内特的考古学家花了 20 年时间，持续发掘和保护从山地融冰中出现的文物。过去发现的物品大多不超过 2,000 年历史，许多来自维京时代；如今，已有 6,000 年历史的箭头出土。研究人员表示，冰层融化正在迅速改变考古景观。

items.title_en: Synaptics Appears to Use Legal Threats to Block Open-Source DisplayLink Driver
items.title_zh: Synaptics 似乎试图用法律威胁阻止开源 DisplayLink 驱动
items.summary_en: Synaptics appears to be using legal threats against an experimental open-source Linux driver for modern DisplayLink hardware. The available material provides no further details about the alleged threats or the driver.
items.summary_zh: Synaptics 似乎正对一款面向新型 DisplayLink 硬件的实验性开源 Linux 驱动采取法律威胁。现有信息未提供相关威胁或驱动的更多细节。

items.title_en: F/OSS Comics #13: BSD Unix, Part 3 – The Beginning of BSD Unix
items.title_zh: F/OSS Comics #13：BSD Unix（第三部）——BSD Unix 的起源
items.image_url: https://fosscomics.com/posts/13. BSD Unix Part 3 - The Beginning of BSD Unix/images/feature.png
items.summary_en: This installment follows Bill Joy as he handles BSD distribution and debugging, moving from Pascal and tape-based workflows to a VAX system. Joy later works with Ozalp Babaoglu to bring virtual memory to Unix.
items.summary_zh: 这一期讲述 Bill Joy 如何负责 BSD 的发布与调试，工作环境从 Pascal 和磁带逐步发展到 VAX 系统。之后，他与 Ozalp Babaoglu 合作，将虚拟内存引入 Unix。

items.title_en: Radiation Map of the World
items.title_zh: 世界辐射地图
items.summary_en: Radiation Map of the World is a community-measured global radiation map. It tracks detector-recorded routes and areas and provides live statistics from RadiaCode devices around the world.
items.summary_zh: 《世界辐射地图》是一张由社区共同测量的全球辐射地图。它记录探测器采集的路线和区域，并提供来自世界各地 RadiaCode 设备的实时统计数据。

items.title_en: Show HN: A decent text-to-image model trained for ~$20K (Apache 2.0 Weights)
items.title_zh: Show HN：约 2 万美元训练出的优秀文生图模型（Apache 2.0 权重）
items.summary_en: A two-person lab is developing generative video models from scratch, with the goal of making animation tools faster, cheaper, and more controllable. Its work explores pixel-space diffusion models that remove the VAE stage used by typical latent diffusion systems. The authors say this simplifies training and achieves 11-times faster convergence than their latent-diffusion approach.
items.summary_zh: 一家两人实验室正在从头训练生成式视频模型，目标是让动画工具更快、更便宜且更易控制。其研究探索了去除典型潜空间扩散系统中 VAE 阶段的像素空间扩散模型。作者表示，这种方法简化了训练，并比其潜空间扩散方案实现了快 11 倍的收敛。

items.title_en: Progress on provable inference for large language models
items.title_zh: 可验证大语言模型推理取得进展
items.summary_en: Anthropic and academic collaborators report progress on using zkSNARKs for provable inference. Such cryptographic proofs could let a model provider commit to a specific model and prove that each response came from it. This addresses the difficulty users face in distinguishing a claimed model from a substituted model, tampered output, or other intermediary.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 及其学术合作伙伴报告了使用 zkSNARK 实现可验证推理的进展。这类密码学证明可以让模型提供商承诺使用特定模型，并证明每个回答确实由该模型生成。它针对的是用户难以分辨实际模型是否被替换、输出是否遭篡改或是否经过其他中间方处理的问题。

items.title_en: Making any integer with four 2s (2025)
items.title_zh: 用四个 2 构造任意整数（2025）
items.summary_en: The piece presents a mathematical puzzle about constructing integers using exactly four 2s. Some of the examples are accessible to elementary-school children.
items.summary_zh: 这篇内容介绍了一道使用恰好四个 2 构造整数的数学谜题。其中一些例子甚至小学生也能完成。

items.title_en: Uranium cubes reveal why the German nuclear project failed
items.title_zh: 铀立方体揭示德国核项目失败的原因
items.summary_en: Research challenges Werner Heisenberg's claim that Germany's wartime reactor project was close to criticality and only needed slightly more uranium. The study concludes that, under the design used for the B8 pile, the German program lacked enough uranium and heavy water to build a working bomb. The research began after physicist Timothy Koeth received a mysterious heavy-metal cube in 2013 and recognized it as one of the uranium cubes used by German scientists. Only 14 such cubes are known to exist today.
items.summary_zh: 研究质疑了维尔纳·海森堡关于德国战时反应堆项目接近达到临界、只需更多一点铀的说法。研究认为，按照 B8 反应堆采用的设计，德国项目缺乏制造可运行核装置所需的足量铀和重水。这项研究始于 2013 年，当时物理学家蒂莫西·科特收到一个神秘的重金属立方体，并认出它是德国科学家使用过的铀立方体之一。目前已知仅存 14 个这样的立方体。

items.title_en: Copper – A minimal low-level programming language with OOP and generics
items.title_zh: Copper：支持面向对象和泛型的极简低级编程语言
items.summary_en: Copper is a programming language created as a replacement for C. It emphasizes minimalism, simple syntax, explicit behavior, and familiar constructs so that the language can be understood in full by a single programmer.
items.summary_zh: Copper 是一种旨在替代 C 的编程语言。它强调极简设计、简单语法、明确行为和熟悉的构造，以便单个程序员能够完整理解这门语言。

items.title_en: Hungary: Communist-era files released, up to 60k former agents revealed
items.title_zh: 匈牙利公开共产主义时期档案，最多揭示 6 万名前特工
items.summary_en: Hungary has released secret-police files from the communist era, identifying up to 60,000 informants. The disclosure follows repeated failures to open the archives since the country's democratic transition in 1990. A bill passed in September granted the public unrestricted access to the records for the first time.
items.summary_zh: 匈牙利公开了共产主义时期的秘密警察档案，其中最多可识别 6 万名线人。自该国 1990 年民主转型以来，公开这些档案的努力曾多次失败。9 月通过的一项法案首次向公众授予不受限制的档案访问权。

items.title_en: They don't make 'em like that any more: Borland Turbo Pascal 7
items.title_zh: 如今已不复存在的产品：Borland Turbo Pascal 7
items.summary_en: Borland Turbo Pascal was a highly successful programming tool that introduced features such as integrated source-level debugging. Turbo Pascal 7, also known as Turbo Pascal for Windows 1.5, was the final and most advanced version of the line, offering substantial capabilities at an affordable price. Its book license allowed one purchased copy to be used by any number of people, though only one person at a time, and Turbo Pascal eventually gave way to Delphi.
items.summary_zh: Borland Turbo Pascal 是一款极为成功的编程工具，带来了集成式源码级调试等功能。Turbo Pascal 7，也称 Turbo Pascal for Windows 1.5，是这一产品线的最终版本和巅峰之作，以低廉价格提供了足够开发大型应用的能力。它采用“图书授权”模式，一份购买的副本可供任意数量的人使用，但同一时间只能由一人使用；最终 Turbo Pascal 被 Delphi 取代。

items.title_en: My Favourite Laptop
items.title_zh: 我最喜欢的笔记本电脑
items.summary_en: The author calls a battered 2015 ThinkPad X250 the best laptop they have owned. It is shown running a graphical shell on top of a microkernel the author is developing.
items.summary_zh: 作者称，一台磨损严重的 2015 年 ThinkPad X250 是自己用过的最好笔记本电脑。文章展示了它运行在作者正在开发的微内核之上的图形 Shell。

items.title_en: Greece has its own Pompeii: Thera buried Akrotiri in ash 17th-16th century BCE
items.title_zh: 希腊版庞贝：Thera 在公元前 17 至 16 世纪以火山灰掩埋 Akrotiri
items.summary_en: The Thera volcano on modern-day Santorini buried the Bronze Age settlement of Akrotiri in ash during the 17th or 16th century BCE. After earthquakes and eruptions, residents first fled by boat, returned to gather materials and repair damage, and then evacuated again as conditions worsened. The eruption was one of the largest in recorded history.
items.summary_zh: 位于今圣托里尼的 Thera 火山在公元前 17 或 16 世纪喷发，以火山灰掩埋了青铜时代聚落 Akrotiri。地震和喷发后，居民先乘船逃离，随后返回收集材料、修复受损建筑；情况恶化后，他们再次撤离。这次喷发是有记录以来规模最大的喷发之一。

items.title_en: European RISC-V Industrial Computing Initiative
items.title_zh: 欧洲 RISC-V 工业计算倡议
items.summary_en: ERICI provides a verified reference stack for RISC-V industrial computers, covering firmware, boot loaders, hypervisors, real-time operating systems, and Linux on real RVA23 hardware. The non-commercial initiative targets partitioned systems used on factory floors. It emphasizes avoiding dependence on a single company, country, or instruction-set license for machines expected to operate for 15 years.
items.summary_zh: ERICI 为 RISC-V 工业计算机提供经过验证的参考栈，涵盖固件、引导加载程序、虚拟机监控器、实时操作系统和 Linux，并运行于真实 RVA23 硬件上。这个非商业倡议面向工厂环境中的分区系统，强调运行周期预计达 15 年的设备不应依赖单一公司、国家或指令集授权。

items.title_en: Oracle files to sell $20B in new stock, bonds to finance AI buildout
items.title_zh: 甲骨文拟发行 200 亿美元新股和债券，为 AI 扩张融资
items.summary_en: Oracle filed plans to issue new shares and additional debt. The proceeds are intended to finance the company's artificial-intelligence buildout.
items.summary_zh: 甲骨文提交了发行新股和新增债务的计划。筹集资金将用于为公司的人工智能扩张融资。

items.title_en: Ask HN: What in the world is taking Ubuntu so long?
items.title_zh: 问 HN：Ubuntu 到底为什么这么慢？
items.summary_en: A user questions why Ubuntu has not yet released a fix for CVE-2026-98432, rated 9.8, nearly a week after the issue was reported. The vulnerability remains marked as work in progress, although a mitigation has been listed. The delay has shaken the user's confidence in Ubuntu's security-update process.
items.summary_zh: 一名用户质疑 Ubuntu 为何在 CVE-2026-98432（评分 9.8）出现近一周后仍未发布修复。该漏洞仍标记为“进行中”，不过页面至少已经列出了缓解措施。这一延迟动摇了该用户对 Ubuntu 安全更新流程的信心。

items.title_en: We halved DNS build delay and cut memory use by 85%
items.title_zh: DNS 构建延迟减半，内存占用降低 85%
items.summary_en: Cloudflare built a planner that selects the smallest safe DNS build instead of rebuilding entire zones after every setting change. The change cut full builds by 40%, peak memory use by 85%, and build delay by half. The system now handles about 700 DNS record changes per second, while some zones contain more than 20 million records.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 构建了一个规划器，在 DNS 设置变更后选择最小且安全的构建范围，而不是重建整个区域。该方案使完整构建减少 40%，峰值内存占用降低 85%，构建延迟减半。系统目前每秒处理约 700 次 DNS 记录变更，部分区域包含超过 2,000 万条记录。

items.title_en: I struggle to believe that AI R&D is ingenious
items.title_zh: 我很难相信 AI 研发真的如此高明
items.summary_en: Arjun Panickssery says he struggles to believe that autonomous AI research and development is genuinely ingenious. In projects involving Scrabble, Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe, and philosophy proofs, he observed models missing important literature, running experiments with too little data to be informative, and pursuing trivial directions. He also says a model found a clever blog post about Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe but failed to recognize its importance.
items.summary_zh: Arjun Panickssery 表示，他很难直观相信自主 AI 研发真的足够高明。在拼字游戏、终极井字棋和哲学证明等项目中，他观察到模型会忽略重要文献、用明显不足的数据开展缺乏信息价值的实验，并不断转向琐碎方向。他还表示，模型虽然找到了关于终极井字棋的巧妙博客文章，却没有意识到其重要性。

items.title_en: Building an AI-native engineering org
items.title_zh: 构建 AI 原生工程组织
items.summary_en: The piece is about building an AI-native engineering organization. It focuses on how engineering teams can be structured around AI-native practices.
items.summary_zh: 文章讨论如何构建 AI 原生的工程组织。重点是围绕 AI 原生实践来组织工程团队。

items.title_en: GitHub New pull request overview page in public preview
items.title_zh: GitHub 新版 Pull Request 概览页进入公开预览
items.summary_en: GitHub has introduced an opt-in Overview page for pull requests as a public preview, with rollout continuing through the weekend. The page places merge status and the next available actions in a compact readiness summary at the top. It is intended to reduce the need to scroll through long comment and event timelines to find blockers.
items.summary_zh: GitHub 推出了 Pull Request 概览页公开预览版，用户可选择启用，相关部署将在周末持续进行。该页面在顶部以紧凑的就绪状态摘要展示合并状态和下一步可执行操作。其目的是减少用户在漫长评论和事件时间线中反复滚动、寻找阻塞因素的需要。

items.title_en: Show HN: Vegetable Gardening for Engineers
items.title_zh: Show HN：工程师的蔬菜种植指南
items.summary_en: The guide provides a detailed starting point for growing vegetables at home. Its author assembled material from agricultural extension programs, crop guides, biology courses, farmer training, and gardening workshops after finding popular books too shallow and social media too noisy. The document reflects the author's personal learning process and accepts pull requests and email feedback.
items.summary_zh: 这份指南为在家种植蔬菜提供了一个详尽的入门框架。作者认为流行园艺书籍细节不足、社交媒体则充斥闲聊和标题党，因此汇集了农业推广项目、作物指南、生物课程、农民培训和园艺工作坊等资料。文档记录了作者个人的学习过程，并接受 Pull Request 和邮件反馈。

items.title_en: Seoul Viosys begins production of rare-earth-free white light emitter
items.title_zh: 首尔伟傲世开始生产无稀土白光发光器件
items.summary_en: Seoul Viosys says it has begun mass-producing white-light chips without rare-earth materials traditionally used in white LEDs. The chips can be as small as 10 micrometers and are aimed at applications including AR glasses and AI data communications.
items.summary_zh: 首尔伟傲世表示，已开始量产不使用传统白色 LED 所需稀土材料的白光芯片。这些芯片尺寸最小可达 10 微米，面向 AR 眼镜和 AI 数据通信等应用。

items.title_en: Zinc creep in cable spelter sockets brought down the Arecibo telescope in 2020
items.title_zh: 2020 年阿雷西博望远镜倒塌的原因是电缆锌制套筒发生蠕变
items.summary_en: A 2024 National Academies report identified long-term zinc creep in cable spelter sockets as the root cause of the Arecibo telescope’s 2020 collapse. The failure had not previously been documented in this form, and the report draws lessons for other unique critical science facilities. The sequence began with Hurricane Maria more than three years before the collapse.
items.summary_zh: 美国国家科学院 2024 年的一份报告认定，电缆锌制套筒长期发生锌蠕变，是阿雷西博望远镜 2020 年倒塌的根本原因。这种失效方式此前从未被记录，报告还为其他独特且关键的科学设施总结了经验。事故过程始于倒塌三年多前的玛丽亚飓风。

items.title_en: Revolut moves to self-hosted GLM
items.title_zh: Revolut 转向自托管 GLM
items.summary_en: Revolut reportedly moved about 2,000 engineers to a self-hosted GLM model for coding, leaving Claude Code and Codex as exceptions. The reported deployment uses 56 Nvidia B200 GPUs and costs about 30 cents per million tokens, roughly one-tenth of its previous spending on Anthropic and OpenAI.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，Revolut 已让约 2,000 名工程师使用自托管 GLM 进行编程，并将 Claude Code 和 Codex 列为例外。此次部署使用 56 张 Nvidia B200，成本约为每百万 token 0.30 美元，大约是此前向 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 支出的十分之一。

items.title_en: Ask HN: What are you working on? (November 2026)
items.title_zh: Ask HN：你在做什么？（2026 年 11 月）
items.summary_en: This monthly Ask HN thread invites people to share what they are working on and what they have been curious about lately. It is an open discussion rather than a report about a specific project or event.
items.summary_zh: 这篇每月发布的 Ask HN 帖子邀请读者分享自己正在做的事情，以及最近感兴趣或好奇的问题。这是一个开放讨论帖，并非围绕某个具体项目或事件的报道。

items.title_en: Jobless tech workers are being left out of San Francisco's AI boom
items.title_zh: 失业的科技工作者被排除在旧金山的 AI 繁荣之外
items.summary_en: The piece concerns unemployed technology workers being left out of San Francisco's AI-driven economic boom.
items.summary_zh: 文章关注失业科技工作者被排除在旧金山由 AI 推动的经济繁荣之外。

items.title_en: Baidu released ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base
items.title_zh: 百度发布 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base
items.summary_en: Baidu has released ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base, a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 280 billion total parameters and 14 billion active per token. It was pretrained from scratch on 33.5 trillion tokens with a training context of up to 128K and support for a 1-million-token context during fine-tuning and inference. The released weights are a pretraining checkpoint intended for domain adaptation, instruction tuning, and reinforcement-learning research.
items.summary_zh: 百度发布了 ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base，这是一款总参数量 2800 亿、每个 token 激活 140 亿参数的稀疏混合专家模型。该模型从零开始使用 33.5 万亿 token 进行预训练，训练上下文最长达 128K，并支持在微调和推理阶段使用 100 万 token 上下文。此次发布的是预训练结束时的权重，可用于领域适配、指令微调和强化学习研究。

items.title_en: Nibnib: Image compression with extreme decompression speed
items.title_zh: Nibnib：解压速度极快的图像压缩格式
items.summary_en: Nibnib is an image format using 4 bits per pixel and optimized for extremely fast decompression. It began as an experiment targeting DVI output on an RP2350 microcontroller, where roughly six cycles per pixel must cover pixel fetching, palette lookup, and storage in a line buffer.
items.summary_zh: Nibnib 是一种每像素 4 bit、针对极快解压速度优化的图像格式。它最初是为 RP2350 微控制器上的 DVI 输出进行的实验，该设备每个像素约有 6 个时钟周期，需要完成像素读取、调色板查询和写入行缓冲区。

items.title_en: OpenAI raises $11B at a $1.25T valuation
items.title_zh: OpenAI 以 1.25 万亿美元估值融资 110 亿美元
items.summary_en: About $11 billion in new funding reached OpenAI's accounts by November 6, 2026, according to people familiar with the deal. The money represents the first part of a financing round priced at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation, a figure CFO Sarah Friar confirmed in a television interview. OpenAI declined to comment, and the valuation was reportedly below the company's initial target.
items.summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，截至 2026 年 11 月 6 日，约 110 亿美元的新资金已进入 OpenAI 账户。该资金是融资轮的第一部分，本轮融资的投前估值为 1.25 万亿美元，首席财务官 Sarah Friar 在电视采访中确认了这一数字。OpenAI 拒绝置评，据报道这一估值低于公司最初设定的目标。

items.title_en: Moving our warehouse off DuckDB
items.title_zh: 让我们的数据仓库迁离 DuckDB
items.summary_en: PostHog moved its data warehouse away from DuckDB and DuckLake to an in-house variant of Trino and a new open table format called HogLake. The post focuses on what broke at scale and why the migration was undertaken.
items.summary_zh: PostHog 将数据仓库从 DuckDB 和 DuckLake 迁移到自有的 Trino 变体，以及新的开放表格式 HogLake。文章重点介绍了系统扩展到一定规模后出现的问题，以及迁移的原因。

items.title_en: Devvm.dev: One VM for every project
items.title_zh: Devvm.dev：每个项目一个虚拟机
items.summary_en: Devvm.dev provides an isolated virtual-machine sandbox for each project, with the project's toolchain ready for a developer or coding agent. It is free and open source. The Linux installation script also works on macOS, and the installation process documents its available options.
items.summary_zh: Devvm.dev 为每个项目提供隔离的虚拟机沙箱，并预装项目所需的工具链，供开发者或编程智能体直接开始工作。该工具免费且开源。Linux 安装脚本也可在 macOS 上运行，安装文档列出了可用选项。

items.title_en: Egoless Mathematics in the AI Era
items.title_zh: AI 时代的无我数学
items.summary_en: This guest essay considers mathematics in the era of AI. It is credited to Karthik C. S., Amit Sahai, and Jie Xue, and was initially written in another format before being converted with AI.
items.summary_zh: 这篇客座文章探讨了 AI 时代的数学。文章作者为 Karthik C. S.、Amit Sahai 和 Jie Xue，最初以另一种文件格式撰写，之后通过 AI 完成转换。

items.title_en: Living beyond the limits of survival: wood ants trapped in a gigantic pitfall (2016)
items.title_zh: 活过生存极限：困在巨大陷阱中的木蚁（2016）
items.summary_en: Researchers documented a large accumulation of Formica polyctena worker ants trapped inside a former nuclear-weapons bunker. The ants fell through a ventilation pipe and could not return to their outdoor colony, so they built and maintained an earthen nest in complete darkness. The bunker population has survived for years and now numbers in the hundreds of thousands, sustained by newly fallen workers. It has produced no offspring because of the low temperatures and limited food supply.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员记录了 Formica polyctena 工蚁在一座旧核武器仓库内形成的大规模聚集。这些蚂蚁从通风管道掉入后无法返回室外的母巢，于是在完全黑暗中建造并维护土制巢穴。这个地下种群已存活多年，目前数量达到数十万，依靠外部蚁群不断掉落的新工蚁维持。由于温度较低且食物有限，它们没有繁殖后代。

items.title_en: RealPage rent-pricing case wraps with nearly $360M to renters
items.title_zh: RealPage 租金定价案和解，租户获近 3.6 亿美元
items.summary_en: A federal court approved settlements in the antitrust case over algorithmic rent setting through RealPage software. The court found the settlements, including the payment amounts, releases, and dismissal of the case against settling defendants, fair and adequate for the settling class. A legal expert cautioned that the approval may not be the final word in litigation over algorithmic pricing.
items.summary_zh: 联邦法院批准了围绕 RealPage 软件算法定租的反垄断诉讼和解。法院认定，和解金额、责任解除以及对和解被告的诉讼终结安排，对参与和解的集体成员而言公平且充分。一名法律专家提醒，这可能并不是算法定价诉讼的最终结论。

items.title_en: The Components of Agent Memory
items.title_zh: 智能体记忆的组成部分
items.summary_en: It compares this process with human memory consolidation, in which experiences are captured continuously but only some become long-term knowledge. The proposed “dreaming” process helps organize memories and correct mistakes.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨 Claude 这类 AI 智能体如何在尚不知道未来会发生什么时，判断哪些经历值得记住。它将这一过程与人类记忆巩固进行比较：人类持续记录经历，但只有一部分会成为长期知识。文中提出的“做梦”过程用于整理记忆并纠正错误。

items.title_en: One-minute frequency disturbances from synchronization in power systems
items.title_zh: 电力系统中由同步引起的单分钟频率扰动
items.summary_en: Power grids on five continents show frequency oscillations with an exact one-minute period. The researchers trace them to clock-synchronized control software in devices such as uninterruptible power supplies and battery-storage systems, which creates repeating demand peaks. The growing amplitude has contributed to wear in hydropower systems and prompted stricter frequency-control requirements.
items.summary_zh: 五大洲的电网都出现了周期恰为一分钟的频率振荡。研究人员将其追溯到不间断电源和电池储能系统等设备中的时钟同步控制软件，这些软件会产生重复的用电需求峰值。近年来振荡幅度增大，已造成水电系统磨损，并推动更严格的频率控制要求。

items.title_en: Agent memory needs its OpenTelemetry moment
items.title_zh: 智能体记忆需要一个属于自己的 OpenTelemetry 时刻
items.summary_en: Agent tools currently store memory in incompatible formats, preventing one tool from reading what another has learned. The piece compares this situation with observability before OpenTelemetry and surveys existing memory formats and proposals for a shared specification. A coding tool's lessons may remain isolated from an editor agent or a later tool.
items.summary_zh: 目前，各类智能体工具以互不兼容的格式存储记忆，导致一个工具无法读取另一个工具学到的内容。文章将这一状况与 OpenTelemetry 出现前的可观测性问题相比较，并梳理现有记忆格式以及制定共享规范的提案。编码工具积累的经验可能因此被限制在原工具中，编辑器智能体或之后使用的其他工具都无法访问。

items.title_en: Inkling 2 Small
items.title_zh: Inkling 2 Small
items.summary_en: Thinking Machines has introduced Inkling 2 Small, the second generation of its Inkling models. It is a mixture-of-experts model with 594 billion total parameters, 17 billion active parameters, image-input support, and variable effort. The model scored 31 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, with reported gains in agentic coding, vision, knowledge work, and reasoning.
items.summary_zh: Thinking Machines 发布了第二代 Inkling 模型 Inkling 2 Small。这是一款混合专家模型，总参数量为 5940 亿，激活参数量为 170 亿，支持图像输入和可变推理投入。该模型在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 上获得 31 分，并在智能体编程、视觉、知识工作和推理方面取得提升。

items.title_en: My psychophysics as a bilateral cochlear implant user
items.title_zh: 作为双侧人工耳蜗使用者的心理物理学
items.summary_en: The piece is titled “My psychophysics as a bilateral cochlear implant user.” It is presented as a Claude user artifact.
items.summary_zh: 这篇作品题为《作为双侧人工耳蜗使用者的心理物理学》。它以 Claude 用户创建的 Artifact 形式呈现。

items.title_en: Landline phones will switch off across Britland in 100 days, no extensions
items.title_zh: 英国陆线电话将在 100 天后关闭，无法延期
items.summary_en: Openreach says the legacy public switched telephone network in Britain will be retired on January 31, 2027. The BT Group infrastructure division warned communications providers that the deadline will not be postponed. The shutdown concerns the old telephone network used to deliver legacy services.
items.summary_zh: Openreach 表示，英国传统公共交换电话网将于 2027 年 1 月 31 日退役。BT 集团旗下这家基础设施部门警告通信服务提供商，截止日期不会推迟。这次关闭涉及用于提供传统服务的旧电话网络。

items.title_en: AI agent swarms in Minecraft fail to build civilization, drown in bureaucracy
items.title_zh: Minecraft 中的 AI 智能体群无法建立文明，陷入官僚主义
items.summary_en: A Minecraft experiment released swarms of AI agents to try to build a functioning civilization. The 50-agent teams reportedly failed after becoming paralyzed by bureaucracy. The experiment was intended to provide insight into recent claims about AI agents.
items.summary_zh: 一项 Minecraft 实验让成群的 AI 智能体尝试建立能够运作的文明。据报道，50 个智能体组成的团队最终陷入官僚主义并失败。这项实验旨在帮助理解近期关于 AI 智能体的各种说法。

items.title_en: Surviving "The Graduate"
items.title_zh: 熬过《毕业生》
items.summary_en: The piece is titled “Surviving ‘The Graduate’” and concerns Dustin Hoffman and his experience with the film.
items.summary_zh: 这篇作品以《熬过〈毕业生〉》为题，围绕达斯汀·霍夫曼及其与这部电影相关的经历展开。

items.title_en: Basically no one is using AI agents for their DoorDash orders
items.title_zh: 基本没人用 AI 智能体点 DoorDash 外卖
items.summary_en: DoorDash CEO Tony Xu said AI agents had generated only several hundred orders over the entire period since the feature became available. He described the use case as very low volume, especially compared with the nearly one billion orders DoorDash handled in the third quarter of 2026. The figures suggest that ordering food through external AI agents remains at an early stage.
items.summary_zh: DoorDash 首席执行官 Tony Xu 表示，自该功能上线以来，AI 智能体总共只产生了几百笔订单。他称这一使用场景的规模非常小，而 DoorDash 在 2026 年第三季度单季就处理了接近 10 亿笔订单。这些数字表明，通过外部 AI 智能体点餐仍处于早期阶段。

items.title_en: Never Complain, Never Explain
items.title_zh: 永不抱怨，永不解释
items.summary_en: “Never complain, never explain” is a public-relations strategy particularly associated with the British royal family. The phrase is often attributed to former British prime minister Benjamin Disraeli, though its documented origins trace to Benjamin Jowett's earlier maxims.
items.summary_zh: “永不抱怨，永不解释”是一种尤其与英国王室联系在一起的公共关系策略。这句话常被归于英国前首相本杰明·迪斯雷利，但有文献记录的源头可追溯到本杰明·乔伊特更早提出的格言。

items.title_en: Altoids Project
items.title_zh: Altoids 项目
items.summary_en: A parent and his 12-year-old son spent about two months building the Altoids project. It began after they received a free robot at MIT Swapfest and acquired an inexpensive used ThinkPad. The project culminated in a video documenting their finished product.
items.summary_zh: 一位家长和他 12 岁的儿子花了约两个月完成了 Altoids 项目。项目始于他们在 MIT Swapfest 获得一台免费机器人，并买到一台价格实惠的二手 ThinkPad。最终成果由一段视频记录下来。

items.title_en: Sodium-ion batteries approach cost parity with LFP
items.title_zh: 钠离子电池接近与 LFP 的成本持平
items.summary_en: Sodium-ion batteries are approaching cell-level cost parity with lithium iron phosphate batteries, with supply agreements exceeding 70 GWh worldwide. Wood Mackenzie estimates that they could deliver 21% lower total ownership costs over 20 years despite higher upfront costs. Cell-level parity is expected by late 2026, while module- and system-level parity is not expected until after 2030.
items.summary_zh: 钠离子电池正接近与磷酸铁锂电池实现电芯级成本持平，全球相关供货协议总量已超过 70 GWh。Wood Mackenzie 估计，尽管前期成本更高，钠离子电池 20 年总拥有成本可能低 21%。预计电芯级成本平价将在 2026 年底前后实现，而模组和系统级平价要到 2030 年之后。

items.title_en: Chimera Vocal Synth
items.title_zh: Chimera 声音合成器
items.summary_en: Chimera is a physically modeled vocal synthesizer. It generates every sound from a simulated airway. The project therefore models voice production rather than relying solely on conventional recorded samples.
items.summary_zh: Chimera 是一款基于物理建模的声音合成器。它的每个声音都来自对呼吸道的模拟。因此，该项目模拟的是发声过程，而不只是依赖传统录音样本。

items.title_en: The Ubuntu 26.04 Rust sudo is not compatible with standard sudo
items.title_zh: Ubuntu 26.04 的 Rust sudo 与标准 sudo 不兼容
items.summary_en: Ubuntu 26.04’s Rust implementation of sudo is not compatible with standard sudo.
items.summary_zh: Ubuntu 26.04 使用 Rust 重写的 sudo 与标准 sudo 不兼容。

items.title_en: Clj.rs – a Clojure dialect implemented in Rust
items.title_zh: Clj.rs：用 Rust 实现的 Clojure 方言
items.summary_en: Clj.rs is an experimental Clojure dialect targeting the Rust ecosystem. It aims to provide a Lisp runtime with persistent data structures, a hosted macro system, and native interoperability, supporting both compiled and interpreted use. The project is at an early stage and is expected to have rough edges.
items.summary_zh: Clj.rs 是一个面向 Rust 生态的实验性 Clojure 方言。它旨在提供具备持久化数据结构、托管宏系统和原生互操作能力的 Lisp 运行时，并支持编译或解释执行。该项目仍处于早期阶段，可能存在不少不完善之处。

items.title_en: Porting Android 16 to my blind mother's keypad phone
items.title_zh: 将 Android 16 移植到盲人母亲的按键手机上
items.summary_en: The project ports Android 16 to the author's blind mother's keypad phone. It centers on adapting a modern Android release to older keypad-phone hardware.
items.summary_zh: 该项目将 Android 16 移植到作者失明母亲使用的按键手机上，重点是让现代 Android 系统适配老式按键手机硬件。

items.title_en: Trigger.dev customer environment variables exposed
items.title_zh: Trigger.dev 客户的环境变量遭到暴露
items.summary_en: An attacker gained unauthorized access to environment variables belonging to a subset of Trigger.dev organizations. Trigger.dev says it blocked the exploit and emailed affected account owners with mitigation steps. Its investigation found exposure across that subset of organizations.
items.summary_zh: 攻击者未经授权访问了部分 Trigger.dev 组织的环境变量。Trigger.dev 表示已封堵所利用的漏洞，并向受影响账户所有者发送了缓解措施。公司的调查确认，这些组织存在数据暴露。

items.title_en: Proving and improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
items.title_zh: 用 JEPA 证明并改进柏拉图表征假说
items.summary_en: The paper turns the Platonic Representation Hypothesis into a theorem for separately trained JEPAs across multiple modalities, showing that they learn the same representation up to a rotation under specified positive-pair and misalignment conditions. It characterizes next-token prediction as a JEPA with “bad views,” explaining why language–vision alignment depends on scale. Experiments spanning 145,000 captions and the text of 940 million web images report that good views need 42 times fewer samples than next-token prediction to reach the same alignment.
items.summary_zh: 论文将柏拉图表征假说转化为一个定理：在满足特定正样本配对和错位条件时，分别训练的多模态 JEPA 会学习到除旋转外相同的表征。论文将下一个词预测描述为使用“坏视图”的 JEPA，并据此解释语言与视觉为何需要依靠规模才能对齐。覆盖 14.5 万条图像说明文字和 9.4 亿张网页图片文本的实验显示，达到相同对齐程度时，良好视图所需的训练样本少 42 倍。

items.title_en: Multiplayer tanks that demolish real buildings from OpenStreetMap
items.title_zh: 在 OpenStreetMap 真实建筑上摧毁街区的多人坦克游戏
items.summary_en: World Strike is a multiplayer sandbox game set on real city maps. Players drive toy tanks through cities with other players, aim by tapping the street, and shoot blocky buildings.
items.summary_zh: World Strike 是一款以真实城市地图为场景的多人沙盒游戏。玩家驾驶玩具坦克与其他玩家穿行城市，通过点击街道瞄准，并射击摧毁方块建筑。

items.title_en: Restaurant Delivery Payment-Skimming Campaign
items.title_zh: 餐厅外卖支付盗刷活动
items.summary_en: InfoHawk researchers found a network of 820 suspicious restaurant domains impersonating major US chains including Jersey Mike's, Jimmy John's, Chipotle, and Dave's Hot Chicken. Some sites use payment-skimming attacks to capture card details and request bank SMS verification codes. The investigation began in early November 2026 and identified what appear to be coordinated restaurant-impersonation operations.
items.summary_zh: InfoHawk 研究人员发现了一个由 820 个可疑餐厅域名组成的网络，这些域名冒充 Jersey Mike's、Jimmy John's、Chipotle 和 Dave's Hot Chicken 等美国连锁品牌。部分网站通过支付盗刷攻击窃取银行卡信息，并要求用户提供银行短信验证码。调查于 2026 年 11 月初展开，这些网站疑似属于协调运作的餐厅冒充和支付盗刷活动。

items.title_en: I'm not convinced the AI bubble exists
items.title_zh: 我并不确信 AI 泡沫存在
items.summary_en: The author argues that the widely assumed AI bubble may not necessarily exist or be close to bursting. They acknowledge that AI companies are spending enormous sums and that their financing arrangements make the exact scale of debt and commitments difficult to determine. Still, the author says the rapid growth of AI companies could be justified and may have further room to continue.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，外界普遍认定的 AI 泡沫未必存在，也未必即将破裂。他承认 AI 公司正在投入巨额资金，而且复杂的融资安排使其债务和支出承诺规模难以准确判断。不过，作者认为 AI 公司的快速增长可能有现实基础，未来仍可能继续扩张。

items.title_en: Conductor is joining Meta
items.title_zh: Conductor 加入 Meta
items.summary_en: Conductor announced that it is joining Meta. The company launched in July 2025, when writing most code with agents or using teams of coding agents was still described as unusual. The announcement thanks users who supported the project during that period.
items.summary_zh: Conductor 宣布加入 Meta。该公司于 2025 年 7 月创立，当时让智能体编写大部分代码或使用编程智能体团队仍被认为并不寻常。公告感谢了在这段时期支持该项目的用户。

items.title_en: We've built an open-source feature flag server for 11 years
items.title_zh: 我们打造开源功能开关服务器已有 11 年
items.summary_en: Unleash is an open-source feature-management platform that lets teams control when and how new features are released. It supports smaller, more manageable production deployments and can streamline software delivery. The project has been developed for 11 years.
items.summary_zh: Unleash 是一个开源功能管理平台，让团队控制新功能何时以及如何向用户发布。它支持更小、更易管理的生产部署，并可简化软件交付流程。该项目已开发 11 年。

items.title_en: Ask HN: Does anyone have a contact with Cleveland-area Ham club?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：有人认识克利夫兰地区业余无线电俱乐部的人吗？
items.summary_en: The poster is seeking a contact at the Cuyahoga Amateur Radio Club about removing a large collection of radio equipment from a home. Much of the equipment is reportedly new, and it may be discarded if no one arranges its removal.
items.summary_zh: 发帖人希望联系库亚霍加业余无线电俱乐部的人，以处理一批需要从住宅中搬走的无线电设备。据称其中许多设备是全新的，如果无人处理，可能会被当作垃圾丢弃。

items.title_en: Rune: A native GPU-rendered Rust UI framework for macOS, Windows, Linux and web
items.title_zh: Rune：面向 macOS、Windows、Linux 和 Web 的原生 GPU 渲染 Rust UI 框架
items.summary_en: Rune is a native UI framework for Rust that uses GPU rendering across macOS, Windows, Linux, and the web. It provides its own renderer, text system, layout engine, and spring-based animations. Applications can also run headlessly, allowing agents to render PNG images, dump the element tree, and drive scripted input.
items.summary_zh: Rune 是一个使用 GPU 渲染的 Rust 原生 UI 框架，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 和 Web。它自带渲染器、文本系统、布局引擎和基于弹簧模型的动画。应用还可以无头运行，使智能体能够渲染 PNG、导出元素树并通过脚本驱动输入。

items.title_en: 'It's just vape, nail, charity shops': Can anything save UK high street?
items.title_zh: “这里只有电子烟、美甲店和慈善商店”：还有什么能拯救英国商业街？
items.summary_en: The report examines why residents of Rotherham have abandoned the town centre for a nearby retail park and what might bring them back. The retail park opened in 1987 and still attracts shoppers with large chains and restaurants, while its appearance now resembles a typical big-box shopping centre. The contrast illustrates the challenges facing traditional UK high streets.
items.summary_zh: 报道探讨了罗瑟勒姆居民为何放弃市中心、转而前往附近零售公园，以及什么措施可能让他们回流。该零售公园于 1987 年开业，如今仍凭借大型连锁店和餐厅吸引顾客，但外观已与普通的郊区大型商业中心无异。这一对比体现了英国传统商业街面临的困境。

items.title_en: Petered
items.title_zh: Petered
items.summary_en: The piece revisits the Peter Principle, which says people are promoted until reaching a level of incompetence. It argues that career pressure can make this state unstable: people who cannot advance and may be failing expectations could take greater risks to preserve their jobs or careers. The argument draws on Christian Gläßel and Adam Scharpf's work on careers in dictatorships.
items.summary_zh: 文章重新审视了彼得原理，即人们会不断晋升，直到达到自己无法胜任的层级。文章认为，职业压力可能使这种状态变得不稳定：无法继续晋升且可能无法达到要求的人，可能会为了保住职位甚至职业生涯而承担更大风险。该论点借鉴了 Christian Gläßel 和 Adam Scharpf 关于独裁体制下职业生涯的研究。

items.title_en: Show HN: After a decade of reversing, I got co-op working in DOS Wing Commander
items.title_zh: Show HN：经过十年逆向工程，我让 DOS《Wing Commander》支持合作模式
items.summary_en: A developer spent 11 years working toward cooperative play in the DOS version of Wing Commander. The project began with an idea to inspect the game’s memory and identify the players’ three-dimensional coordinates, then use network packets to control the wingman. It grew out of childhood experiments in which two players shared control of one spacecraft.
items.summary_zh: 一名开发者花了 11 年时间，为 DOS 版《Wing Commander》实现合作游玩。项目最初的思路是检查游戏内存，找出玩家和僚机的三维坐标，再通过网络数据包控制僚机。这个想法源于儿时两名玩家共同操控一艘飞船的经历。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Momentic (YC W24) – Agents that catch bugs by using your app
items.title_zh: Launch HN：Momentic——通过操作应用来发现漏洞的智能体
items.summary_en: Momentic is building QA agents that autonomously plan, explore, and test user flows in web, iOS, Android, and eventually desktop applications. The founders argue that conventional end-to-end tools require tests to hardcode implementation details such as XPath, text, or ARIA attributes, making them costly to maintain. Their approach is intended to use agents for broader bug-finding and visual understanding.
items.summary_zh: Momentic 正在开发 QA 智能体，让其自主规划、探索并测试 Web、iOS、Android 以及未来桌面应用中的用户流程。创始人认为，传统端到端工具要求测试硬编码 XPath、文本或 ARIA 属性等实现细节，因此维护成本较高。这套方案希望利用智能体进行更广泛的找错和视觉理解。

items.title_en: Nasdaq Sinks 5% as Investors Retreat from AI Trade After Election
items.title_zh: 纳斯达克因选举后投资者撤离 AI 交易下跌 5%
items.summary_en: The Nasdaq fell 5% as investors retreated from the AI trade after the election. The move reflects a sharp pullback from technology-focused investments.
items.summary_zh: 选举后，投资者撤离 AI 相关交易，纳斯达克下跌 5%。这一走势反映出资金明显撤出科技类投资。

items.title_en: China's First Frontier AI Export Controls: Mofcom Announcement No. 48
items.title_zh: 中国首次前沿 AI 出口管制：商务部公告第 48 号
items.summary_en: On October 16, 2026, China’s Ministry of Commerce and Ministry of Science and Technology issued Announcement No. 48. It proposes adding 40 technologies to the export-control catalogue, including 23 AI technologies, and imposes an interim pre-export registration requirement already in effect. The draft explicitly covers frontier-model weights, agent architectures, and AI-enabled offensive cyber capabilities with technical thresholds.
items.summary_zh: 2026 年 10 月 16 日，中国商务部和科技部发布第 48 号公告。公告提议将 40 项技术、其中包括 23 项人工智能技术，加入出口管制目录，并实施已经生效的临时出口前登记要求。草案明确涉及前沿模型权重、智能体架构以及由 AI 支持的进攻性网络能力，并为其设定技术门槛。

items.title_en: No AI, 52 min. Build all Linux Files utils in C by Hand [video]
items.title_zh: 无需 AI，52 分钟手写完成所有 Linux 文件工具（视频）
items.summary_en: The video shows someone building all Linux file utilities in C by hand without using AI. Its runtime is 52 minutes.
items.summary_zh: 这段视频展示了如何在不使用 AI 的情况下，用 C 手写完成所有 Linux 文件工具。视频时长为 52 分钟。

items.title_en: The lost malloc()
items.title_zh: 消失的 malloc()
items.summary_en: The author revisited the original source code of malloc as an exercise in Unix archaeology. They describe the historically significant code as unusually approachable compared with modern software. The project was prompted by another idea and became an enjoyable exploration of old systems code.
items.summary_zh: 作者通过研究 malloc 的原始源代码，进行了一次 Unix 考古。作者认为，这些具有历史意义的代码相比现代软件异常易读。这个项目源于另一个想法，最终成为一次对早期系统代码的探索。

items.title_en: Tips for more effective fuzz testing with AFL++
items.title_zh: 使用 AFL++ 进行更有效模糊测试的技巧
items.summary_en: The guide presents practical advice for using AFL++ to fuzz source-available C and C++ programs on glibc-based Linux systems. The author draws on fuzzing roughly 1,000 projects over six years and describes fuzz testing as an effective way to uncover software defects. The recommendations are intended to complement AFL++’s official documentation.
items.summary_zh: 这份指南介绍了如何使用 AFL++ 对基于 glibc 的 Linux 系统上的开源 C 和 C++ 程序进行更有效的模糊测试。作者基于六年间测试约 1000 个项目的经验，认为模糊测试是发现软件缺陷的有效方法。这些建议旨在补充 AFL++ 的官方文档。

items.title_en: Polyend releases the Tracker firmware source code
items.title_zh: Polyend 发布 Tracker 固件源代码
items.summary_en: Polyend released the firmware source code for the original Tracker, Tracker+, and Tracker Mini on GitHub. It also released Tracker Community Edition 1.0 with new features and improvements, allowing users to modify and share firmware. A recovery system is included to reduce the risk of a faulty build bricking the instruments.
items.summary_zh: Polyend 已在 GitHub 发布原版 Tracker、Tracker+ 和 Tracker Mini 的固件源代码。同时发布的 Tracker Community Edition 1.0 包含大量新功能和改进，用户可以修改并分享自己的固件版本。系统还加入了恢复机制，以降低错误固件导致设备变砖的风险。

items.title_en: Every processor die anyone has photographed and given away
items.title_zh: 所有被拍摄并公开的处理器裸片
items.summary_en: The collection contains microscope photographs of 356 processor dies made between 1972 and 2024 and released for public use. A processor die is the flat silicon piece inside a chip package, which must be exposed by sanding or dissolving the package before imaging. A true-scale view is available for the 114 dies whose dimensions are known, showing the size difference between older and modern chips.
items.summary_zh: 这个收藏包含 356 张处理器裸片的显微镜照片，时间跨度从 1972 年到 2024 年，并向公众开放使用。处理器裸片是芯片封装内部的扁平硅片，需要打磨或溶解封装后才能进行拍摄。对于已知尺寸的 114 个裸片，页面还提供真实比例视图，展示老芯片与现代芯片的尺寸差异。

items.title_en: Notes on San Marino
items.title_zh: 圣马力诺札记
items.summary_en: The writer spent three days in San Marino, a landlocked microstate completely surrounded by Italy. Its people are known as the Sammarinese. The notes contrast the travel experience in European microstates with the more unsolicited encounters the writer describes in Afghanistan.
items.summary_zh: 作者在圣马力诺度过了三天；这是一个完全被意大利包围的内陆微型国家，其居民称为 Sammarinese（圣马力诺人）。文章将欧洲微型国家的旅行体验，与作者在阿富汗所描述的更多非预期人际接触进行了对比。

items.title_en: Sneaking into the auditorium for the Windows 2000 launch rehearsal
items.title_zh: 偷偷溜进 Windows 2000 发布彩排现场
items.summary_en: The available source context contains only the line “Wait, that's not him.”
items.summary_zh: 现有资料只包含一句话：“等等，那不是他。”

items.title_en: Pangram Image 1.0
items.title_zh: Pangram Image 1.0
items.summary_en: Pangram has released Image 1.0, an AI image and video detector. The system can identify AI-generated content within a real photograph and show its location with a heatmap. It follows an earlier research preview that the community tested and used to identify weaknesses.
items.summary_zh: Pangram 发布了 Image 1.0，一款用于检测 AI 图像和视频的工具。该系统能够在真实照片中定位 AI 生成内容，并通过热力图显示其位置。正式版本此前经历了研究预览阶段，社区用户曾对其进行测试并帮助发现弱点。

items.title_en: How Long Can Life Wait?
items.title_zh: 生命还能等待多久？
items.summary_en: The piece asks how long life can wait. No further details are available here about the subject or argument.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨“生命还能等待多久”这一问题。现有信息未提供更多主题或论点细节。

items.title_en: Terry Pratchett's Study
items.title_zh: 特里·普拉切特的书房
items.summary_en: This project is not an exact replica of Terry Pratchett’s study because the creator lacked photographs from every angle and precise measurements. Instead, it depicts a small section of a study where Pratchett might have felt at home, built at 1:12 scale. The miniature is connected to the childhood imagination associated with The Borrowers.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目并不是特里·普拉切特书房的精确复制品，因为作者没有各个角度的照片和准确尺寸。它展现的是一个可能令普拉切特感到亲切的书房局部，比例为 1:12。这个微缩场景还联系到了《借东西的小人》带来的童年想象。

items.title_en: We're training a Figma-fluent editing model
items.title_zh: 我们正在训练一个精通 Figma 的编辑模型
items.summary_en: Figma is sharing research on how it is translating AI capabilities into design-editing workflows. The work focuses on training a model that is fluent in Figma editing.
items.summary_zh: Figma 正在分享如何将 AI 能力转化为设计编辑工作流的研究。该工作重点是训练一个精通 Figma 编辑操作的模型。

items.title_en: Chomsky and the two cultures of statistical learning (2011)
items.title_zh: 乔姆斯基与统计学习的两种文化（2011）
items.summary_en: The essay responds to Steven Pinker’s question about why probabilistic models trained with statistical methods have been successful. It examines Chomsky’s objections that statistical language models may have engineering value without providing scientific principles or insight into language. It also considers what statistical models are, how successful they have been, and whether their success resembles progress in science.
items.summary_zh: 文章回应了 Steven Pinker 关于统计方法训练的概率模型为何能够成功的问题。文章考察了乔姆斯基的批评：统计语言模型或许具有工程价值，却未必揭示语言背后的科学原理或提供真正洞见。文章还讨论统计模型的定义、语言模型的成功程度，以及这种成功是否类似于科学进步。

items.title_en: Writing seen in PHerc. 306B, for the first time in 2000 years
items.title_zh: PHerc. 306B 中的文字：两千年来首次重见天日
items.summary_en: Writing in PHerc. 306B has been seen for the first time in 2,000 years.
items.summary_zh: PHerc. 306B 中的文字在两千年后首次重见天日。

items.title_en: Giant canyon on Mars is still tectonically active
items.title_zh: 火星上的巨大峡谷至今仍在构造活动
items.summary_en: A giant canyon on Mars is still tectonically active. No further details about the evidence or the canyon are available here.
items.summary_zh: 火星上的一条巨大峡谷仍处于构造活动之中。现有信息未提供相关证据或峡谷的更多细节。

items.title_en: Understanding Email Encryption (2025)
items.title_zh: 理解电子邮件加密（2025）
items.summary_en: The guide explains that email can be encrypted in different ways, at different stages, and for different purposes. Each approach protects against different threats and introduces its own trade-offs. It begins by asking which email-related threats are realistic for most people.
items.summary_zh: 这份指南解释了电子邮件可以在不同阶段、以不同方式、出于不同目的进行加密。每种方式针对的威胁不同，也各有取舍。文章首先从大多数人实际面临哪些邮件威胁这一问题开始。

items.title_en: LLMs are not superhuman at reading and writing neural network weights
items.title_zh: LLM 并没有超越人类地读写神经网络权重
items.summary_en: The source challenges claims that frontier LLMs are superhuman at manipulating neural-network weights. GPT-6 Astra can identify the games a small network was trained to play from its weights and modify those weights, and it significantly improved the mathematical ability of a 0.8B Qwen model by editing them directly. The author notes that such model-improvement capabilities could be relevant to recursive self-improvement.
items.summary_zh: 资料质疑前沿大语言模型在操作神经网络权重方面已经超越人类的说法。GPT-6 Astra 能根据小型网络的权重判断其训练的游戏，并直接修改这些权重；它还通过编辑权重显著提升了 0.8B Qwen 模型的数学能力。作者指出，这类改进模型的能力可能与递归自我改进有关。

items.title_en: Last night an AI agent performed brain surgery on a mouse
items.title_zh: 昨晚，一名 AI 智能体为一只老鼠做了脑部手术
items.summary_en: An AI agent was given 19 gene-therapy vectors, a mouse model of epilepsy, a motorized surgical rig with cameras, and the goal of reducing seizures. It selected the treatment and brain region and derived surgical coordinates from the available data; the supplied account is truncated before reporting the outcome.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员向一个 AI 智能体提供了 19 种基因治疗载体、癫痫小鼠模型、带摄像头的电动手术设备，以及减少癫痫发作的目标。智能体选择了药物和脑区，并从现有数据推导出手术坐标；现有资料在说明结果前已经截断。

items.title_en: Debian apt security update (man-in-the-middle)
items.title_zh: Debian apt 安全更新（中间人攻击）
items.summary_en: Debian has issued an apt security update concerning a man-in-the-middle vulnerability. Further technical details are not available here.
items.summary_zh: Debian 发布了针对中间人攻击问题的 apt 安全更新。现有信息未提供更多技术细节。

items.title_en: The Duty of a Scholar
items.title_zh: 学者的责任
items.summary_en: The author recounts discovering a cryptographic side-channel vulnerability and developing a proof-of-concept that could recover enough bits of an RSA private key to reconstruct it. They then spent six months quietly notifying security teams and coordinating a fix before public disclosure. The account presents that work as a responsibility that took priority over academic and career obligations.
items.summary_zh: 作者回忆了发现一种密码学侧信道漏洞的过程，并制作出能够窃取足够 RSA 私钥位、进而重建完整密钥的概念验证程序。随后，作者花了六个月秘密通知安全团队并协调修复，之后才公开披露。文章将这项工作描述为优先于学业和职业安排的责任。

items.title_en: A wave of plastic-free coffee pods and machines
items.title_zh: 一波无塑料咖啡胶囊与咖啡机
items.summary_en: Growing concern about ingesting microplastics is driving the development of plastic-free coffee pods and machines.
items.summary_zh: 人们对摄入微塑料的担忧日益增加，正推动无塑料咖啡胶囊和咖啡机的发展。

items.title_en: Antimony: CAD Software Evolved from Lisp Machines and Not Drafting Tables (2015)
items.title_zh: Antimony：从 Lisp 机器而非制图桌演化而来的 CAD 软件（2015）
items.summary_en: Antimony is a computer-aided design tool imagined as if CAD software had evolved from Lisp machines rather than drafting tables. Its design is organized around three mostly orthogonal axes.
items.summary_zh: Antimony 是一款计算机辅助设计工具，其设定是 CAD 软件从 Lisp 机器而非制图桌演化而来。它的设计围绕三个大体相互正交的轴展开。

items.title_en: Qualcomm Cloud AI 100 Ultra – 150W AI Accelerator Card with 128GB at 548GB/s
items.title_zh: 高通 Cloud AI 100 Ultra：配备 128GB、548GB/s 带宽的 150W AI 加速卡
items.summary_en: Qualcomm presents the Cloud AI 100 Ultra as a 150W accelerator for generative AI. The card has 128GB of memory and 548GB/s of memory bandwidth. Qualcomm positions it as a cost-optimized option for data-center AI workloads.
items.summary_zh: 高通将 Cloud AI 100 Ultra 定位为用于生成式 AI 的 150W 加速卡。该卡配备 128GB 内存，内存带宽为 548GB/s。高通将其定位为面向数据中心 AI 工作负载的成本优化方案。

items.title_en: Image of our satellite-choked night skies
items.title_zh: 卫星挤满夜空的影像
items.summary_en: The item presents an image of night skies crowded with satellites. It is described as a striking depiction of the growing number of satellites visible above Earth.
items.summary_zh: 该条目展示了一幅卫星挤满夜空的影像。它被描述为对地球上空可见卫星数量增加的直观呈现。

items.title_en: The Megadonors Who Have Poured $1.2B into the Midterms
items.title_zh: 向中期选举投入 12 亿美元的超级捐助者
items.summary_en: The title concerns megadonors who have contributed $1.2 billion to U.S. midterm elections. It does not identify the donors or describe how the money was spent.
items.summary_zh: 标题关注向美国中期选举投入 12 亿美元的超级捐助者。标题未列出捐助者姓名，也未说明资金的具体用途。

items.title_en: Five memorable books about programming (2008)
items.title_zh: 五本令人难忘的编程书
items.summary_en: The author frames programming books as tools for turning ideas into working implementations rather than as technology for its own sake. After reading classics such as Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs and Paradigms of Artificial Intelligence Programming, the author chooses to focus on less conventional books that influenced their thinking. The selection therefore emphasizes intellectual impact over canonical status.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，编程书籍的价值不在于技术本身，而在于帮助读者把想法实现出来。在读过《计算机程序的构造和解释》和《人工智能编程范式》等经典之后，作者选择介绍一些影响了自己思考方式、但不那么主流的书。这个书单因此更看重思想影响，而非经典地位。

items.title_en: Being a kid making games in the early 2000s
items.title_zh: 2000 年代初还是孩子时制作游戏
items.summary_en: Jay Tholen's autobiographical essay recounts being a young person who made games and posted them online. Tholen is identified as the lead developer and designer of Hypnospace Outlaw, Dropsy, and Slayers X. The essay directs readers to a more detailed account of that experience.
items.summary_zh: Jay Tholen 的自传体文章回顾了自己年少时制作游戏并发布到网上的经历。Tholen 是《Hypnospace Outlaw》《Dropsy》和《Slayers X》的主创开发者与设计师。文章还引导读者阅读更详细的经历记录。

items.title_en: uBlock Origin filter to block autoplay videos in TechCrunch
items.title_zh: 用于屏蔽 TechCrunch 自动播放视频的 uBlock Origin 过滤器
items.summary_en: The filter blocks scripts used by TechCrunch's embedded JW Player and Connatix floating ad player, preventing videos from loading. Cosmetic rules then hide the empty space left by the blocked player.
items.summary_zh: 这组过滤规则会屏蔽 TechCrunch 嵌入的 JW Player 和 Connatix 浮动广告播放器所使用的脚本，从而阻止视频加载。外观规则还会隐藏播放器被拦截后留下的空白区域。

items.title_en: ISponsorBlockTV: SponsorBlock client for all YouTube TV clients
items.title_zh: iSponsorBlockTV：适用于所有 YouTube TV 客户端的 SponsorBlock 客户端
items.summary_en: iSponsorBlockTV is a self-hosted application that connects to the YouTube TV app and automatically skips sponsored segments and intros using the SponsorBlock API. It can also mute videos automatically and press YouTube's "Skip Ad" button when it appears. YouTube appears to have changed its screen-ID format and is revoking existing codes, so devices must be paired again.
items.summary_zh: iSponsorBlockTV 是一款自托管应用，可连接 YouTube TV 客户端，并通过 SponsorBlock API 自动跳过赞助片段和片头。它还可以自动静音，并在 YouTube 广告出现“跳过广告”按钮后自动点击。YouTube 似乎更改了屏幕 ID 格式并正在撤销现有代码，因此设备需要重新配对。

items.title_en: Novellas with Groff
items.title_zh: 与 Groff 一起写中篇小说
items.summary_en: The author says they recently finished their second novella. They do not plan to publish it or send it privately to readers.
items.summary_zh: 作者表示自己最近完成了第二部中篇小说。但作者不打算公开发表，也不打算私下发送给读者。

items.title_en: University libraries are being swarmed by AI bots, putting public access at risk
items.title_zh: 大学图书馆遭 AI 机器人蜂拥抓取，公共访问面临风险
items.summary_en: AI bots are swarming university libraries and putting public access at risk.
items.summary_zh: AI 机器人正大量抓取大学图书馆资源，使公共访问面临风险。

items.title_en: Democrats launching congressional investigations into SpaceXAI, META and Apple
items.title_zh: 民主党人将对 SpaceX、Meta 和苹果发起国会调查
items.summary_en: Democrats are launching congressional investigations into SpaceX, Meta, and Apple.
items.summary_zh: 民主党人将对 SpaceX、Meta 和苹果发起国会调查。

items.title_en: Distinct cellular and genetic differences in colorectal cancer in young patients
items.title_zh: 年轻结直肠癌患者存在独特的细胞和遗传差异
items.summary_en: Researchers from Dana-Farber, Mass General Brigham, and the Broad Institute identified biological clues that may explain why colorectal cancer can behave more aggressively in younger people. Published in Nature Medicine, the study is described as the largest of its kind and compares age-associated cellular and genetic features. In the United States, colorectal cancer diagnoses among people under 50 rose 2.9 percent per year from 2013 through 2022.
items.summary_zh: Dana-Farber、Mass General Brigham 和 Broad Institute 的研究人员发现了可能解释年轻人结直肠癌为何表现得更具侵袭性的生物学线索。该研究发表于《自然·医学》，被称为同类研究中规模最大的一项，并比较了与年龄相关的细胞和遗传特征。在美国，2013 至 2022 年间，50 岁以下人群的结直肠癌诊断率年均上升 2.9%。

items.title_en: The U.S. Census Bureau and "Super Intelligence"
items.title_zh: 美国人口普查局与“超级智能”
items.summary_en: The author revisited U.S. corporate AI-adoption data from the Census Bureau's Business Trends and Outlook Survey. The survey is conducted every two weeks and samples 200,000 businesses from a total population of 1.2 million, with each business participating once every 12 weeks. The author says the Bureau's data work has been affected by Executive Order 14434, referred to as the “Super Intelligence” order.
items.summary_zh: 作者重新查看了美国人口普查局商业趋势与展望调查中的企业 AI 采用数据。该调查每两周进行一次，从总计 120 万家企业中抽取 20 万家，每家企业每 12 周参与一次。作者称，人口普查局的数据工作受到了第 14434 号行政命令，即所谓“超级智能”行政命令的影响。

items.title_en: Show HN: Uncracked City, detective game where you question LLM suspects that lie
items.title_zh: Show HN：Uncracked City——审问会撒谎的 LLM 嫌疑人的侦探游戏
items.summary_en: Uncracked City is a detective game in which players question LLM-controlled suspects who may lie. Each case takes place in a real city with real public locations, while the crimes and characters are fictional. The game is free on Android, available in six languages, and its iOS version is awaiting review.
items.summary_zh: Uncracked City 是一款侦探游戏，玩家需要审问可能撒谎的 LLM 控制的嫌疑人。每个案件都发生在拥有真实公共地点的城市中，但犯罪事件和人物均为虚构。游戏在 Android 上免费提供，支持六种语言，iOS 版本仍在等待审核。

items.title_en: Nvidia Kubernetes Engine (NVKE)
items.title_zh: Nvidia Kubernetes Engine（NVKE）
items.summary_en: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine is a management plane for running Kubernetes on bare-metal NVIDIA GPU infrastructure. Platform teams can install it to create and operate workload clusters, each with its own control plane, etcd, and node pools. NVKE is currently a preview release, and its APIs, configuration, and behavior may change, so it is not recommended for production workloads.
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine 是一个用于在裸机 NVIDIA GPU 基础设施上运行 Kubernetes 的管理平面。平台团队可以安装它来创建和运营工作负载集群，每个集群都拥有独立的控制平面、etcd 和节点池。NVKE 目前仍处于预览阶段，API、配置和行为可能发生变化，因此不建议用于生产工作负载。

items.title_en: There is no posttraining data commons
items.title_zh: 不存在后训练数据公共资源库
items.summary_en: The essay argues that pretraining benefited from a large public commons of digitized knowledge, including Wikipedia, open-source code, Stack Exchange, arXiv papers, and public-domain books. Posttraining consumes tasks rather than documents, and the author says no comparable shared resource currently exists. This creates a data problem for the open-models community.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，预训练受益于一个庞大的数字化知识公共资源库，其中包括维基百科、开源代码、Stack Exchange、arXiv 论文和公版书籍。后训练消耗的是任务而非文档，而作者认为目前不存在可比的共享资源。这给开放模型社区带来了数据问题。

items.title_en: Shrinking NixOS RAM footprint and resource requirements to the bare minimum
items.title_zh: 将 NixOS 的内存占用和资源需求压缩到最低
items.summary_en: The guide describes reducing NixOS's RAM requirements to 512 MB. The author expected the work to take half a day but spent nearly three days on it, and notes that the guide focuses on RAM rather than disk-space reduction. Combining the approaches may introduce defaults that users do not expect.
items.summary_zh: 这份指南介绍了如何将 NixOS 的内存需求降至 512 MB。作者原本预计半天完成，但实际花了近三天，并说明文章重点是降低内存占用，而不是节省磁盘空间。将两类优化结合使用，可能会引入终端用户意料之外的默认设置。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Rivet (YC W23) – Scale and Orchestrate Agents on S3
items.title_zh: Launch HN：Rivet（YC W23）——在 S3 上扩展和编排代理
items.summary_en: Rivet is an open-source, self-hostable orchestrator for agent workloads built around lightweight actors backed by S3. Each actor provides a long-lived process, in-memory context, a WebSocket server, durable SQLite storage backed by S3, and idle hibernation. The team says the design grew out of infrastructure work for multiplayer games and aims to avoid the overhead of running a heavyweight sandbox per agent.
items.summary_zh: Rivet 是一个开源、可自行托管的代理工作负载编排器，围绕由 S3 支持的轻量级 actor 构建。每个 actor 都提供长期运行的进程、内存上下文、WebSocket 服务器、由 S3 支持的持久化 SQLite 存储，以及空闲休眠功能。团队表示，该设计源自多人游戏基础设施工作，旨在避免为每个代理运行重量级沙箱的开销。

items.title_en: The Web Is More Than Enough, by Paul Ford
items.title_zh: Web 已经足够强大，作者：Paul Ford
items.summary_en: The author argues that web browsers now support rich application development with far less difficulty than before. A browser-based office suite that stores data in the URL attracted enough visitors to exhaust the Cloudflare free plan and draw several hundred thousand people after the author added a payment method. The project also received feature requests, media coverage, and a temporary top-ten position on Product Hunt.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为，如今的浏览器已经能够以比过去低得多的成本支持丰富的应用开发。一款将数据存储在 URL 中的浏览器办公套件吸引了大量访问者，耗尽 Cloudflare 免费套餐；作者绑定支付方式后，又有数十万人前来访问。该项目还收到功能请求，获得媒体报道，并一度进入 Product Hunt 前十。

items.title_en: Ads in Popular Apps Give Police a Powerful Tool to Spy on Users
items.title_zh: 热门应用中的广告给了警方强大的用户监控工具
items.summary_en: The piece reports that advertisements in popular apps can provide police with a powerful tool for tracking users.
items.summary_zh: 文章称，热门应用中的广告可能为警方提供一种强大的用户追踪工具。

items.title_en: Have I befriended a murderer?
items.title_zh: 我是否和一个杀人犯成了朋友？
items.summary_en: A journalist spent five years investigating a man convicted of bludgeoning his wife to death. During that investigation, the boundary between journalism and friendship became blurred. The piece recounts that personal and professional entanglement.
items.summary_zh: 一名记者花了五年调查一名因殴打妻子致死而被定罪的男子。在调查过程中，新闻工作与私人友谊之间的界限逐渐模糊。文章讲述了这段个人关系与职业调查交织在一起的经历。

items.title_en: Can GROUP BY still be optimized after all these years?
items.title_zh: GROUP BY 这么多年后还能继续优化吗？
items.summary_en: Pivot introduced an optimization for GROUP BY queries with a Top-K operator above them, significantly improving performance when finding the groups with the highest aggregate values. The example query is finding the 10 items with the most orders. The walkthrough also explains how analytical databases execute GROUP BY operations.
items.summary_zh: Pivot 为带有 Top-K 运算符的 GROUP BY 查询引入了一项优化，在寻找聚合值最高的分组时显著提升了性能。示例查询是找出订单量最多的 10 个商品。文章还讲解了分析型数据库如何执行 GROUP BY。

items.title_en: Starship Flight 15 on 11/13 plans to catch both booster and ship
items.title_zh: 星舰第 15 次飞行计划于 11 月 13 日同时接住助推器和飞船
items.summary_en: SpaceX’s Starship Flight 15 is scheduled for November 13 and plans to catch both the booster and the ship. The available information identifies SpaceX as a company that designs, manufactures, and launches rockets and spacecraft, but provides no further details about the flight plan.
items.summary_zh: SpaceX 的星舰第 15 次飞行计划于 11 月 13 日进行，目标是同时接住助推器和飞船。现有信息只说明 SpaceX 负责设计、制造和发射火箭及航天器，没有提供更多飞行计划细节。

items.title_en: How do you take a picture of a black hole?
items.title_zh: 如何拍摄黑洞照片？
items.summary_en: Astrophysicist Shep Doeleman explains how the first image of a black hole was captured using a telescope effectively the size of Earth. The image shows the black hole’s shadow, which can test theoretical predictions. The next goal is to create a movie rather than a single image.
items.summary_zh: 天体物理学家 Shep Doeleman 解释了人类如何利用实际上与地球一样大的望远镜拍摄第一张黑洞图像。图像展示的是黑洞的阴影，可用于检验理论预测。下一步目标是制作黑洞的动态影片，而不只是单张图像。

items.title_en: Skill to Create Product Videos
items.title_zh: 创建产品视频的技能
items.summary_en: This project is a Claude Code skill for creating product videos. It supports real-browser capture, branded composition, and local mastering, and includes a quick start, worked videos, and usage instructions.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个用于制作产品视频的 Claude Code 技能。它支持真实浏览器录制、品牌化合成和本地母版制作，并提供快速入门、示例视频和使用说明。

items.title_en: Consumer brain wave headsets threaten privacy
items.title_zh: 面向消费者的脑电波耳机威胁隐私
items.summary_en: Consumer brain-wave headsets threaten privacy by collecting users' brain data.
items.summary_zh: 面向消费者的脑电波耳机通过收集用户的脑部数据，对隐私构成威胁。

items.title_en: New 3D thermal invisibility cloak makes objects disappear from infrared cameras
items.title_zh: 新型三维热隐身斗篷让物体从红外摄像机中消失
items.summary_en: Researchers developed and tested a three-dimensional thermal cloak that can conceal complex objects from infrared cameras while protecting them from extreme temperatures. Rather than blocking heat, it guides heat around the hidden object and works across different heat directions and object shapes. Potential applications include electronics cooling, thermal protection, and reducing thermal detection.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员开发并测试了一种三维热隐身斗篷，能够让复杂物体避开红外摄像机的探测，同时保护其免受极端温度影响。它不是阻挡热量，而是将热量引导至物体周围，并能适应不同的热流方向和物体形状。潜在应用包括电子设备散热、热防护和降低热特征探测。

items.title_en: Ballot Rejections Have Soared in Rural Counties as USPS Reduces Mail Service
items.title_zh: 美国邮政减少服务后，农村县的选票拒收激增
items.summary_en: A ProPublica data analysis found that postal delays caused by cost-cutting measures endangered the validity of ballots mailed from rural areas. Counties that voted for Trump in 2024 were affected most heavily. Election workers near Spokane, Washington, checked the post office three days after a primary while waiting for late ballots.
items.summary_zh: ProPublica 的数据分析发现，削减成本措施造成的邮政延误，危及农村地区邮寄选票的有效性。2024 年投票支持特朗普的县受到的影响最严重。在华盛顿州斯波坎以北，选举工作人员在初选后三天前往邮局，等待迟到的邮寄选票。

items.title_en: This Month in Ladybird – October 2026
items.title_zh: Ladybird 月报：2026 年 10 月
items.summary_en: In October, Ladybird moved style and layout work off the main thread, built a JavaScript JIT, and replaced its WebAssembly engine. The browser also received a redesigned user interface and passed Safari Technology Preview on Web Platform Tests. Ladybird is funded entirely by companies and individuals supporting the open web.
items.summary_zh: 10 月，Ladybird 将样式和布局工作移出主线程，构建了 JavaScript JIT，并替换了 WebAssembly 引擎。该浏览器还重新设计了用户界面，并在 Web Platform Tests 中超过了 Safari Technology Preview。Ladybird 完全由支持开放网络的企业和个人资助。

items.title_en: Curiosity Traps
items.title_zh: 好奇心陷阱
items.summary_en: The essay discusses reverse honeypots, deliberate intellectual attractions designed to draw in attentive and constructive people. In contrast with computing honeypots that lure malicious actors, these “curiosity traps” use interesting ideas to encourage close attention and serendipitous connections.
items.summary_zh: 文章讨论了“反向蜜罐”：有意设置的智力诱饵，用来吸引专注且具有建设性的人。与计算机领域引诱恶意行为者的蜜罐不同，这些“好奇心陷阱”利用有趣的想法鼓励深入关注和意外的知识连接。

items.title_en: Bidirectional charging during grid outages
items.title_zh: 电网停电期间的双向充电
items.summary_en: The piece considers using an electric vehicle’s large battery both to power a home during outages and to recharge from solar panels while the grid is down. Several manufacturers support vehicle-to-home discharge, but generally treat it as a separate mode and do not support recharging the car during the outage. Existing documentation from GM and Ford describes backup discharge without the proposed combined operation.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨了在停电时利用电动汽车的大电池为家庭供电，并在电网中断期间通过太阳能为车辆充电的做法。多家制造商支持车辆向家庭放电，但通常将其视为独立模式，不支持在停电期间为车辆重新充电。GM 和 Ford 的现有文档描述了备用放电功能，却没有提供这种组合运行方式。

items.title_en: A Little Snitch for Windows
items.title_zh: Windows 版 Little Snitch
items.summary_en: PacketHound is a free outbound firewall for Windows. When an application first tries to connect to the internet, it shows the publisher, destination, and port, then lets the user allow or block the connection permanently or until the application exits.
items.summary_zh: PacketHound 是一款免费的 Windows 出站防火墙。应用首次尝试连接互联网时，它会显示应用开发者、目标地址和端口，用户可以允许或阻止连接，并选择永久生效或仅持续到应用退出。

items.title_en: SLAC researchers find proof of altermagnetism, a new magnetic phase
items.title_zh: SLAC 研究人员找到交错磁性的证据，这是一种新的磁性相
items.summary_en: A team led by SLAC researchers reports direct observation of a distinctive property in an altermagnetic candidate material. Published findings provide experimental evidence for altermagnetism as a third magnetic phase alongside ferromagnetism and antiferromagnetism. The researchers say the phase combines properties associated with the two established classes.
items.summary_zh: 由 SLAC 研究人员领导的团队报告称，他们在一种交错磁性候选材料中直接观察到了独特性质。论文结果为交错磁性作为铁磁性和反铁磁性之外的第三种磁性相提供了实验证据。研究人员表示，这种磁性相兼具两类既有磁性的部分特征。

items.title_en: Agentic backdoors via pretraining poisoning
items.title_zh: 通过预训练投毒植入智能体后门
items.summary_en: Researchers show that poisoned pretraining data can implant a remote-code-execution backdoor in an LLM-based agent. In experiments with Qwen3 models, poisoning just 0.1% of the corpus produced a backdoor, and the 4B model reached about 92% attack success when the trigger was present. The backdoor remained effective at a poisoning rate of 0.0005%, demonstrating a risk from uncurated web-scale training data.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员证明，经过投毒的预训练数据可以在基于大语言模型的智能体中植入远程代码执行后门。在 Qwen3 模型实验中，仅污染 0.1% 的语料就能植入后门；触发条件出现时，4B 模型的攻击成功率约为 92%。即使投毒比例降至 0.0005%，后门仍保持有效，显示出未经筛选的网络训练数据带来的风险。

items.title_en: Kalshi court losses pile up as judges refuse to block state gambling laws
items.title_zh: Kalshi 法庭败诉不断：法官拒绝阻止州赌博法
items.summary_en: Two federal appeals courts rejected Kalshi's latest attempts to block gambling laws in Connecticut, New York, and Nevada. The prediction-market company is also facing a new lawsuit from the Arkansas attorney general. The central dispute is whether state gambling laws apply to Kalshi's markets despite its claim that they are swaps regulated only by the CFTC. The Trump administration supports Kalshi's position.
items.summary_zh: 两家联邦上诉法院驳回了 Kalshi 最近阻止康涅狄格州、纽约州和内华达州赌博法实施的请求。这家预测市场公司还面临阿肯色州总检察长提起的新诉讼。争议核心在于，尽管 Kalshi 声称其产品属于只能由商品期货交易委员会监管的“互换”，州赌博法是否仍适用于这些市场。特朗普政府支持 Kalshi 的立场。

items.title_en: When a language's creator and its owners strongly disagree [pdf]
items.title_zh: 当语言的创造者与其所有者严重分歧时
items.summary_en: This paper examines a strong disagreement between a programming language’s creator and the entities that own it. The available information does not identify the language, the parties, or the substance of the disagreement.
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文探讨了一位编程语言创作者与其所有者之间的严重分歧。现有信息没有说明涉及哪种语言、相关各方是谁，也没有说明分歧的具体内容。

items.title_en: Evergreen: A Provably Safe Systems Language
items.title_zh: Evergreen：一种可证明安全的系统编程语言
items.summary_en: Evergreen is a systems programming language that treats invariants as part of the code. Preconditions, postconditions, and data invariants are placed beside the code they describe. The compiler checks these conditions as obligations.
items.summary_zh: Evergreen 是一种将不变量纳入代码的系统编程语言。前置条件、后置条件和数据不变量会写在所描述代码旁边。编译器会将这些条件作为义务进行检查。

items.title_en: Show HN: I rebuilt my old canvas 3D library as a small WebGL 2 library – phoria2
items.title_zh: Show HN：我把旧的 canvas 3D 库重写成了小型 WebGL 2 库——phoria2
items.summary_en: Phoria2 is a small JavaScript library for web-based 3D charts, labeled scenes, dashboards, and product viewers, using a WebGL 2 renderer. Its API is designed to be learned quickly and is intended for both humans and coding agents. The project rewrites phoria.js, a 2013 library that rendered 3D through the 2D canvas context.
items.summary_zh: Phoria2 是一个基于 WebGL 2 渲染器的轻量 JavaScript 3D 库，可用于网页图表、带标签场景、仪表盘和产品查看器。它的 API 设计为易于快速学习，并同时面向人类开发者和编码代理。该项目重写了 2013 年通过 2D canvas 上下文渲染 3D 的 phoria.js。

items.title_en: Hacking the Xbox 360 Hypervisor Part 3: Bad Update Improvements
items.title_zh: 破解 Xbox 360 超级监控程序（第三部分）：改进 Bad Update
items.summary_en: The third part of this series describes improvements to the Xbox 360 Bad Update exploit. Its runtime was reduced from about 20 minutes to nearly instantaneous, while its success rate rose from roughly 30% to nearly 100%. The post also covers improvements by other researchers, including a new game-save entry point in the demo version of Rock Band Blitz.
items.summary_zh: 该系列第三部分介绍了 Xbox 360 Bad Update 漏洞利用方式的改进。其运行时间从约 20 分钟缩短到几乎即时，成功率则从约 30% 提升到接近 100%。文章还介绍了其他研究者做出的改进，包括利用《Rock Band Blitz》试玩版中的新游戏存档入口。

items.title_en: Show HN: A language model that lives in a boot sector
items.title_zh: Show HN：运行在引导扇区中的语言模型
items.summary_en: BootGPT places an entire inference engine in a 510-byte MBR, with model weights, vocabulary, and strings stored in the following disk sectors. Its small character-level neural network was trained to generate Linux boot messages indefinitely, matching a simulator character by character. Debugging uncovered an x86 assembly bug involving the remainder left in EDX by integer division and a pointer that also used EDX.
items.summary_zh: BootGPT 将完整推理引擎放入 510 字节的 MBR 中，并把模型权重、词汇表和字符串存储在后续磁盘扇区。这个小型字符级神经网络经过训练，可以无限生成 Linux 启动消息，并与模拟器逐字符匹配。调试过程中发现了一个 x86 汇编错误：整数除法会把余数留在 EDX，而偏置表指针也使用了 EDX。

items.title_en: Claude Opus 5.5 Can Draw Permit-Level Architectural Drawings
items.title_zh: Claude Opus 5.5 能绘制达到许可级别的建筑图纸
items.summary_en: The piece claims that Claude Opus 5.5 can produce architectural drawings at a permit-level standard.
items.summary_zh: 文章称 Claude Opus 5.5 能够绘制达到许可级别标准的建筑图纸。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Kino AI (YC S23) – AI media manager and video editor
items.title_zh: Launch HN：Kino AI（YC S23）——AI 媒体管理器和视频编辑器
items.summary_en: Kino combines footage and asset storage, a video editor, review links, and teammate collaboration in one workspace. Agents, colleagues, and coding tools such as Codex and Claude Code can work on the same timeline with shared notes and footage. Its code-first editor expresses editing, motion graphics, timeline operations, comments, and 3D scenes as code built on Remotion.
items.summary_zh: Kino 将素材与资产存储、视频编辑器、审阅链接和团队协作整合在一个工作区中。智能体、同事以及 Codex 和 Claude Code 等编程工具可以围绕同一时间线协作，共享评论和素材。其代码优先的编辑器基于 Remotion，把剪辑、动态图形、时间线操作、评论和 3D 场景都表示为代码。

items.title_en: YC's Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
items.title_zh: YC 的 Garry Tan 重度使用 AI agent，每年令牌开销最高达 20 万美元
items.summary_en: Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan told Walter Isaacson that he spends roughly $100,000 to $200,000 a year on AI tokens. He uses agents for numerous work projects and coding tasks and has published 23 Claude Code skills, called gstack, on GitHub. Tan has also joked publicly about working with agents so intensely that he barely sleeps at times.
items.summary_zh: Y Combinator 首席执行官 Garry Tan 告诉 Walter Isaacson，他每年在 AI 令牌上的支出约为 10 万至 20 万美元。他将 agent 用于众多工作项目和编程任务，并在 GitHub 上公开了名为 gstack 的 23 个 Claude Code 技能。Tan 此前还曾开玩笑说，自己有时沉迷于与 agent 工作，几乎无法入睡。

items.title_en: The Flash C Compiler
items.title_zh: Flash C 编译器
items.summary_en: Flash C is a C compiler.
items.summary_zh: Flash C 是一个 C 编译器。

items.title_en: Domain hacks with unusual Unicode characters (2018)
items.title_zh: 使用罕见 Unicode 字符制作域名变体（2018）
items.summary_en: It points out that symbols such as ™, ℠, ℞, ℡, and № are individual Unicode characters, and notes that .tel and .no are also top-level domains.
items.summary_zh: 文章介绍了使用罕见 Unicode 字符制作域名变体的做法。它指出 ™、℠、℞、℡ 和 № 等符号都各自是单个 Unicode 字符，并注意到 .tel 和 .no 也都是顶级域名。

items.title_en: Show HN: Firenook – Firebase emulators in Rust: 40× faster writes, 10× less RAM
items.title_zh: Show HN：Firenook——用 Rust 编写的 Firebase 模拟器，写入快 40 倍、内存少 10 倍
items.summary_en: Firenook is presented as a Rust-based drop-in replacement for the Firebase Emulator Suite. Its developers say it removes the Java dependency, adds a newly built web console, and delivers 40-times-faster writes while using one-tenth as much RAM. In a test with two million records, Firenook used about 2 GB of memory compared with 22 GB for the official suite.
items.summary_zh: Firenook 是一个用 Rust 编写的 Firebase Emulator Suite 即插即用替代品。开发者称，它去除了 Java 依赖，重新构建了网页控制台，写入速度提升 40 倍，内存占用降至十分之一。在加载 200 万条数据的测试中，Firenook 使用约 2 GB 内存，而官方套件使用约 22 GB。

items.title_en: Show HN: I built a tool that prices a pre-built PC part by part
items.title_zh: Show HN：我做了一个逐项估算预装电脑价格的工具
items.summary_en: The tool lets users paste a prebuilt-PC listing and receive a value grade, dated component estimates, and a shareable report. AI extracts information from the listing, while a custom pricing engine determines the grade and updates daily. The creator is seeking feedback on the scoring system, interface, and usefulness.
items.summary_zh: 该工具允许用户粘贴预装电脑的商品信息，并获得价值评级、带日期的组件估价和可分享报告。AI 负责读取商品描述，自定义定价引擎负责计算评级，并每天更新价格。开发者正在寻求对评分方式、界面和实用性的反馈。

items.title_en: Partial Operator Precedence
items.title_zh: 部分运算符优先级
items.summary_en: This Zig Devlog page contains a curated list of recent changes to the language’s main branch. It includes entries for 2026, with separate archives available for other years.
items.summary_zh: 这篇 Zig 开发日志整理了该语言主分支近期的变更。页面包含 2026 年的条目，其他年份则可通过独立的归档页面查看。

items.title_en: Efficient algorithms, the Exponential Time Hypothesis, and losing the plot
items.title_zh: 高效算法、指数时间假说与偏离主题
items.summary_en: The essay revisits the Exponential Time Hypothesis and Strong Exponential Time Hypothesis. It describes them as deliberately provocative working hypotheses rather than conjectures, intended both to challenge claims that P equals NP and to explore relationships among problems when SAT requires far more than polynomial time. Earlier work had improved brute-force exponents, but the connections between those results were unclear.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章重新审视指数时间假说和强指数时间假说。文章称，它们原本是带有挑衅性的工作假说，而非严格猜想：一方面用于挑战“P=NP”的主张，另一方面用于探索当 SAT 的真实复杂度远超多项式时间时，不同问题之间会如何关联。此前人们不断改进暴力算法的指数常数，但这些结果之间的联系并不清晰。

items.title_en: Memorilla: Latent Semantic Memory for LLMs
items.title_zh: Memorilla：面向大语言模型的潜在语义记忆
items.summary_en: Memorilla is a memory system that compresses information from an entire document collection into a fixed number of query-dependent memory tokens for a frozen LLM. It encodes documents once, then retrieves and places relevant information in the model's input embedding space. Using 16 memory tokens, it outperformed baselines on five of eight benchmarks. On FactKG, it reached 84.33% accuracy versus 80.43% for full-context inference while using 108 times fewer tokens to represent the source documents.
items.summary_zh: Memorilla 是一种记忆系统，能将整个文档集合的信息压缩为固定数量、随查询变化的记忆 token，供冻结的大语言模型使用。它先对文档进行一次编码，再检索相关信息并将其放入模型的输入嵌入空间。在八项基准测试中的五项上，使用 16 个记忆 token 的 Memorilla 击败了对比系统。在 FactKG 测试中，它的准确率达到 84.33%，高于完整上下文推理的 80.43%，同时表示源文档所需的 token 数减少了 108 倍。

items.title_en: AI fan wikis riddled with errors are muddying the waters of games culture
items.title_zh: 充斥错误的 AI 粉丝维基正在搅乱游戏文化
items.summary_en: AI-powered fan wikis are appearing with inaccurate or irrelevant information, leaving fans sidelined and publishers to address the problems.
