One cited Nighthawks wiki was not genuinely editable, contained fictional characters and skills, and mixed in unrelated information from a film and a painting with the same name. Its listed sources were sometimes unrelated to the pages they supposedly supported.
items.summary_zh: 由 AI 驱动的粉丝维基正在出现大量不准确或无关信息，使粉丝被排除在外，也迫使发行商处理这些问题。文中提到的一个《Nighthawks》维基并非真正可编辑的维基，还包含虚构的角色和技能，并将同名电影和画作的无关信息混入页面。它列出的来源有时也与页面内容毫无关系。

items.title_en: Zero Hour: Telling time was a matter of survival and strategy during WWI (2014)
items.title_zh: 零时刻：第一次世界大战中，报时关乎生存与战略（2014）
items.summary_en: It recounts Hungarian officer and artist Béla Zombory-Moldován finding his watch intact while wounded during an evacuation in Galicia. The war also drove rapid advances in communication technology alongside new weapons such as poison gas, tanks, and heavy artillery.
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述了第一次世界大战期间，报时如何成为关乎生存与战略的问题。匈牙利军官兼艺术家 Béla Zombory-Moldován 在加利西亚战场受伤撤离时，发现自己的手表仍完好无损。战争还推动了通信技术的快速发展，与此同时，毒气、坦克和重型火炮等新武器相继出现。

items.title_en: We can do better than line-buffered output
items.title_zh: 我们可以做得比按行缓冲输出更好
items.summary_en: The piece argues that line buffering can bottleneck non-interactive terminal applications, while full buffering delays output until a buffer fills or is explicitly flushed. It uses unzip's file-name output as an example where printing can dominate extraction time for archives with many small files. The proposed approach aims to deliver lines promptly to terminals while retaining the speed of full buffering.
items.summary_zh: 文章指出，行缓冲可能成为非交互式终端应用的瓶颈，而完全缓冲会延迟输出，直到缓冲区填满或被显式刷新。文章以 unzip 输出文件名为例：对于包含大量小文件的压缩包，打印过程可能占据主要解压时间。文中提出的方法旨在保持完全缓冲速度的同时，将行内容及时发送到终端。

items.title_en: The Reconstruction of Torn Documents
items.title_zh: 撕毁文件的重建
items.summary_en: Germany's Federal Archives assumed responsibility for MfS records after the Stasi Records Agency was dissolved in June 2021, and document reconstruction became a statutory task. A computer-assisted reconstruction project had been dormant after scanning stopped in 2014 and reassembly in 2016. After discussions with the Fraunhofer Institute for Production Systems and Design Technology, the archives concluded that the project could not continue in its existing form and instructed the procurement office to terminate the old contract.
items.summary_zh: 德国联邦档案馆在国家安全部档案机构于 2021 年 6 月解散后接管了原东德国家安全部档案，文件重建也首次成为法律规定的任务。一个计算机辅助重建项目在 2014 年停止扫描、2016 年停止重新拼接后一直处于停滞状态。联邦档案馆与弗劳恩霍夫生产系统与设计技术研究所讨论后认定，该项目无法按原有方式继续，并要求采购部门终止旧合同。

items.title_en: Text.js: Build full-stack React apps that render inside console.log
items.title_zh: Text.js：让全栈 React 应用渲染在 console.log 中
items.summary_en: Text.js is a React framework for building full-stack applications that render inside the browser’s DevTools console. Its page itself runs in the console and provides keyboard shortcuts for opening developer tools. The framework presents console rendering as an alternative interface for React applications.
items.summary_zh: Text.js 是一个 React 框架，用于构建渲染在浏览器开发者工具控制台中的全栈应用。它的页面本身也会在控制台中运行，并提供打开开发者工具的快捷键。该框架将控制台渲染作为 React 应用的一种替代界面。

items.title_en: I toured Unitree's factory. I'm more bullish on the West
items.title_zh: 我参观了 Unitree 工厂，对西方更有信心了
items.summary_en: A visit to Unitree’s Hangzhou factory found that actuator production was still largely manual, with only one or two newer automated lines and many workers using old winding machines. Unitree describes a viral humanoid assembly video as an actual deployment, while its IPO prospectus calls it a pilot and says assembly is mainly manual. At the end of 2025, Unitree’s machinery was valued at about $1.7 million while the company produced nearly 32,000 robots that year.
items.summary_zh: 参观 Unitree 杭州工厂时，作者发现执行器生产仍主要依靠人工：只有一两条较新的自动化产线，其余区域有许多工人操作老式绕线机。Unitree 将一段在自家工厂进行人形机器人装配的热门视频称为实际部署，但 IPO 招股书称其为试点，并表示装配目前主要靠人工。2025 年底，Unitree 的设备账面价值约为 170 万美元，而公司当年生产了近 3.2 万台机器人。

items.title_en: What do the next 4000 emoji look like?
items.title_zh: 未来 4000 个 emoji 会是什么样？
items.summary_en: The piece asks what the next 4,000 emoji might look like.
items.summary_zh: 文章提出了一个问题：未来 4000 个 emoji 可能会是什么样子。

items.title_en: JIT bitmap text rendering for microcontrollers
items.title_zh: 面向微控制器的 JIT 位图文字渲染
items.summary_en: The project develops text rendering for an RP2350-based re-creation of an 1980s home computer. It uses bitmap fonts for efficiency and their crisp appearance at low resolutions, while also seeking proportional spacing and kerning. The author notes that many RP2350 projects use fixed character cells because high-performance proportional rendering is difficult.
items.summary_zh: 该项目为基于 RP2350 的 20 世纪 80 年代家用电脑复刻设备开发文字渲染功能。作者选择位图字体，原因是其效率较高，并且在低分辨率下能保持清晰外观，同时还希望实现比例间距和字距调整。作者指出，许多 RP2350 项目采用固定字符单元，因为高性能的比例字体渲染较难实现。

items.title_en: ToothPaste
items.title_zh: ToothPaste
items.summary_en: ToothPaste wirelessly transmits AES-256-encrypted keyboard and mouse commands to USB-compatible devices. It uses Web Bluetooth, a cryptographic IC, and an ESP32-S3, without requiring specialized drivers or extensive setup. The project is designed for cross-platform device control.
items.summary_zh: ToothPaste 可将经过 AES-256 加密的键盘和鼠标指令无线传输到兼容 USB 的设备。它使用 Web Bluetooth、加密芯片和 ESP32-S3，无需专用驱动或复杂配置。该项目面向跨平台设备控制。

items.title_en: I'm not a fan of Deno's security model (2024)
items.title_zh: 我不喜欢 Deno 的安全模型（2024）
items.summary_en: It describes Deno as a JavaScript runtime that includes a standard library, package manager, and TypeScript transpiler. Deno uses V8 to interpret and compile JavaScript rather than implementing its own JavaScript engine.
items.summary_zh: 文章考察了 Deno 的安全机制，尤其是权限系统，并认为这种模型从根本上不安全且容易误导。文中将 Deno 描述为一个 JavaScript 运行时，包含标准库、包管理器和 TypeScript 转译器。Deno 使用 V8 来解释和编译 JavaScript，而不是自行实现 JavaScript 引擎。

items.title_en: Silicon Valley Promises AI Will Cure Disease. Drugmaker CEOs Aren't Buying It
items.title_zh: 硅谷承诺 AI 将治愈疾病，制药公司 CEO 却并不买账
items.summary_en: The piece contrasts Silicon Valley's promises that AI will cure disease with skepticism from drugmaker CEOs.
items.summary_zh: 文章将硅谷关于 AI 能够治愈疾病的承诺，与制药公司 CEO 的怀疑态度进行了对比。

items.title_en: TextEdit vs. Pages
items.title_zh: TextEdit 对比 Pages
items.summary_en: The author agrees that TextEdit can usually handle simple word-processing tasks but chooses to continue using Pages. The decision follows an experiment prompted by an argument that TextEdit is an underappreciated macOS word processor. The piece explains why Pages remains the author's preference.
items.summary_zh: 作者认同 TextEdit 通常能够完成简单的文字处理任务，但仍选择继续使用 Pages。这个决定源于一次尝试：有人认为 TextEdit 是 macOS 上被低估的文字处理器。文章解释了作者为何依然偏好 Pages。

items.title_en: AI for scientific discovery: How researchers use Claude
items.title_zh: 用于科学发现的 AI：研究人员如何使用 Claude
items.summary_en: Researchers analyzed 207,000 sessions to study how Claude is used in scientific work and which tasks receive the most use. The study examines how AI might amplify researchers' capabilities and accelerate scientific discovery. It argues that research may be an early and significant domain for AI because of its highly cognitive nature and its dependence on scarce human time and expertise.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员分析了 207,000 次会话，以了解 Claude 如何用于科学工作，以及哪些任务最常使用它。这项研究考察了 AI 如何扩大研究人员的能力并加速科学发现。研究认为，由于科研高度依赖认知劳动和稀缺的人类时间与专业知识，科研可能会成为 AI 较早产生重大影响的领域。

items.title_en: Microsoft is winding down Oracle deal to rent AI cloud capacity
items.title_zh: 微软正逐步结束租用 AI 云容量的甲骨文协议
items.summary_en: Microsoft is winding down its deal with Oracle to rent AI cloud capacity.
items.summary_zh: 微软正逐步结束与甲骨文签订的 AI 云容量租用协议。

items.title_en: Retro Song Bird: Plug in any Game Boy cartridge to hear the soundtrack
items.title_zh: Retro Song Bird：插入任意 Game Boy 卡带，聆听游戏配乐
items.summary_en: Retro Song Bird lets users relive classic-game soundtracks by plugging in a Game Boy cartridge. It supports more than 1,900 games.
items.summary_zh: Retro Song Bird 允许用户插入 Game Boy 卡带，重温经典游戏的配乐。它支持超过 1,900 款游戏。

items.title_en: Tasfer: a text editor drawn on a 2D canvas
items.title_zh: Tasfer：绘制在二维画布上的文本编辑器
items.summary_en: Tasfer is an open-source web text editor built on a 2D canvas instead of contentEditable. It includes peer-to-peer collaboration and requires no accounts. The author chose this approach to avoid contentEditable’s browser-dependent HTML changes, selection problems, and messy paste behavior.
items.summary_zh: Tasfer 是一个开源网页文本编辑器，使用二维画布构建，而不是依赖 contentEditable。它支持点对点协作，且无需账户。作者采用这种方式，是为了避开 contentEditable 带来的浏览器间 HTML 行为差异、光标选择问题和粘贴内容混乱等问题。

items.title_en: Vibe Coding Keypad
items.title_zh: Vibe Coding Keypad
items.summary_en: Keychron's F4 HE 8K Vibe Coding Keypad is designed for AI-assisted workflows. Its four keys can be assigned to send prompts, accept edits, or start voice input with a single press. Shipping is scheduled to begin within two working days.
items.summary_zh: Keychron F4 HE 8K Vibe Coding Keypad 面向 AI 辅助工作流设计。它的四个按键可以分别设置为发送提示词、接受编辑或启动语音输入，一键即可执行。产品预计在两个工作日内开始发货。

items.title_en: The AI sell-off compared to well-known stock market crashes
items.title_zh: 将 AI 抛售与知名股市崩盘相比较
items.summary_en: The S&P 500 fell 4.4% on November 5, 2026, its worst day since April 2025, and stood 6% below its October 6 record. The Nasdaq had fallen 11%, while chip stocks were down 36%, comparable to their 35% decline during the COVID-19 crash. Compared with major historical market crashes, the S&P 500’s recent 6% decline is described as a mild correction.
items.summary_zh: 2026 年 11 月 5 日，标普 500 指数下跌 4.4%，创 2025 年 4 月以来最差单日表现，较 10 月 6 日的纪录高点低 6%。纳斯达克指数下跌 11%，芯片股下跌 36%，接近其在新冠疫情崩盘期间 35% 的跌幅。与历史上主要的市场崩盘相比，标普 500 最近 6% 的回落被描述为一次温和修正。

items.title_en: I Am the Reason OpenAI Is Killing Unlimited Chats
items.title_zh: 我让 OpenAI 取消了无限聊天
items.summary_en: The author describes building custom MCP integrations and using multiple ChatGPT conversations for software development. OpenAI has announced changes that will end unlimited ChatGPT chats in their previous form and merge that usage with Codex, affecting the author’s development workflow.
items.summary_zh: 作者介绍了如何构建自定义 MCP 集成，并使用多个 ChatGPT 对话进行软件开发。OpenAI 已宣布调整，将终止原有形式的无限 ChatGPT 聊天，并把相关使用量与 Codex 合并，这会影响作者的开发流程。

items.title_en: Apple reports fourth quarter results
items.title_zh: 苹果公布第四季度业绩
items.summary_en: Apple announced financial results for its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter, which ended on September 26, 2026.
items.summary_zh: 苹果公布了截至 2026 年 9 月 26 日的 2026 财年第四季度财务业绩。

items.title_en: Pilot-wave hydrodynamics (Quantum phenomena in macroscopic hydrodynamic systems)
items.title_zh: 导波流体动力学（宏观流体系统中的量子现象）
items.summary_en: Since 2005, researchers have studied droplets that bounce and walk on a vibrating fluid bath and display features reminiscent of quantum phenomena. The work develops hydrodynamic quantum analogs and theoretical links to pilot-wave dynamics associated with de Broglie. The group combines experiments, flow visualization, and theory to investigate the resulting quantum-like behavior.
items.summary_zh: 自 2005 年以来，研究人员一直在研究于振动液体表面弹跳和行走的液滴，它们会表现出类似量子现象的特征。这项工作发展了流体动力学量子类比，并建立了与德布罗意相关导波动力学的理论联系。研究团队结合实验、流动可视化和理论分析，探究由此产生的类量子行为。

items.title_en: Building a Multi-Agent System from Scratch: Architecture Patterns
items.title_zh: 从零构建多代理系统：架构模式
items.summary_en: It argues that adding agents introduces a coordination problem on top of the reasoning problem, with most production engineering effort concentrated there. Systems that work in a short demo can therefore encounter failure modes when run for months against unexpected inputs.
items.summary_zh: 文章考察了协调多个 AI 代理的编排器—工作器、黑板和流水线模式。文章指出，增加代理后，除了推理问题，还会出现协调问题，而生产环境的大部分工程工作都集中在后者上。一个能在短暂演示中运行的系统，长期面对未预期输入时可能会暴露出不同的失败模式。

items.title_en: The Gordon Gekko effect: The role of culture in the financial industry (2016) [pdf]
items.title_zh: 戈登·盖柯效应：文化在金融业中的作用（2016）
items.summary_en: The paper examines the role of culture in the financial industry under the title “The Gordon Gekko Effect.” No further findings or methods are established by the available information.
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文以“戈登·盖柯效应”为题，研究文化在金融业中的作用。现有信息未提供更多研究方法或结论。

items.title_en: PostgreSQL Internals [pdf] (2023)
items.title_zh: PostgreSQL 内部机制（2023）
items.summary_en: This is a 2023 PDF about PostgreSQL internals. No further coverage or specific topics are established by the available information.
items.summary_zh: 这是一本 2023 年出版的 PostgreSQL 内部机制 PDF。现有信息未提供更多内容或具体主题。

items.title_en: Edward Hopper's Iconic Painting, "Nighthawks
items.title_zh: 爱德华·霍普的标志性画作《夜游者》
items.summary_en: Edward Hopper began painting Nighthawks by late November 1941, and had likely completed many of its preparatory pencil and chalk sketches. The finished 1942 oil painting depicts a sparsely populated New York diner illuminated by artificial light. It measures 33 1/8 by 60 inches and is held by the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.summary_zh: 爱德华·霍普在 1941 年 11 月底前已经开始创作《夜游者》，并可能完成了许多铅笔和粉笔预备稿。这幅完成于 1942 年的油画描绘了一家被人工灯光照亮、客人寥寥的纽约餐馆。作品尺寸为 33 1/8 × 60 英寸，现藏于芝加哥艺术博物馆。

items.title_en: The Stacks Project, Formalized in Lean
items.title_zh: 用 Lean 形式化《Stacks Project》
items.summary_en: Axiom has released a Lean formalization of the entire Stacks Project, an open-source reference on modern algebraic geometry spanning roughly 7,500 pages. The development contains about 16 million lines of code and is presented as the largest integrated reusable library of formalized mathematics built so far. Its declarations are machine-checked and linked back to the corresponding canonical Stacks text.
items.summary_zh: Axiom 发布了完整《Stacks Project》的 Lean 形式化版本；这是一部约 7500 页、关于现代代数几何的开源参考资料。该形式化工程包含约 1600 万行代码，被称为目前规模最大的集成式、可复用形式化数学库。其声明经过机器检查，并链接回《Stacks Project》中对应的规范文本。

items.title_en: ChatGPT silently passes data between connectors and the bounty wants an ID card
items.title_zh: ChatGPT 在连接器之间悄悄传递数据，而漏洞悬赏要求提供身份证件
items.summary_en: With two connectors enabled, ChatGPT made a follow-up tool call through a different connector from the one that started the flow without notifying the user. The call carried a one-time confirmation code from the first connector’s widget. The setup used two connectors pointing to the same MCP server, one custom connector and one published app.
items.summary_zh: 在同时启用两个连接器时，ChatGPT 未通知用户，就通过与启动流程不同的另一个连接器发起了后续工具调用。该调用携带了第一个连接器小组件生成的一次性确认码。测试环境包含两个指向同一 MCP 服务器的连接器：一个是开发者模式下添加的自定义连接器，另一个是应用目录中的已发布应用。

items.title_en: LongCat-2.5: Native Multimodality for Agentic Tasks
items.title_zh: LongCat-2.5：面向智能体任务的原生多模态
items.summary_en: LongCat-2.5 is described as a 1.6-trillion-parameter model trained entirely on domestically produced chips.
items.summary_zh: LongCat-2.5 被描述为一款拥有 1.6 万亿参数、全程使用国产芯片训练的大模型。

items.title_en: Hardcoded credentials and other issues in Tata Motors App
items.title_zh: Tata Motors 应用存在硬编码凭据等问题
items.summary_en: The Tata Motors app has hardcoded credentials and other security issues.
items.summary_zh: Tata Motors 应用存在硬编码凭据等安全问题。

items.title_en: The great butter and cheese fire of 1991
items.title_zh: 1991 年那场巨大的黄油与奶酪火灾
items.summary_en: The subject is the great butter and cheese fire of 1991, in which more than 20 million pounds of commodities were lost.
items.summary_zh: 主题是 1991 年那场巨大的黄油与奶酪火灾，当时有超过 2000 万磅商品损失。

items.title_en: Ask HN: How did you convince family and friends to join your XMPP/Matrix server?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：你是如何说服家人和朋友加入 XMPP/Matrix 服务器的？
items.summary_en: The author asks how people persuaded family and friends to move from SMS or WhatsApp to self-hosted XMPP or Matrix messaging. Their contacts mainly value ease of use, reliability, and fun features, while the author finds many existing clients difficult to use and poorly suited as simple SMS replacements. The discussion centers on the practical and user-experience barriers to adopting open messaging protocols.
items.summary_zh: 提问者想知道，大家是如何说服家人和朋友从短信或 WhatsApp 转向自托管的 XMPP 或 Matrix 消息服务的。提问者的亲友主要看重易用性、可靠性和有趣的功能，而提问者认为许多现有客户端难用，也不适合作为简单的短信替代品。讨论的核心是开放消息协议在实际采用和用户体验方面面临的障碍。

items.title_en: UK House of Lords to propose mandatory CSAM detection software on smartphones
items.title_zh: 英国上议院将提议在智能手机上强制安装 CSAM 检测软件
items.summary_en: The proposal would require software on all smartphones and tablets in the UK to prevent users from viewing or creating illicit content.
items.summary_zh: 这项提议将要求英国所有智能手机和平板电脑安装相关软件，以阻止用户查看或创建非法内容。

items.title_en: Too Expensive to Exist
items.title_zh: 贵得无法存在
items.summary_en: The piece is titled “Too Expensive to Exist.”
items.summary_zh: 文章题为《贵得无法存在》。

items.title_en: C64 Basic Dungeon Crawler: Stairs, Levels and Levelling Up (Part 11)
items.title_zh: C64 BASIC 地牢爬行游戏：楼梯、关卡与升级（第 11 部分）
items.summary_en: This installment adds new levels and a stronger sense of progression to a dungeon game written in C64 BASIC. It presents progression as an important distinction between a short pick-up-and-play game and a game that can occupy players for much longer.
items.summary_zh: 这一期为 C64 BASIC 地牢游戏加入了新关卡和更明显的成长感。文章将成长机制视为短小即玩游戏与能让玩家长时间投入的游戏之间的重要区别。

items.title_en: Show HN: Stroq – a local audit of what your coding agent did and why
items.title_zh: Show HN：Stroq——审计编程代理做了什么以及为何这样做
items.summary_en: Stroq is an open-source local tool for inspecting Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor sessions. It identifies known secrets, counts commands derived from text an agent read, and shows which keys left the machine. Local hooks can then trace risky commands back to the content that prompted them, without telemetry.
items.summary_zh: Stroq 是一款开源本地工具，用于检查 Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor 的会话。它可以识别已知密钥，统计代理从所读取文本中产生的命令，并显示哪些密钥离开了本机。用户还可以通过本地钩子将高风险命令追溯到触发它们的内容，而且不会发送遥测数据。

items.title_en: When electric cars were for women
items.title_zh: 当电动汽车属于女性时
items.summary_en: Early carmakers believed women preferred vehicles that were quiet, clean, and easy to start, while mercury-arc rectifiers were used for charging.
items.summary_zh: 文章考察了汽车尚处于新兴阶段时的早期电动车，它们曾与蒸汽汽车和内燃机汽车竞争。早期汽车制造商认为女性偏好安静、清洁且容易启动的车辆，而电动车使用汞弧整流器充电。

items.title_en: Replit rebuilt its sandbox engine with microVMs
items.title_zh: Replit 使用 microVM 重构沙箱引擎
items.summary_en: Replit completed a rewrite of its sandbox engine using microVMs to improve isolation, capabilities, portability, and startup performance. The new engine supports the company's Bring Your Own Cloud offering across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure. Replit migrated hundreds of millions of projects without data loss while rolling out the change. The system is intended to provide stronger isolation, scalable storage, and fast startup for coding agents.
items.summary_zh: Replit 使用 microVM 重写了沙箱引擎，以提升隔离性、功能、云环境可移植性和启动速度。新引擎支持其 Bring Your Own Cloud 服务，可运行在 AWS、Google Cloud 和 Azure 环境中。Replit 在部署过程中平稳迁移了数亿个项目，没有发生数据丢失。该系统旨在为编程智能体提供更强的隔离能力、可扩展存储和快速启动。

items.title_en: The End of AI Frontiers
items.title_zh: AI Frontiers 的终结
items.summary_en: After ChatGPT’s release in 2023, John Langford and colleagues formed AI Frontiers within Microsoft Research to organize AI research more coherently. The roughly 50-person group used a middle ground between top-down and bottom-up organization, while dealing with disagreements and frequent compute bottlenecks. Langford said he believed the group was succeeding at pioneering work despite its small size, although the excerpt ends before describing its closure.
items.summary_zh: ChatGPT 于 2023 年发布后，约翰·兰福德与同事在微软研究院内部组建了 AI Frontiers，以更有组织地推进人工智能研究。这个约 50 人的团队采取介于自上而下和自下而上之间的组织方式，同时面临内部分歧和计算资源瓶颈。兰福德认为，尽管规模较小，该团队仍在开展开创性工作，但所给内容尚未说明其后续解散经过。

items.title_en: Show HN: Waymark – A workflow engine that compiles jobs instead of replaying
items.title_zh: Show HN：Waymark——编译任务而非重放任务的工作流引擎
items.summary_en: Waymark is an open-source durable execution library similar to Temporal or DBOS. It lets developers write workflows in ordinary Python code using conditionals, loops, and asyncio-style parallelism, while the runtime handles distributed execution. Rather than replaying past state in an interpreter, Waymark walks the program’s AST and compiles the logic into bytecode for a stackless virtual machine.
items.summary_zh: Waymark 是一个类似 Temporal 或 DBOS 的开源持久执行库。开发者可以用普通 Python 代码编写工作流，包括条件语句、循环和类似 asyncio 的并行操作，再由运行时负责分布式执行。Waymark 不通过解释器重放历史状态，而是遍历程序 AST，将逻辑编译为运行在无栈虚拟机上的字节码。

items.title_en: Arrows to arrows, categories to queries (2025)
items.title_zh: 从箭头到箭头，从范畴到查询（2025）
items.summary_en: The author created catlang, a small programming language inspired by category theory that compiles to SQL. Rather than being a conventional query language, it is a programming language whose compiler emits one large `SELECT` statement. Running that query in PostgreSQL produces the program’s output.
items.summary_zh: 作者创建了 catlang，这是一种受范畴论启发、可编译为 SQL 的小型编程语言。它并非传统意义上的查询语言，而是一种由编译器生成一个大型 `SELECT` 语句的编程语言。在 PostgreSQL 中运行该查询，就能得到程序的输出。

items.title_en: A 1580 Map Shows Why Data Visualization Is Never Neutral
items.title_zh: 一张 1580 年的地图说明数据可视化从来不是中立的
items.summary_en: The title uses a map from 1580 to examine why data visualization is never neutral. It does not provide further details about the map or the argument.
items.summary_zh: 标题以一张 1580 年的地图为切入点，讨论数据可视化为何从来不是中立的。标题未提供地图或论点的更多细节。

items.title_en: 8088 Domination Post-Mortem
items.title_zh: 《8088 Domination》事后复盘
items.summary_en: The write-up explains how the author created 8088 Domination, a program capable of displaying full-motion video on a 1981 IBM PC. The production runs on an IBM PC 5150 connected to a television through its composite output. It can also be downloaded and run on vintage hardware to verify the demonstration.
items.summary_zh: 这篇复盘介绍了作者如何制作《8088 Domination》，一款能够在 1981 年的 IBM PC 上播放全动态视频的程序。该作品可在通过复合视频输出连接电视的 IBM PC 5150 上运行。读者还可以下载它，在老式硬件上运行以验证演示效果。

items.title_en: WorkOS reports security breach
items.title_zh: WorkOS 报告安全漏洞事件
items.summary_en: WorkOS detected anomalous traffic to an internal business system on October 30, 2026, and says an attacker accessed an internal API used by sales and marketing tools. The API exposed data from Salesforce and Snowflake, including business contacts, account and commercial information, usage metrics, marketing contacts, and support tickets. The investigation identified evidence that the attack was likely driven by the AI-assisted autonomous penetration-testing framework ARTEX, but the available notice is truncated before stating the full impact on application data.
items.summary_zh: WorkOS 于 2026 年 10 月 30 日发现内部业务系统存在异常流量，并称攻击者进入了供销售和营销工具使用的内部 API。该 API 可访问 Salesforce 和 Snowflake 中的业务联系人、账户与商业信息、使用指标、营销联系人及支持工单等数据。调查发现证据表明，攻击可能由 AI 辅助的自主渗透测试框架 ARTEX 发起，但现有通知在说明对应用数据的完整影响前已经截断。

items.title_en: As the Japanese countryside empties out, wildlife is disappearing
items.title_zh: 随着日本乡村人口流失，野生动物也在消失
items.summary_en: Japan’s population is declining, with the decrease especially pronounced in rural areas. Although abandoned farmland might be expected to allow wildlife to return, wildlife is also disappearing in those places. The observed pattern is therefore a paradoxical decline of both people and wildlife in rural Japan.
items.summary_zh: 日本人口正在减少，农村地区的下降尤其明显。人们原本可能预期，废弃农田会让野生动物重新出现，但这些地区的野生动物也在消失。因此，日本农村呈现出人口与野生动物同时减少的矛盾趋势。

items.title_en: Size-It-Up (Game)
items.title_zh: Size-It-Up（游戏）
items.summary_en: Size It Up is a game about estimating real-world scale. Players make five daily visual comparisons and can score up to 500 points.
items.summary_zh: Size It Up 是一款估算现实世界物体尺度的游戏。玩家每天进行五次视觉比较，最高可得 500 分。

items.title_en: Commodore PET – The Worlds First Personal Computer
items.title_zh: Commodore PET——世界上第一台个人电脑
items.summary_en: The Commodore PET is presented as the world's first personal computer.
items.summary_zh: Commodore PET 被称为世界上第一台个人电脑。

items.title_en: AI text watermarking and quality loss
items.title_zh: AI 文本水印与质量损失
items.summary_en: It argues that preserving the quality of one response does not establish that the overall output distribution remains unchanged, which is more relevant to how people use these systems.
items.summary_zh: 文章考察了为响应欧盟《人工智能法案》透明度指南而引入的 AI 文本水印是否会影响输出质量。文章指出，保持单次回答的质量，并不能证明整体输出分布没有变化，而后者更符合人们实际使用这些系统的方式。

items.title_en: William Nordhaus has died
items.title_zh: 威廉·诺德豪斯去世
items.summary_en: William Nordhaus, a Yale economist who won the 2018 Nobel Prize for integrating climate change into long-run macroeconomic analysis, died on October 30 at age 85. He also held senior administrative roles at Yale, including provost and vice president for finance and administration. His work influenced economics and climate policy analysis for decades.
items.summary_zh: 耶鲁大学经济学家 William Nordhaus 于 10 月 30 日去世，享年 85 岁。他因将气候变化纳入长期宏观经济分析而获得 2018 年诺贝尔经济学奖，还曾在耶鲁担任教务长和财务与行政副校长等高级行政职务。他的研究数十年来影响了经济学和气候政策分析。

items.title_en: Much Ado About None: Sentinel Values in Python
items.title_zh: 《大惊小怪的 None》：Python 中的哨兵值
items.summary_en: The piece explains why Python’s None is often unsuitable for representing absence, because it can also mean unset, error, or a legitimate value. Sentinel values avoid this ambiguity by using a marker outside the domain of valid values. It connects the discussion to PEP 661, which makes sentinel values first-class in Python 3.15.
items.summary_zh: 文章解释了 Python 的 None 为何常常不适合表示缺失，因为它还可能表示未设置、错误或一个合法值。哨兵值通过使用有效值域之外的标记来避免这种歧义。文章还将这一讨论与 PEP 661 联系起来，该提案让哨兵值在 Python 3.15 中成为一等对象。

items.title_en: Finding Xanadu: Inside a JRPG classic translation 15 years in the making
items.title_zh: 寻找 Xanadu：一部 JRPG 经典游戏长达 15 年的翻译历程
items.summary_en: The issue includes interviews about a human-made fan translation of a classic JRPG that took 15 years to complete. It also features interviews about two additional human-made fan translations.
items.summary_zh: 这期内容收录了一部经典 JRPG 粉丝翻译项目的访谈，该项目历时 15 年完成。内容还包括另外两个由人类完成的粉丝翻译项目访谈。

items.title_en: Cloudflare experiencing multiple active incidents
items.title_zh: Cloudflare 出现多起活跃事故
items.summary_en: The status page currently says that no issues affecting Cloudflare services are known. It provides real-time service status, incident history, and scheduled-maintenance information.
items.summary_zh: 状态页面目前表示，尚未发现影响 Cloudflare 服务的问题。该页面提供服务实时状态、事故历史和计划维护信息。

items.title_en: Moment of Ruby: An Argument for Nothing
items.title_zh: Ruby 时刻：为“无参数”辩护
items.summary_en: The piece presents a Ruby technique for methods that act as both getters and setters. Passing a value updates a setting, while passing nothing reads it. The author describes the pattern as small and useful.
items.summary_zh: 文章介绍了一种 Ruby 技巧：让同一个方法同时充当 getter 和 setter。传入值即可更新设置，不传参数则读取设置。作者认为这种模式简单而实用。

items.title_en: Kirlian Photography: Building Your Own Equipment
items.title_zh: 克里安摄影：自己制作设备
items.summary_en: Kirlian photography is a form of high-voltage contact-print photography. It is named after Semyon Davidovich Kirlian and Valentina Kirlian, who began working on high-voltage photography in 1939. The couple collaborated for more than 30 years on equipment development and electro-photography research.
items.summary_zh: 克里安摄影是一种高压接触式印相摄影。它以谢苗·达维多维奇·克里安和瓦莲京娜·克里安夫妇命名，两人于 1939 年开始研究高压摄影。这对夫妇合作了 30 多年，持续开发设备并研究电摄影技术。

items.title_en: Frustrated Ranchers Want People to Quit 'Rescuing' Their Working Guardian Dogs
items.title_zh: 牧场主恼火：请别再“救走”他们的工作护卫犬
items.summary_en: People who mistake livestock guardian dogs for strays in rural pastures have been taking them to animal shelters. Wyoming ranchers say the problem is growing. One affected dog, Faith, is an Akbash whose job was to protect a rancher’s sheep from predators.
items.summary_zh: 一些人误把农村牧场中的牲畜护卫犬当成流浪狗，并将它们带到动物收容所。怀俄明州牧场主表示，这一问题正在加剧。受到影响的狗 Faith 是一只阿克巴什犬，职责是保护牧场主的羊群免受捕食者侵害。

items.title_en: Future Maintenance of Mbed TLS
items.title_zh: Mbed TLS 的未来维护
items.summary_en: The Mbed TLS project is preparing to transition the maintenance of its TLS and X.509 libraries. Existing maintainers will continue developing and maintaining TF-PSA-Crypto, which remains an actively maintained part of the project.
items.summary_zh: Mbed TLS 项目正准备转变 TLS 和 X.509 库的维护安排。现有维护者将继续开发和维护 TF-PSA-Crypto，该组件仍会保持积极维护。

items.title_en: Mizu – zero-copy parallel R and Python over shared memory
items.title_zh: Mizu：通过共享内存实现 R 与 Python 的零拷贝并行
items.summary_en: Mizu provides thread-speed asynchronous and parallel execution for Python over shared memory. Its benchmarks report reducing task round trips from roughly 100 microseconds over sockets to less than 1 microsecond. Lists, dictionaries, NumPy arrays, and Arrow tables can be shared between Python and R as zero-copy views.
items.summary_zh: Mizu 通过共享内存为 Python 提供接近线程速度的异步和并行执行能力。其基准测试称，任务往返时间可从基于套接字的约 100 微秒降至不到 1 微秒。列表、字典、NumPy 数组和 Arrow 表都可以作为零拷贝视图在 Python 与 R 之间共享。

items.title_en: A brief history of just-in-time: forty years of JIT work, from 1960–2000
items.title_zh: 即时生产的简史：1960—2000 年四十年的 JIT 工作
items.summary_en: The piece provides a forty-year history of just-in-time work from 1960 to 2000. The title identifies the period and subject but gives no further historical details.
items.summary_zh: 文章回顾了 1960 年至 2000 年间、持续四十年的即时生产工作史。标题未提供更多历史细节。

items.title_en: Ask HN: What cryptography book do you recommend for reading with 10 year olds?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：推荐与 10 岁孩子一起阅读的密码学书籍？
items.summary_en: A parent is looking for a cryptography book to read with a 10-year-old who enjoys inventing ciphers and reading adult math and science books. They want more than puzzle books: ideally, a history of cryptography combined with basic theory that is not too mathematically demanding.
items.summary_zh: 一位家长正在寻找适合与 10 岁孩子一起阅读的密码学书籍。孩子喜欢自己发明密码，也喜欢阅读成人数学和科学读物。家长希望书籍不只是谜题合集，而是能结合密码学历史与基础理论，同时避免数学难度过高。

items.title_en: GPT-Rosalind-6 System Card Addendum
items.title_zh: GPT-Rosalind-6 系统卡附录
items.summary_en: GPT-Rosalind-6 is described as a frontier reasoning model for biology, drug discovery, and translational medicine. It is available only to qualified users through trusted access, with applications, security controls, and governance practices reviewed before approval. The model shares weights with GPT-6 Astra, supports some dual-use biological research, and continues to refuse biological-weaponization requests.
items.summary_zh: GPT-Rosalind-6 被描述为面向生物学、药物发现和转化医学的前沿推理模型。它仅通过受信访问向合格用户提供，申请用途、安全控制和治理措施会在批准前接受审查。该模型与 GPT-6 Astra 使用相同权重，支持部分双重用途生物研究，但仍拒绝生物武器化请求。

items.title_en: Nyquist Limit:The frequency of changes in tech is invalidating our understanding
items.title_zh: 奈奎斯特极限：技术变化的频率正在使我们失去理解能力
items.summary_en: The piece argues that product teams are using LLMs to increase the rate of technological change beyond the pace at which people can understand and evaluate systems. It compares human decision-making to a sampling process and says that, near the limit, teams may mistake noise for meaningful signals, contributing to costly unanticipated outages. The proposed remedy is to choose a change frequency that allows systems to be sampled at more than twice that rate.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，产品团队正借助 LLM 提高技术变化速度，使其超过人们理解和评估系统的能力。文章将人的决策过程比作采样过程，并称在接近极限时，团队可能把噪声误认为有效信号，从而导致代价高昂且无法预警的故障。文章提出的解决办法是设定合适的系统变更频率，使人们能够以超过该频率两倍的速度进行采样。

items.title_en: How to prove equations using diagrams, part 1
items.title_zh: 如何用图解证明方程，第一部分
items.summary_en: The post introduces e-graphs, data structures that maintain a congruence relation over expression trees. It traces their origins to work by Nelson and Oppen in 1980 and notes renewed interest after the egg software demonstrated that e-graphs combined with equality saturation can support fast, adaptable equational reasoning. The author describes using egglog, egg's successor, to reason about finitely presented categories in CatColab.
items.summary_zh: 文章介绍了 e-graph，这是一种在表达式树上维护同余关系的数据结构。文章提到，e-graph 最早源于 Nelson 和 Oppen 1980 年的工作，后来 egg 软件展示了 e-graph 与等式饱和结合后可用于快速且灵活的等式推理，因而重新受到关注。作者还介绍了如何在 CatColab 中使用 egg 的后继项目 egglog，研究有限表示范畴。

items.title_en: Show HN: I built a little browser game to practice Vim commands
items.title_zh: Show HN：我做了一个练习 Vim 命令的小型浏览器游戏
items.summary_en: The browser game hjkl is designed to help players remember Vim commands while relaxing. The creator says more commands are planned for future additions.
items.summary_zh: 浏览器游戏 hjkl 旨在让玩家在放松时练习并记住 Vim 命令。作者表示，未来还计划加入更多命令。

items.title_en: Lippitt-Knoster in Practice (Field Notes for Managing Complex Projects)
items.title_zh: 实践 Lippitt-Knoster 模型：复杂项目管理现场笔记
items.summary_en: The piece presents the Lippitt-Knoster model as a framework for managing complex projects. The author says the model has been referenced in their work for the past decade and published the field notes on November 6, 2026.
items.summary_zh: 文章介绍了用于管理复杂项目的 Lippitt-Knoster 模型。作者表示，过去十年间自己一直在工作中提到这一模型，并于 2026 年 11 月 6 日发布了这份实践笔记。

items.title_en: A Critique of GPUI
items.title_zh: 对 GPUI 的批评
items.summary_en: The author questions whether GPUI and egui are suitable foundations for complex native desktop applications. GPUI is being used for an official rewrite of Discord, while many LLM-based applications appear to choose egui. Although the author praises projects such as Zed and uses egui for game debugging interfaces, they argue that both frameworks’ state models are a poor default for complex desktop software.
items.summary_zh: 作者质疑 GPUI 和 egui 是否适合用作复杂原生桌面应用的基础。Discord 正在使用 GPUI 重写其应用，而许多基于大语言模型的应用似乎选择了 egui。作者认可 Zed 等项目的表现，也在游戏调试界面中使用 egui，但认为这两个框架的状态模型不应成为复杂桌面软件的默认选择。

items.title_en: Enlightenment 0.28.0 Release
items.title_zh: Enlightenment 0.28.0 发布
items.summary_en: Enlightenment 0.28.0 is the latest release of the Enlightenment desktop environment. The release notes recommend installing several components for proper functionality, though the system can operate without them.
items.summary_zh: Enlightenment 0.28.0 是 Enlightenment 桌面环境的最新版本。发行说明建议安装若干组件以确保功能正常，但即使没有这些组件系统也可以运行。

items.title_en: Closed AI models dominate the price-performance frontier
items.title_zh: 闭源 AI 模型主导性价比前沿
items.summary_en: An analysis of the AI price-performance frontier finds that closed models are now the best buy at nearly every budget level. Open-weight models win at only 3% of price points, down from 41% in June. Recent closed releases have become both cheaper and stronger, leaving open models competitive mainly at the very bottom of the price range.
items.summary_zh: 一项对 AI 性价比前沿的分析发现，如今几乎所有预算档位中，闭源模型都是最值得购买的选择。开放权重模型仅在 3% 的价格点上胜出，低于 6 月的 41%。近期闭源模型同时变得更便宜、更强，使开放模型主要只在价格区间最底部保持竞争力。

items.title_en: No Vehicles in the Park
items.title_zh: 公园内禁止车辆
items.summary_en: This is a language-and-rules game consisting of 27 questions. Players can skip to the end after completing the first seven questions, where they receive a comparison of their results with those of other players and an explanation of the game's design.
items.summary_zh: 这是一款围绕语言和规则设计的游戏，共有 27 道题。完成前七题后，玩家可以直接跳到结尾；结尾会比较玩家与其他人的成绩，并解释游戏的设计思路。

items.title_en: GeoWorks, Microsoft Windows' Upstart '90s Competitor (2016)
items.title_zh: GeoWorks：微软 Windows 在 90 年代的后起竞争者
items.summary_en: GeoWorks was a 1990s upstart competitor to Microsoft Windows, with AOL also involved.
items.summary_zh: GeoWorks 是 20 世纪 90 年代挑战微软 Windows 的新兴竞争者，AOL 也参与其中。

items.title_en: The typo generation is damaging literature
items.title_zh: 错别字一代正在损害文学
items.summary_en: The discussion concerns Percival Everett’s The Trees and the problem of errors in contemporary books. One response agrees that frustrating typos are common in modern publishing but disputes claims about how certain literary passages should be interpreted. The response specifically questions treating invented lynching victims with real names and a broadcast transcript as straightforward mistakes.
items.summary_zh: 这场讨论围绕珀西瓦尔·埃弗里特的《树》和当代书籍中的错误展开。一位回应者同意现代出版物中令人困扰的错别字很常见，但不同意对某些文学段落的解读。回应特别质疑把使用真实姓名的虚构私刑受害者，以及一段广播文字稿，直接视为错误的说法。

items.title_en: Death Comes for XSLT
items.title_zh: XSLT 走向终结
items.summary_en: The post argues that XSLT is being targeted for removal as a web standard. It says Google decided to remove XSLT and that other browser vendors followed its lead. The author responds with a declaration opposing the deprecation and removal of XSLT from Google Chrome.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，XSLT 这一 Web 标准正面临被移除的命运。文中称 Google 决定移除 XSLT，其他浏览器厂商也随之采取类似行动。作者则发表声明，反对在 Google Chrome 中弃用并移除 XSLT。

items.title_en: Ozempic-style drugs now in trials for heart failure, addiction and even aging
items.title_zh: 类似 Ozempic 的药物如今进入心力衰竭、成瘾乃至衰老研究试验
items.summary_en: Ozempic-style drugs are being tested in human trials for heart failure, addiction, Alzheimer's disease, and aging in addition to diabetes and weight loss. The share of trials outside the traditional uses has roughly tripled over the past 15 years. About five in six trials still concern diabetes and weight, but research in other areas is growing rapidly.
items.summary_zh: 除了糖尿病和减重之外，类似 Ozempic 的药物如今也进入了心力衰竭、成瘾、阿尔茨海默病和衰老研究的人体试验。过去 15 年间，传统用途之外的相关试验占比大约增长了三倍。约六分之五的试验仍集中于糖尿病和体重问题，但其他领域的研究正在快速增加。

items.title_en: MTG-I2 First Images
items.title_zh: MTG-I2 首批图像
items.summary_en: EUMETSAT released the first image from the Flexible Combined Imager aboard the MTG-I2 satellite, launched on August 27, 2026. The satellite is designed to provide high-resolution observations of Europe every 2.5 minutes. This frequent coverage is intended to help forecasters track rapidly developing severe weather and issue earlier, more precise warnings.
items.summary_zh: 欧洲气象卫星组织发布了 MTG-I2 卫星搭载的灵活组合成像仪拍摄的首张图像；该卫星于 2026 年 8 月 27 日发射。卫星计划每 2.5 分钟提供一次欧洲高分辨率观测。这种高频覆盖有助于预报员追踪快速发展的恶劣天气，并更早、更准确地发布预警。

items.title_en: How to Lie With Statistics (1954)
items.title_zh: 《如何用统计学撒谎》（1954 年）[PDF]
items.summary_en: “How to Lie With Statistics” is a 1954 book available as a PDF. Its title indicates a focus on misleading uses or interpretations of statistics.
items.summary_zh: 《如何用统计学撒谎》是一本 1954 年出版、现以 PDF 形式提供的书。书名表明其主题是统计数据的误导性使用或解读。

items.title_en: Show HN: We compressed a 31B video+audio diffusion model to 14B, 6 steps, INT8
items.title_zh: Show HN：将 31B 视频音频扩散模型压缩至 14B、6 步、INT8
items.summary_en: HyperFlow H3 Flash is a compressed, few-step version of MiniMax-H3 with 13.7 billion parameters. It generates video and synchronized stereo audio together and supports INT8 and GGUF formats. The project also provides weights, ComfyUI nodes, a GGUF setup guide, and an eight-step LoRA for the full-size model.
items.summary_zh: HyperFlow H3 Flash 是 MiniMax-H3 的压缩少步数版本，包含 137 亿个参数。它能够同时生成视频和同步立体声，并支持 INT8 与 GGUF 格式。项目还提供模型权重、ComfyUI 节点、GGUF 配置指南，以及适用于完整模型的 8 步 LoRA。

items.title_en: Quadrillion-parameter transformers and how to train them
items.title_zh: 万亿参数 Transformer 及其训练方法
items.summary_en: The research extrapolates a scaling law to 5 trillion tokens and estimates that a model trained at 10^29 FLOPs would require roughly 7,000 times Chinchilla's parameter count. It also reports that larger models trained repeatedly on the same data require substantially more weight decay. The proposed hyperparameter law remains near-optimal at 16 times the fitted compute.
items.summary_zh: 这项研究将一项扩展规律外推至 5 万亿个 token，估计在 10^29 FLOPs 的训练规模下，模型所需参数量约为 Chinchilla 方案的 7,000 倍。研究还指出，在相同数据上重复训练更大的模型时，需要显著提高权重衰减。其提出的超参数规律在达到拟合计算量 16 倍时仍接近最优。

items.title_en: Google has acquired Crusoe's data center site in southeast Wyoming
items.title_zh: Google 收购 Crusoe 位于怀俄明州东南部的数据中心项目用地
items.summary_en: Google acquired Crusoe’s data center site in southeast Wyoming after Crusoe completed site selection, government approvals, and a hybrid power strategy with Tallgrass Energy. The transaction ends Crusoe’s pre-development work on the Wyoming project. The site was announced as acquired on November 6, 2026.
items.summary_zh: 在 Crusoe 完成选址、政府审批以及与 Tallgrass Energy 共同制定的混合供电方案后，Google 收购了其位于怀俄明州东南部的数据中心项目用地。这笔交易结束了 Crusoe 在该项目上的前期开发工作。该项目于 2026 年 11 月 6 日宣布完成收购。

items.title_en: Paraguay bank collapses with half of population's savings
items.title_zh: 巴拉圭银行倒闭，涉及全国一半人口的储蓄
items.summary_en: Protests have erupted across Paraguay after Ueno Bank was shut down overnight during a solvency crisis. Customers were left unable to access their money. An estimated 60% of Paraguay's adult population banks with Ueno.
items.summary_zh: Ueno Bank 因偿付能力危机在夜间被关闭后，巴拉圭各地爆发抗议。客户无法取用自己的资金。据估计，巴拉圭约 60% 的成年人口在 Ueno Bank 开户。

items.title_en: British Library Legal deposit and web archiving
items.title_zh: 英国图书馆的法定缴存与网络存档
items.summary_en: The British Library and other legal deposit libraries are legally entitled to copy UK-published material from the internet for archival purposes. The page explains how they identify UK websites and describes the restrictions that apply to legal-deposit web archiving. The framework extends legal deposit practices to online material.
items.summary_zh: 大英图书馆及其他法定缴存图书馆依法有权复制互联网上在英国出版的材料，用于存档。该页面说明了它们如何识别英国网站，以及网络法定缴存存档所受的限制。这套制度将法定缴存实践延伸到了在线材料。

items.title_en: Outbound SIP calling is now available to all organizations
items.title_zh: 出站 SIP 呼叫现已向所有组织开放
items.summary_en: Organizations can connect incoming and outgoing phone calls to GPT-Live through a SIP trunk. The phone provider exchanges call audio with OpenAI, while the organization’s backend handles session configuration, call controls, and business logic. SIP signaling uses TLS, and GPT-Live requires SRTP for audio.
items.summary_zh: 组织现在可以通过 SIP 中继，将呼入和呼出电话连接到 GPT-Live。电话服务商负责与 OpenAI 交换通话音频，而组织的后端负责会话配置、通话控制和业务逻辑。SIP 信令使用 TLS，GPT-Live 的音频则要求使用 SRTP。

items.title_en: How octopuses squeeze through too small gaps
items.title_zh: 章鱼如何挤过过小的缝隙
items.summary_en: The project provides a research paper and videos about how octopuses squeeze through gaps that appear too small for them.
items.summary_zh: 该项目提供了一篇研究论文和相关视频，介绍章鱼如何挤过看似小于自身尺寸的缝隙。

items.title_en: Altera Announces Agilex 2X, a Complete FPGA and SoC Portfolio
items.title_zh: Altera 宣布 Agilex 2X：完整的 FPGA 与 SoC 产品组合
items.summary_en: Altera has announced Agilex 2X, described as a complete FPGA and SoC portfolio.
items.summary_zh: Altera 宣布了 Agilex 2X，并将其称为完整的 FPGA 与 SoC 产品组合。

items.title_en: Amsterdam School
items.title_zh: 阿姆斯特丹学派
items.summary_en: The Amsterdam School emerged from Eduard Cuypers's atelier during the first decade of the 20th century. Its future leaders included Michel de Klerk, Johann Melchior van der Mey, and Pieter Lodewijk Kramer. The movement combined elements of Jugendstil, Arts and Crafts, Belgian Art Nouveau, 17th-century Dutch architecture, and Indonesian art.
items.summary_zh: 阿姆斯特丹学派于 20 世纪第一个十年从爱德华·柯伊佩斯的工作室中发展起来。其未来的代表人物包括米歇尔·德·克勒克、约翰·梅尔希奥·范·德·梅和彼得·洛德韦克·克拉默。该流派融合了青年风格、工艺美术运动、比利时新艺术、17 世纪荷兰建筑和印度尼西亚艺术等元素。

items.title_en: From Charlemagne to the Kitchen Boy: Reading the Hamburg Rathaus
items.title_zh: 从查理曼大帝到厨房男孩：阅读汉堡市政厅
items.summary_en: One example is its turquoise roof: the roof is made of copper, whose reaction with oxygen, water, and carbon dioxide gradually forms a green patina.
items.summary_zh: 文章通过一百多个细节，讲述汉堡市政厅如何呈现这座城市的历史。其中一个例子是它的蓝绿色屋顶：屋顶由铜制成，铜与空气中的氧气、水和二氧化碳发生反应，经过多年逐渐形成绿色的铜锈。

items.title_en: Wir müssen wissen – wir werden wissen
items.title_zh: 我们必须知道——我们必将知道
items.summary_en: The essay recounts how paradoxes such as Russell's paradox triggered a foundational crisis in mathematics. Hilbert sought a complete and consistent axiomatic foundation, but Gödel's incompleteness theorems showed that no complete, consistent, self-supporting system of mathematics can exist. The title quotes Hilbert's declaration, “We must know—we will know.”
items.summary_zh: 文章回顾了罗素悖论等悖论如何引发数学基础危机。希尔伯特曾试图建立完备且一致的公理体系，但哥德尔不完备定理表明，不可能存在一个完备、一致且自我支撑的数学体系。标题引用了希尔伯特的宣言：“我们必须知道——我们必将知道。”

items.title_en: Muse AI agent is a commercial surveillance network disguised as an AI assistant
items.title_zh: Muse AI 智能体是伪装成 AI 助手的商业监控网络
items.summary_en: The title characterizes the Muse AI agent as a commercial surveillance network disguised as an AI assistant. It does not provide details about the alleged surveillance mechanisms or evidence.
items.summary_zh: 标题将 Muse AI 智能体描述为伪装成 AI 助手的商业监控网络。标题未提供相关监控机制或证据的细节。

items.title_en: Parchment Paper History: How We Got Paper Perfect for Baking (2019)
items.title_zh: 烘焙纸的历史：我们如何得到完美的烘焙用纸（2019）
items.summary_en: The piece traces the origins of parchment paper and explains how it became a common baking aid. The supplied text provides the article’s subject but not its historical details.
items.summary_zh: 文章追溯烘焙纸的起源，并解释它如何成为常见的烘焙辅助用品。现有内容只说明了文章主题，未提供更多历史细节。

items.title_en: Perplexity launches AI agents for work
items.title_zh: Perplexity 推出面向工作的 AI agents
items.summary_en: Perplexity introduced AI teammates designed to coordinate agents, manage ongoing projects, and follow through on tasks in areas such as operations and marketing. The company says its earlier web-capable assistant supported personal tasks including restaurant bookings and shopping. It now positions Perplexity Computer as a platform for serious work by individuals and companies. The new agents are intended to be purpose-built for workplace tasks.
items.summary_zh: Perplexity 推出了 AI teammate，用于协调多个智能体、管理持续进行的项目，并完成运营和营销等领域的任务。该公司表示，其此前具备联网能力的助手已支持预订餐厅、购物等个人事务。如今，Perplexity 将 Computer 定位为个人和企业开展正式工作的工具。新推出的智能体则专门面向工作场景设计。

items.title_en: Scriptable GeoDNS: Leaving AWS for Bunny
items.title_zh: 可编程 GeoDNS：从 AWS 迁移到 Bunny
items.summary_en: The author moved a blog from Amazon CloudFront and Route 53 to Bunny, using JavaScript executed for each DNS query to direct visitors to nearby servers. Route 53's zone, geolocation-query, health-check, and DNSSEC key costs were a significant reason for the change. Bunny DNS offered scriptable responses and was nearly free for up to 500 domains. The migration was uneventful, with separate CDN caching configured for AVIF and WebP images.
items.summary_zh: 作者将博客从 Amazon CloudFront 和 Route 53 迁移到 Bunny，并通过在每次 DNS 查询时执行 JavaScript，将访问者导向附近的服务器。Route 53 的区域、地理位置查询、健康检查以及 DNSSEC 密钥费用，是促成迁移的重要原因。Bunny DNS 支持可编程响应，并且最多 500 个域名时几乎免费。迁移过程顺利，同时为 AVIF 和 WebP 图片分别配置了 CDN 缓存。

items.title_en: Building the NBC News Big Board
items.title_zh: 构建 NBC News 的选举“大看板”
items.summary_en: The NBC News Big Board began as a touchscreen prototype for exploring county-level election results and later became the on-air display used by Steve Kornacki. Michael Small and the author built it with NBC News Digital’s product and technology teams for live broadcasts watched by about 10 million people. The system had to support last-minute scorecard filters while leaving no room for errors during live election coverage.
items.summary_zh: NBC News 的选举“大看板”最初是一个用于浏览县级选举结果的触摸屏原型，后来成为 Steve Kornacki 在节目中使用的直播显示系统。作者与 Michael Small 及 NBC News Digital 的产品和技术团队共同完成了它，直播时约有 1000 万人观看。系统还必须支持临时添加计分卡筛选条件，同时在选举直播中几乎不能出错。

items.title_en: Show HN: Spindle – a full-featured, type-safe web framework for OCaml 5
items.title_zh: Show HN：Spindle，面向 OCaml 5 的全功能类型安全 Web 框架
items.summary_en: Spindle is a multicore-by-design, Eio-native web framework for OCaml that uses a type-driven API to derive codecs, request validation, OpenAPI specifications, and frontend schemas. It includes an RFC-strict HTTP server, WebSockets, SSE, MCP server primitives, tracing, metrics, and logging. Its benchmarks report performance two times faster than NestJS and five times faster than FastAPI on a single core, although speed was not the project’s primary goal.
items.summary_zh: Spindle 是一个面向多核设计、原生支持 Eio 的 OCaml Web 框架，通过类型驱动的 API 自动生成编解码器、请求验证、OpenAPI 规范和前端模式。它包含严格遵循 RFC 的 HTTP 服务器、WebSocket、SSE、MCP 服务器基础组件，以及分布式追踪、指标和日志功能。基准测试显示，它在单核上运行速度约为 NestJS 的两倍、FastAPI 的五倍，不过速度并非项目的首要目标。

items.title_en: Show HN: BBRouter – Ben Eater's 8-bit computer, simulated on 3D breadboards
items.title_zh: Show HN：BBRouter——在 3D 面包板上模拟 Ben Eater 的 8 位计算机
items.summary_en: BBRouter is a realistic virtual breadboard editor for building and debugging Ben Eater’s 8-bit computer. It offers side-by-side diffs, scopes, synchronized schematics, auto-routing, Arduino IDE uploads, and MCP connections to AI assistants. Users can inspect the simulated SAP-1, probe circuits, slow the clock, and follow instructions to build the real hardware.
items.summary_zh: BBRouter 是一个逼真的虚拟面包板编辑器，用于搭建和调试 Ben Eater 的 8 位计算机。它提供并排差异比较、示波器、同步原理图、自动布线、Arduino IDE 上传以及与 AI 助手的 MCP 连接。用户可以检查模拟的 SAP-1、探测电路、降低时钟速度，并按照说明搭建真实硬件。

items.title_en: Keeping Up Appearances – The women taking over the funeral industry
items.title_zh: 维持体面：正在接管殡葬业的女性
items.summary_en: It is presented as a preview of an issue of the LARB Quarterly focused on the theme of “Scene.”
items.summary_zh: 文章考察了正在接管殡葬业部分领域的女性。它是以“Scene”为主题的《LARB Quarterly》一期内容的预览。

items.title_en: RTX 5090 Street Prices Top $9k as Nvidia GPU Costs Climb
items.title_zh: RTX 5090 市场价突破 9000 美元，英伟达 GPU 成本攀升
items.summary_en: Street prices for Nvidia’s RTX 5090 have risen above $9,000 as Nvidia GPU costs climb.
items.summary_zh: 随着英伟达 GPU 成本上升，RTX 5090 的市场价格已突破 9000 美元。

items.title_en: Playing with the STM32MP2
items.title_zh: 折腾 STM32MP2
items.summary_en: The author describes a long-delayed project involving the STM32MP2 and explains that publication was partly held back after they discovered a silicon bug with security implications. The work builds on the author’s experience pairing STM32 microcontrollers with FPGAs, but notes that the STM32H7 FMC requires more than 30 pins for extensive chip-select and address-line use. Those pins are spread around the package, making the design difficult.
items.summary_zh: 作者介绍了一个拖延已久的 STM32MP2 项目，并表示在发现一个具有安全影响的芯片缺陷后，部分内容必须暂缓发布。该项目延续了作者将 STM32 微控制器与 FPGA 配合使用的经验，但作者指出，STM32H7 的 FMC 在使用多组片选和地址线时需要 30 多个引脚。这些引脚分散在封装各处，增加了设计难度。

items.title_en: Drones built to look like birds evaded detection at Air Force tech exercise
items.title_zh: 仿鸟无人机在空军技术演习中躲过探测
items.summary_en: A flapping-wing drone from U.S.-based Ornadyne evaded sensor detection during a recent Air Force technology exercise in the Mojave Desert. The company's small O1 ornithopter uses bird-like wing movements instead of propellers and is designed to resemble birds found in different regions. It is intended for low-altitude intelligence collection and area surveys.
items.summary_zh: 美国 Ornadyne 公司研发的一款扑翼无人机在莫哈韦沙漠举行的一次空军技术演习中躲过了传感器探测。该公司的小型 O1 扑翼机不使用螺旋桨，而是通过类似鸟类的振翅方式飞行，并被设计成类似不同地区常见的鸟类。它面向低空情报收集和区域侦察任务。

items.title_en: Sculpture re-creates odd optical effects of famed Lycurgus Cup
items.title_zh: 雕塑重现著名 Lycurgus Cup 的奇异光学效果
items.summary_en: Researchers at the University of Sheffield recreated the recipe for the 1,600-year-old Lycurgus Cup in a modern glass sculpture. Like the original dichroic glass, the sculpture appears green when lit from the front and deep red when lit from behind. The color shift results from gold and silver nanoparticles in the glass, which alter how electrons respond to light.
items.summary_zh: 谢菲尔德大学研究人员重现了有 1600 年历史的 Lycurgus Cup 的玻璃配方，并制作出现代玻璃雕塑。与原始二向色玻璃一样，雕塑从正面照明时呈绿色，从背面照明时呈深红色。颜色变化源于玻璃中的金银纳米颗粒，它们改变了电子对光的响应方式。

items.title_en: Edgar Allan Poe, Quintessential American Writer
items.title_zh: 埃德加·爱伦·坡：典型的美国作家
items.summary_en: The piece argues that Edgar Allan Poe deserves consideration as the quintessential American writer, despite more commonly cited names such as Mark Twain and Toni Morrison. It notes that Poe may be more highly revered abroad than in the United States and cites one ranking that placed him first among American writers.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，尽管人们更常提到马克·吐温和托妮·莫里森等作家，埃德加·爱伦·坡仍应被视为典型的美国作家。文章指出，坡在海外可能比在美国本土更受推崇，并引用了一份将他列为美国作家第一名的排名。

items.title_en: ZapFast: A fast, native WhatsApp client in Rust and egui
items.title_zh: ZapFast：使用 Rust 和 egui 构建的快速原生 WhatsApp 客户端
items.summary_en: ZapFast is a lightweight, native WhatsApp client written in Rust with an egui interface. It is designed to run on Linux, macOS, and Windows. The project provides downloads, setup instructions, a user guide, and contribution information.
items.summary_zh: ZapFast 是一款使用 Rust 编写、基于 egui 界面的轻量级原生 WhatsApp 客户端。它面向 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 平台。项目提供下载、安装说明、用户指南和参与贡献的方式。

items.title_en: Yes, You Can Pass a Nuclear Missile Driving on Interstate 80 Through Wyoming
items.title_zh: 是的，你可以驾驶汽车沿怀俄明州 80 号州际公路运送核导弹
items.summary_en: Military-escorted semitrailers traveling on Interstate 80 through Wyoming may carry nuclear missiles. Driver Roberto Figueroa became curious after seeing a uniquely shaped trailer accompanied by armored vehicles and helicopters near Burns. The convoy's appearance prompted questions about what was being transported.
items.summary_zh: 在怀俄明州 80 号州际公路上行驶、由军方护送的半挂车可能运输核导弹。司机 Roberto Figueroa 在 Burns 附近看到一辆外形独特的拖车，周围还有装甲车和头顶的直升机，因此产生了疑问。这支车队的外观引发了人们对其运输内容的猜测。

items.title_en: Turning every radio into a radar
items.title_zh: 让每台收音机都变成雷达
items.summary_en: The project aims to turn any radio into a radar.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目旨在把任何收音机变成雷达。

items.title_en: Vathographs: Photographic depth maps as creative expression
items.title_zh: Vathographs：以摄影深度图作为创作表达
items.summary_en: Vathography is an art practice that turns the depth estimated from a photograph into an artwork. A diffusion transformer infers the relative distance of every point in a scene from a single image, translating the photograph's visual data into volume rather than documentary imagery. The work was inspired by Marigold V2's ability to produce detailed component maps suitable for high-resolution art.
items.summary_zh: Vathography 是一种将照片估算出的深度转化为艺术作品的创作实践。扩散 Transformer 根据单张图像推断场景中每个点的相对距离，把照片数据转译为体积和形态，而不再保留其作为纪实照片的性质。Marigold V2 能生成足够细致、适合高分辨率创作的分层图像，促成了这一探索。

items.title_en: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
items.title_zh: GPT-6 Cyber：推进对齐型网络安全代理的前沿
items.summary_en: OpenAI has introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity model designed to find and validate exploitable vulnerabilities while staying within authorized scope. Compared with GPT-5.6 Cyber, it reportedly improves ExploitGym performance by 51% and shows a step-function improvement in scope adherence. It is already being used to uncover and validate thousands of exploits in security-critical codebases including Linux and Firefox.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出了 GPT-6 Cyber，这是一款旨在发现并验证可利用漏洞、同时遵守授权范围的网络安全模型。与 GPT-5.6 Cyber 相比，该模型在 ExploitGym 上的表现提升了 51%，在遵守任务范围方面也实现了阶跃式改进。据称，它已经用于在 Linux 和 Firefox 等安全关键代码库中发现并验证数千个漏洞利用。

items.title_en: One of Google's Android partners turned 1.3M set-top boxes into a botnet
items.title_zh: 谷歌一名 Android 合作伙伴将 130 万台机顶盒变成僵尸网络
items.summary_en: Google says it dismantled a backdoor operated by one of its manufacturing partners. The backdoor was used to create a botnet containing 1.3 million Android TV devices, and Google says the manufacturer intentionally hijacked the devices with malware.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌称，其已拆除一家制造合作伙伴植入的后门。该后门被用于组建包含 130 万台 Android TV 设备的僵尸网络；谷歌表示，这家制造商是有意通过恶意软件劫持这些设备。

items.title_en: Nordstjernen, Northstar, Southstar: minimalist webbrowsers in C and Rust
items.title_zh: Nordstjernen、Northstar、Southstar：用 C 和 Rust 编写的极简浏览器
items.summary_en: Nordstjernen is a web browser written from scratch in C, with a focus on HTML and CSS support. It runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux, with additional builds for Android, FreeBSD, NetBSD, and the JVM. Its 1.0.40 release adds Shared Web Workers, ElementInternals, real popups, hardware video decoding, an optional memory-safe Rust IPC parser, and several security fixes.
items.summary_zh: Nordstjernen 是一款从零开始用 C 编写、专注于 HTML 和 CSS 支持的浏览器。它运行于 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，并提供 Android、FreeBSD、NetBSD 及 JVM 构建版本。1.0.40 版本加入了 Shared Web Workers、ElementInternals、真正的弹出窗口、硬件视频解码、可选的内存安全 Rust IPC 解析器，以及多项安全修复。

items.title_en: Apple capped engineers at a $200 daily AI budget
items.title_zh: 苹果将工程师的每日 AI 预算上限设为 200 美元
items.summary_en: Apple is reportedly rationing computing resources for its own engineers, with a daily AI budget capped at $200. The measure applies to the company’s builders, though the available context does not specify how the cap is enforced or what prompted it. It indicates that even large technology companies are managing access to costly AI compute.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，苹果正在限制自家工程师使用的计算资源，将每日 AI 预算上限设为 200 美元。现有信息没有说明这一上限如何执行，也未说明其具体原因。这表明即使是大型科技公司，也在管理成本高昂的 AI 算力使用。

items.title_en: NetBSD 11.1
items.title_zh: NetBSD 11.1
items.summary_en: NetBSD 11.1 is available for download for platforms including amd64, i386, sparc64, macppc, RISC-V, MIPS-based Cavium Octeon devices, Nintendo Wii, and various ARM devices. The distribution provides hashes signed with the NetBSD Security Officer’s PGP key.
items.summary_zh: NetBSD 11.1 已开放下载，支持 amd64、i386、sparc64、macppc、RISC-V、基于 MIPS 的 Cavium Octeon 设备、Nintendo Wii 以及多种 ARM 设备。发行包还提供了由 NetBSD 安全官 PGP 密钥签名的哈希值。

items.title_en: Open-Source 5G Ran Platforms: A Dual Perspective on Performance and Capabilities
items.title_zh: 开源 5G RAN 平台：性能与能力的双重视角
items.summary_en: The paper compares the open-source 5G RAN platforms OpenAirInterface and srsRAN. Its evaluation covers supported features and deployment flexibility, along with radio-resource-control setup, theoretical data rates, and real workloads such as video on demand, live streaming, and cloud gaming. The study varies software-defined radios, RAN configurations, and numbers of real user devices to address gaps in earlier comparisons.
items.summary_zh: 论文比较了 OpenAirInterface 和 srsRAN 这两个开源 5G RAN 平台。评估内容包括支持的功能与部署灵活性，以及无线资源控制建立流程、理论数据速率和视频点播、直播、云游戏等真实负载。研究还改变软件定义无线电、RAN 配置和真实用户设备数量，以弥补早期比较覆盖不足的问题。

items.title_en: If you're on Replit Pro, you have until November 8 to opt out of arbitration
items.title_zh: 如果你使用 Replit Pro，须在 11 月 8 日前选择退出仲裁
items.summary_en: Replit Pro users have until November 8 to opt out of arbitration. The available information provides no further details about the arbitration terms or opt-out process.
items.summary_zh: Replit Pro 用户须在 11 月 8 日前选择退出仲裁。现有信息未提供仲裁条款或退出流程的更多细节。

items.title_en: The Ford Privacy Promise: You're in Control of Your Data
items.title_zh: 福特隐私承诺：你的数据由你掌控
items.summary_en: Ford announced a “Privacy Promise” focused on its responsibility to safeguard customer data.
items.summary_zh: 福特宣布推出“隐私承诺”，强调其保护客户数据的责任。

items.title_en: 40C3 halfnarp – Submit talk preferences to aid scheduling
items.title_zh: 40C3 halfnarp：提交演讲偏好以协助排期
items.summary_en: The 40C3 halfnarp lets attendees select the talks they want to watch and submit their preferences. The submissions are intended to help reduce scheduling conflicts in the event's program. Questions and problems are handled through the listed FAQ, blog post, and contact address.
items.summary_zh: 40C3 halfnarp 允许参会者选择想观看的演讲并提交偏好。这些提交信息旨在帮助减少活动日程中的时间冲突。相关问题和故障可通过列出的常见问题、博客文章及联系邮箱处理。

items.title_en: PyLings: Solve Exercises and Learn Python
items.title_zh: PyLings：通过练习学习 Python
items.summary_en: PyLings teaches Python by having users fix code in exercises ranging from basic concepts to senior-level interview problems. It includes 35 warm-ups and 20 interview exercises, requires no dependencies, and targets Python 3.14. The tool opens the next exercise and reruns its tests whenever the user saves.
items.summary_zh: PyLings 通过让用户修复代码来学习 Python，练习范围从基础知识延伸到高级面试题。它包含 35 道热身题和 20 道面试题，不依赖额外软件包，面向 Python 3.14。用户每次保存时，工具都会打开下一道练习并重新运行测试。

items.title_en: New typeface using intricate designs from Shakespeare's First Folio (2023)
items.title_zh: 采用莎士比亚《第一对开本》复杂图案的新字体（2023）
items.summary_en: Shakespeare's Globe worked with the South London studio Typeland to create Amifer Folio, a typeface based on ornamental editorial devices from Shakespeare's First Folio. The project marks the collection's 400th anniversary and draws on its woodcuts and themes of wilderness and tamed environments. The typeface is being used on posters for the theatre's summer season.
items.summary_zh: 莎士比亚环球剧院与南伦敦字体工作室 Typeland 合作，设计了 Amifer Folio 字体，其灵感来自莎士比亚《第一对开本》中的装饰性编辑图案。该项目纪念这部文集出版 400 周年，并借鉴其中的木刻插图以及荒野与驯化环境的主题。该字体将用于剧院夏季演出季的海报。

items.title_en: V100 SXM2 pinout and NVLink reference
items.title_zh: V100 SXM2 引脚图与 NVLink 参考资料
items.summary_en: This project collects V100 SXM2 pin maps, two- and four-GPU NVLink connection plans, and connector-only KiCad resources. It aims to support an open-source carrier-board design for Nvidia V100 SXM2 modules, while enabling others to develop their own designs.
items.summary_zh: 该项目整理了 V100 SXM2 引脚图、双 GPU 和四 GPU 的 NVLink 连接方案，以及仅含连接器的 KiCad 资源。项目目标是支持 Nvidia V100 SXM2 模块的开源载板设计，同时让其他人能够据此开发自己的设计。

items.title_en: Swipeblocked: The phrases your iPhone won't suggest
items.title_zh: Swipeblocked：iPhone 不会推荐的短语
items.summary_en: The iPhone keyboard contains a hidden list of thousands of phrases that it will not suggest or allow users to swipe. The list includes slurs, sexual and drug-related terms, political slogans, historical events, and public figures. The site reconstructed the list from the keyboard's data files in iOS 27.0, while Apple has not published it or explained how it is selected.
items.summary_zh: iPhone 键盘包含一份隐藏列表，其中有数千个不会被推荐、也无法通过滑行输入的短语。列表涵盖侮辱性词语、性和毒品相关词汇、政治口号、历史事件及公众人物。该网站根据 iOS 27.0 的键盘数据文件还原了这份列表，而苹果既未公开它，也未说明其选择方式。

items.title_en: WaveDudeNext 2D Wave Simulator
items.title_zh: WaveDudeNext 二维波模拟器
items.summary_en: WaveDudeNext is an interactive Windows simulator for two-dimensional wave optics. Users can turn images into refractive scenes, place light sources and optical components, and observe refraction, diffraction, and interference. It displays both the wave field and time-averaged intensity, while supporting probes, timeline control, video export, adjustable brightness, custom color schemes, and multiple interface languages.
items.summary_zh: WaveDudeNext 是一款面向 Windows 的交互式二维波动光学模拟器。用户可以将图像转换为折射场景，放置光源和光学元件，并观察折射、衍射与干涉现象。程序同时显示波场和时间平均强度，并支持探针、时间轴控制、视频导出、亮度调节、自定义配色以及多种界面语言。

items.title_en: 88x31 GIF Stickers for 2026
items.title_zh: 2026 年的 88×31 GIF 贴纸
items.summary_en: The project offers 30 web buttons in the classic 88×31 GIF-sticker format, with visitors invited to choose one.
items.summary_zh: 该项目提供 30 个经典 88×31 GIF 贴纸风格的网页按钮，访客可以任选一个。

items.title_en: Air holes turn silicon wafers into flat UV focusing mirrors for compact optics
items.title_zh: 气孔将硅晶圆变成用于紧凑光学系统的平面紫外聚焦镜
items.summary_en: The research describes using air holes in silicon wafers to create flat ultraviolet-focusing mirrors. Metasurfaces can control the phase of light with nanoscale structures, but extending them into the ultraviolet is difficult because many metasurface materials strongly absorb UV light. The approach could support compact systems for high-resolution imaging, spectroscopy, and sensing.
items.summary_zh: 这项研究介绍了利用硅晶圆中的气孔制造平面紫外聚焦镜。超表面可以通过纳米结构控制光的相位，但许多超表面材料会强烈吸收紫外光，使其向紫外波段扩展十分困难。这种方法有望用于高分辨率成像、光谱分析和传感等紧凑型系统。

items.title_en: Ask HN: How do you manage your AI agents' context across clients and projects?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：如何管理 AI 代理在不同客户和项目之间的上下文？
items.summary_en: The author asks how people preserve context and past decisions when using AI agents across multiple clients and projects. The questions cover transferring context between sessions and agent types, separating client information, recovering from forgotten or rejected approaches, and whether users have built or bought tools for the problem. The discussion is intended to inform a possible tool the author may build.
items.summary_zh: 作者询问人们如何在多个客户和项目之间使用 AI 代理时保存上下文与既有决策。问题涉及在不同会话和代理类型之间传递上下文、隔离客户信息、处理代理忘记或采用已否决方案的情况，以及用户是否购买或开发过相关工具。作者希望借此了解实际工作方式，并评估是否开发一款工具。

items.title_en: Adding Window Functions to a Spreadsheet
items.title_zh: 为电子表格添加窗口函数
items.summary_en: The project addresses the difficulty of maintaining running totals in spreadsheets after more than basic edits. It starts from the familiar pattern where each balance equals the previous balance plus the current transaction. The proposed approach adds window-function capabilities to make such calculations easier to manage.
items.summary_zh: 该项目针对电子表格在进行复杂编辑后难以维护累计总额的问题。它从常见的“当前余额等于上一行余额加当前交易额”这一模式出发。其方案为电子表格增加窗口函数能力，让这类计算更易管理。

items.title_en: A field guide to CAPTCHA types and how they break
items.title_zh: CAPTCHA 类型及其破解方式实地指南
items.summary_en: The project is an open field guide covering 39 CAPTCHA types, their identifying signals, documented open-source bypass methods, and paid alternatives. It provides a searchable web version and frames the material for education and authorized research. Its stated goal is to make changing CAPTCHA systems easier to navigate, compare, and cite while emphasizing responsible use.
items.summary_zh: 该项目是一份开放实地指南，涵盖 39 种 CAPTCHA 类型、识别信号、已有的开源绕过方法及付费替代方案，并提供可搜索的网页版内容。项目将材料定位为教育和获授权研究用途。其目标是在强调负责任使用的同时，让不断变化的 CAPTCHA 系统更易于查找、比较和引用。

items.title_en: Show HN: The DNA of DOOM – How code structure survives across 44 ports
items.title_zh: Show HN：DOOM 的 DNA——代码结构如何跨越 44 个移植版本延续
items.summary_en: The project uses a custom structural extraction engine to analyze 44 historical ports of DOOM. It examines which functions remain, whether their keyword structure is preserved, and whether comparable call networks can be identified. The analysis is intended to trace how the game’s code structure survives across ports.
items.summary_zh: 该项目使用自定义结构提取引擎，分析 DOOM 历史上的 44 个移植版本。研究内容包括哪些函数得以保留、函数的关键词结构是否延续，以及是否存在可比较的调用网络。分析旨在追踪游戏代码结构如何跨越不同移植版本保存下来。

items.title_en: Decode kernel panic from QR Code photo
items.title_zh: 从二维码照片中解码内核崩溃信息
items.summary_en: The project is titled “decode kernel panic from QR Code photo.” It is presented as a GitHub Gist, but the available page content does not provide the decoding method or a working example.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目名为“从二维码照片中解码内核崩溃信息”。它以 GitHub Gist 的形式呈现，但现有页面内容没有提供解码方法或可运行示例。

items.title_en: American Voters Overwhelmingly Reject AI Data Centers
items.title_zh: 美国选民压倒性反对 AI 数据中心
items.summary_en: Data-center proposals appeared in more than 40 ballot races across 13 U.S. states, and voters rejected them in 38 races at the time of reporting. Six cities voted to ban data centers outright, while 12 imposed limits on their electricity consumption. Candidates who supported data centers also lost in several races, including Texas Governor Gregg Abbott’s bid for a fourth term.
items.summary_zh: 美国 13 个州有 40 多场选举将数据中心提案列入选票，截至报道时选民已在其中 38 场投下反对票。六座城市投票决定全面禁止数据中心，另有 12 座城市限制其用电量。支持数据中心的候选人在多场选举中也落败，其中包括竞选第四个任期的得克萨斯州州长 Gregg Abbott。

items.title_en: Show HN: Codemap – one-page interactive map of any Go repository
items.title_zh: Show HN：Codemap——用一页交互式地图展示任意 Go 仓库
items.summary_en: Codemap generates a single HTML page mapping a Go module’s packages, dependencies, files, and functions. Users can search the map, inspect what each package uses and what uses it, and jump to function definitions in GitHub-hosted modules. Tests are excluded from the map.
items.summary_zh: Codemap 会生成一个 HTML 页面，展示 Go 模块中的包、依赖、文件和函数。用户可以搜索地图，查看每个包依赖什么以及被什么依赖，并跳转到 GitHub 模块中的函数定义。地图不包含测试代码。

items.title_en: Making Peace with the Projective Plane
items.title_zh: 与射影平面和解
items.summary_en: The essay explains projective geometry as a natural response to practical problems rather than an arbitrary abstraction. Projective space and homogeneous coordinates eliminate exceptional cases and informal references to points at infinity. The author describes coming to appreciate these ideas only later, after initially finding them unmotivated as a student.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章将射影几何解释为解决实际问题的自然工具，而非任意的抽象。射影空间和齐次坐标能够消除特殊情况，以及对“无穷远处对象”的非严格描述。作者回忆说，自己学生时代觉得这些概念缺乏动机，后来才认识到它们的自然性。

items.title_en: Is Curiosity Good for Us?
items.title_zh: 好奇心对我们有益吗？
items.summary_en: The excerpt examines curiosity, conscience, and the difficulty of knowing another person’s internal state with certainty. It describes the superego, and its precursor conscience, as a part of the self that has no curiosity about itself.
items.summary_zh: 节选探讨了好奇心、良知，以及人们难以确定他人内在状态这一问题。文中将超我及其前身良知描述为自我中一个对自身缺乏好奇的部分。

items.title_en: Optical Circuit Switch Technology Built on Low-Loss Silicon Photonics Platform
items.title_zh: 基于低损耗硅光子平台的光学电路交换技术
items.summary_en: PsiQuantum unveiled optical circuit switching technology based on its low-loss silicon-photonics platform. The company presents it as a response to the growing networking demands created by large AI compute clusters. Optical connectivity is increasingly being considered for faster, more efficient, and more scalable data movement between computing systems.
items.summary_zh: PsiQuantum 发布了基于低损耗硅光子平台的光学电路交换技术。该公司将其定位为应对大型 AI 计算集群不断增长的网络需求。随着计算系统之间的数据传输成为 AI 扩展的瓶颈，光互连正被越来越多地用于实现更快、更高效且更易扩展的连接。

items.title_en: Hacking the T-Mobile Sidekick, 20 Years Too Late
items.title_zh: 破解 T-Mobile Sidekick：晚了 20 年
items.summary_en: The author cracked the signing key for the Danger platform after developer keys for the Sidekick had stopped being issued in 2010. The T-Mobile Sidekick, released in 2002, combined a full QWERTY keyboard, messaging services, push notifications, and a Java-based operating system. Its data was stored on Danger’s servers, and the service ultimately shut down in 2011 after Microsoft acquired Danger and a major data loss occurred in 2009.
items.summary_zh: 在 Sidekick 的开发者密钥于 2010 年停止发放后，作者破解了 Danger 平台的签名密钥。T-Mobile Sidekick 于 2002 年推出，配备全尺寸 QWERTY 键盘、即时通信服务、推送通知以及基于 Java 的操作系统。其数据存储在 Danger 的服务器上；微软收购 Danger 后，2009 年发生重大数据丢失，服务最终于 2011 年关闭。

items.title_en: MoofTCP – A modern replacement for MacTCP on 68k Macs
items.title_zh: MoofTCP——68K Mac 上 MacTCP 的现代替代品
items.summary_en: MoofTCP is a drop-in replacement for Apple's MacTCP on System 6 and 68000-based Macs. Existing MacTCP programs can run unchanged on its newly written, portable-C TCP/IP stack. It includes its own control panel, installer, and DHCP client, and was designed for a Mac Classic with 4 MB of RAM.
items.summary_zh: MoofTCP 是 System 6 和 68000 Mac 上苹果 MacTCP 的即插即用替代品。现有的 MacTCP 程序无需修改即可运行在其用可移植 C 语言重写的 TCP/IP 协议栈上。它还包含独立的控制面板、安装程序和 DHCP 客户端，并针对仅有 4 MB 内存的 Mac Classic 设计。

items.title_en: Show HN: Where Were We
items.title_zh: Show HN：我们曾在哪里
items.summary_en: Where Were We turns vacation photos into a shareable web game. It uses EXIF metadata to determine where and when each photo was taken, then builds the game from that information.
items.summary_zh: Where Were We 可以把旅行照片制作成可分享的网页游戏。它利用照片的 EXIF 元数据判断拍摄地点和时间，再据此生成游戏。

items.title_en: From wild to mild: Friendly foxes show changes in brain region
items.title_zh: 从野生到温顺：友善狐狸的大脑区域发生变化
items.summary_en: Researchers compared the brains of domesticated, aggressive, and wild foxes and found changes in a brain region associated with aggression. The changes occurred in the ventromedial hypothalamus at the base of the brain. This region is also linked to energy-use decisions, maternal instincts, and social behavior in mice.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员比较了驯化、好斗和野生狐狸的大脑，发现一个与攻击行为相关的脑区发生了变化。变化出现在大脑底部的腹内侧下丘脑。该区域还与小鼠的能量使用决策、母性本能和社会行为有关。

items.title_en: The She-Wolves of Jülich
items.title_zh: 于利希的母狼们
items.summary_en: The She-Wolves of Jülich is a historical subject centered on women associated with Jülich. The title provides no further details about the people or events involved.
items.summary_zh: 《于利希的母狼们》是一篇围绕与于利希有关女性人物的历史主题文章。标题未提供相关人物或事件的更多细节。

items.title_en: Playing Zork 1 on a CP/M emulator on Linux (2021)
items.title_zh: 在 Linux 上用 CP/M 模拟器玩《Zork 1》（2021）
items.summary_en: The article shows how to use the z80pack Z80 emulator on Linux to run CP/M and then play Zork 1. Zork is an early interactive-fiction game that accepts plain-text commands such as “take axe” and “look at box.” The example uses Zork because it is substantial while avoiding the terminal-related complications that would arise with software such as WordStar.
items.summary_zh: 文章演示了如何在 Linux 上使用 z80pack Z80 模拟器运行 CP/M，随后游玩《Zork 1》。Zork 是早期的互动小说游戏，接受“拿起斧头”“查看盒子”等纯文本指令。作者选择它是因为游戏内容足够复杂，同时又能避开运行 WordStar 等软件时会遇到的终端相关问题。

items.title_en: Apple Will Scan Public iCloud Links for Harmful Content Starting in iOS 27.3
items.title_zh: 苹果将从 iOS 27.3 开始扫描公开 iCloud 链接中的有害内容
items.summary_en: Apple will scan public iCloud links for harmful content starting with iOS 27.3. No further details about the scanning process or the content categories are available here.
items.summary_zh: 从 iOS 27.3 开始，苹果将扫描公开 iCloud 链接中的有害内容。现有信息未提供扫描流程或内容类别的更多细节。

items.title_en: Ex-PlayStation boss says "true innovation" would be making a $300 console again
items.title_zh: 前 PlayStation 负责人称，真正的创新是再次推出 300 美元的游戏主机
items.summary_en: Former PlayStation executive Shawn Layden said the company should do something it has never done. The proposed form of "true innovation" is to make a $300 console again.
items.summary_zh: 前 PlayStation 高管 Shawn Layden 表示，公司应该做一件从未做过的事。他所提出的“真正创新”是再次推出售价 300 美元的游戏主机。

items.title_en: Optimising the Rail Cube
items.title_zh: 优化 Rail Cube
items.summary_en: The project is an interactive Rail Cube track that currently displays a prompt for a shape string. It is described as resembling a combination of model trains and LEGO. No optimization results are provided in the available context.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个交互式 Rail Cube 轨道项目，目前会提示用户输入形状字符串。作者将它形容为模型火车与乐高的结合体。现有信息未提供具体的优化结果。

items.title_en: 512GB Mac Studio
items.title_zh: 512GB Mac Studio
items.summary_en: The listed Mac Studio configuration includes an M5 Ultra chip, 512GB of memory, and 1TB of storage. Apple says the Mac can transfer files, photos, messages, passwords, and other data from iCloud during setup when an iPhone is brought nearby.
items.summary_zh: 该款 Mac Studio 配备 M5 Ultra 芯片、512GB 内存和 1TB 存储空间。苹果表示，设置时将 iPhone 放在 Mac 附近，即可从 iCloud 传输文件、照片、消息、密码等数据。

items.title_en: My first and last telegram was from Rebecca West
items.title_zh: 我收到的第一封、也是最后一封电报来自丽贝卡·韦斯特
items.summary_en: A telegram from Rebecca West was addressed to Ann Cottrell Free, described here as the first female D.C. The account asks why West sent the cable and notes that West met two Orthodox people while in Sarajevo. The telegram was tucked inside West's book Black Lamb and Grey Falcon.
items.summary_zh: 丽贝卡·韦斯特发出的一封电报，收件人是被称为首位女性 D.C. 的 Ann Cottrell Free。文章追问韦斯特为何发出这封电报，并提到她在萨拉热窝期间结识了两名东正教人士。这封电报被夹在韦斯特的《黑羊与灰鹰》一书中。

items.title_en: Reading the Anthropic S-1, with Zvi Mowshowitz
items.title_zh: 阅读 Anthropic 的 S-1：与 Zvi Mowshowitz 对谈
items.summary_en: A discussion of Anthropic's IPO filing examines founder control, compute commitments, and the company's GPU supply. The filing describes a structure in which a single Class F share holds 50.1% of the vote, an uncapped 3:1 employee donation match, and about $900 billion in forward compute commitments. The participants argue that softer third-quarter revenue may reflect a shortage of GPUs rather than customers. They also discuss bubble and circular-financing risks and responsibility for AI-assisted theft from Binance.
items.summary_zh: 这场对 Anthropic IPO 文件的解读讨论了创始人控制权、算力承诺以及公司的 GPU 供应情况。文件显示，单一 F 类股份拥有 50.1% 的投票权，公司提供无上限的 3:1 员工捐赠匹配，并作出约 9000 亿美元的未来算力承诺。参与者认为，第三季度收入走弱可能反映的是 GPU 短缺，而非客户不足。他们还讨论了泡沫和循环融资风险，以及 AI 辅助攻击者从 Binance 窃取 50 亿美元事件的责任归属。

items.title_en: You are protesting the wrong technology, people
items.title_zh: 人们抗议错了技术
items.summary_en: The piece argues that people are directing their protests at the wrong technology. No further details about the technology or the argument are established here.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章认为，人们把抗议矛头指向了错误的技术。现有信息未说明具体涉及哪种技术或论据。

items.title_en: The efficiency trap: why optimising everything can backfire, badly
items.title_zh: 效率陷阱：为什么优化一切可能严重适得其反
items.summary_en: The piece argues that relentless streamlining can make systems more dangerous by eliminating spare capacity. It cites English hospitals, where about 95% of adult beds were occupied at the height of last year's flu season, leaving little reserve for a sudden surge. The example illustrates how efficiency targets can reduce resilience in critical systems.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，不断追求精简可能会因消除冗余能力而让系统变得更加危险。文章以英国医院为例：去年流感季高峰期，成人病床占用率约为 95%，几乎没有能力应对突发的患者激增。这个例子说明，对效率的追求可能削弱关键系统的韧性。

items.title_en: In LLM era, can software startup survive?
items.title_zh: 在 LLM 时代，软件初创公司还能生存吗？
items.summary_en: The discussion argues that generative AI has made turning ideas into software much faster, while large companies retain advantages in computing resources and customer bases. It also says users increasingly expect startups to offer open-source and free software, making paid products harder to sell. The question is whether software startups can remain viable under these conditions.
items.summary_zh: 这场讨论认为，生成式 AI 让把想法转化为软件变得更快，而大公司仍拥有计算资源和客户基础方面的优势。讨论还指出，用户越来越期待初创公司提供开源和免费软件，使付费产品更难销售。核心问题是软件初创公司能否在这种环境下继续生存。

items.title_en: Letting users trust their own MCP clients, without opening a phishing hole
items.title_zh: 让用户信任自己的 MCP 客户端，同时避免打开钓鱼漏洞
items.summary_en: The proposal addresses how MCP servers can support custom clients without creating a phishing hole. A user’s trusted redirect URIs are selected at sign-in, allowing a self-hosted agent, Slack bot, VPS service, or personal MCP client to complete standard OAuth authentication. The design is intended to protect access to files while still allowing users to run clients they control.
items.summary_zh: 该方案解决 MCP 服务器如何支持自定义客户端、同时避免形成钓鱼漏洞的问题。用户在登录时选择受信任的重定向 URI，使自托管智能体、Slack 机器人、VPS 服务或个人 MCP 客户端能够完成标准 OAuth 认证。这样既可保护文件访问，也允许用户运行自己控制的客户端。

items.title_en: Show HN: An offline desktop companion to help maintain a healthy blink rhythm
items.title_zh: Show HN：帮助保持健康眨眼节律的离线桌面助手
items.summary_en: EyesRhythm is an offline desktop tool that gives audio and visual cues to help users maintain a healthy blinking rhythm. It detects blinks locally using one or more webcams, records neck movement, and requires no internet connection. The project is aimed at people whose prolonged screen work can reduce blink frequency and contribute to dry, painful eyes.
items.summary_zh: EyesRhythm 是一款离线桌面工具，通过音频和视觉提示帮助用户保持健康的眨眼节律。它使用一台或多台摄像头在本地检测眨眼、记录颈部运动，并且无需联网。该项目面向长时间使用屏幕、可能因眨眼频率下降而出现干眼和疼痛的人群。

items.title_en: Mocktastic: A Meshtastic Node on Arduino
items.title_zh: Mocktastic：Arduino 上的 Meshtastic 节点
items.summary_en: Mocktastic is a small, customizable Meshtastic-compatible LoRa client for ESP32 boards built with ArduinoIDE. It is an educational and experimental C++ implementation rather than a fork of the official firmware. The project demonstrates Meshtastic packet encoding and decoding and includes an environmental-sensor example.
items.summary_zh: Mocktastic 是一个面向 ESP32 开发板、使用 ArduinoIDE 构建的小型可定制 Meshtastic 兼容 LoRa 客户端。它是用于教育和实验的 C++ 实现，并非官方固件的分支。项目演示了 Meshtastic 数据包的编码与解码，并包含环境传感器示例。

items.title_en: Show HN: PyWolf3D, a wolfenstein3D clone written from scratch in Python
items.title_zh: Show HN：PyWolf3D——从零用 Python 编写的 Wolfenstein 3D 克隆版
items.summary_en: PyWolf3D is a Wolfenstein 3D engine and game clone written from scratch in Python using Pygame. A demo is included.
items.summary_zh: PyWolf3D 是一个使用 Python 和 Pygame 从零编写的 Wolfenstein 3D 引擎及游戏克隆版，并提供演示。

items.title_en: A Conversation with Paul Masurel, Creator of Tantivy
items.title_zh: 与 Tantivy 创造者 Paul Masurel 对话
items.summary_en: The interview covers building a search engine in Rust, competing with Lucene, maintaining open source, and lessons from Tantivy's development. Tantivy began in 2017 as a small modular Rust project and later became the engine behind Quickwit, ParadeDB, LNX, and other search products. Its development also prompted performance collaboration with the Lucene team.
items.summary_zh: 这次访谈讨论了用 Rust 构建搜索引擎、与 Lucene 竞争、维护开源项目，以及 Tantivy 开发过程中的经验。Tantivy 于 2017 年作为一个小型模块化 Rust 项目出现，后来成为 Quickwit、ParadeDB、LNX 等搜索产品的引擎。其发展还促成了与 Lucene 团队的性能合作。

items.title_en: Independent Assessment of AI R&D Acceleration at Anthropic in October 2026
items.title_zh: Anthropic 2026 年 10 月 AI 研发加速的独立评估
items.summary_en: METR conducted a high-access assessment of how much AI accelerated research and development at Anthropic in October 2026. Anthropic was allowed to redact non-public information, and it removed a majority of the evidence METR considered most informative for its conclusions. METR says the important redactions are described in its report, while noting that some details cannot be explained without exposing sensitive information.
items.summary_zh: METR 对 2026 年 10 月 AI 在 Anthropic 内部加速研发的程度进行了高权限评估。Anthropic 获准删去非公开信息，并删除了 METR 认为对结论最有说明力的大部分证据。METR 表示，报告描述了对结论重要的删节内容，但部分细节无法在不泄露敏感信息的情况下解释。

items.title_en: Benchfmt.rs: Bringing Go's benchmarking and benchstat workflow to Rust
items.title_zh: Benchfmt.rs：将 Go 的基准测试与 benchstat 工作流带到 Rust
items.summary_en: benchfmt.rs is a zero-dependency Rust benchmark runner and Criterion converter designed around Go’s benchstat workflow. It adds key-value projections, heap tracking for bytes and objects allocated per operation, and pprof profiling. The author uses varint and Prometheus Remote Write 2.0 decoding benchmarks to compare Go and Rust.
