items.summary_zh: benchfmt.rs 是一个零依赖的 Rust 基准测试运行器和 Criterion 转换器，旨在带来 Go benchstat 的工作流。它增加了键值投影、每次操作的字节和对象分配堆跟踪，以及 pprof 性能分析。作者通过 varint 和 Prometheus Remote Write 2.0 解码基准测试比较 Go 与 Rust。

items.title_en: Brazilian Credit Guarantor Fund Data Breach Affecting PII and Payout Data
items.title_zh: 巴西信贷担保基金数据泄露，涉及个人信息和赔付数据
items.summary_en: Brazil's credit guarantor fund reported unauthorized access to personal information in environments related to its guarantee-payment processes. It has found no evidence so far that the data was disclosed or misused, and no financial loss has been identified. The investigation continues with help from specialized companies to determine the extent of access and whether data was copied, disclosed, or used improperly.
items.summary_zh: 巴西信贷担保基金报告称，与担保赔付流程相关的环境曾发生个人信息未授权访问。目前尚未发现数据被披露或滥用的证据，也未发现由此造成的财务损失。调查仍在继续，并由专业公司协助确定访问范围，以及数据是否被复制、披露或不当使用。

items.title_en: OCAP Bounded Authority: Edera's Managed Approach to Object Capabilities
items.title_zh: OCAP 有界权限：Edera 的对象能力管理方案
items.summary_en: Edera describes using object-capability security and bounded authority to restrict AI agents to only the access they need. The approach is intended to contain the impact of a compromise, since credentials or filesystem access can expose far more than an agent's narrowly intended task. The same concern applies to MCP servers holding cloud credentials.
items.summary_zh: Edera 介绍了如何利用对象能力安全和有界权限，让 AI 代理只能获得完成任务所需的访问权限。该方法旨在限制系统遭到入侵后的影响，因为凭据或文件系统权限可能暴露远超代理原定任务范围的数据。持有云凭据的 MCP 服务器也面临同样的问题。

items.title_en: Show HN: Gauge – Open-Source CLI to recursively improve your docs
items.title_zh: Show HN：Gauge——递归改进文档的开源 CLI
items.summary_en: Gauge is an open-source CLI that recursively improves documentation for coding agents. It runs tasks, analyzes agent transcripts for friction or failures, creates documentation variants, and repeats the process until a variant resolves the issues. The tool includes a local execution backend and can also optimize skills, CLIs, and other agent-facing interfaces.
items.summary_zh: Gauge 是一个用于递归改进 coding agent 文档的开源 CLI。它会运行任务、分析 agent 会话记录中的阻碍或失败、生成文档变体，并重复这一过程，直到某个变体解决相关问题。该工具包含本地执行后端，也可用于优化技能、CLI 和其他面向 agent 的界面。

items.title_en: A Chemical Hunger (2021)
items.summary_en: It contrasts an average U.S. male weight of about 155 pounds a century ago with roughly 195 pounds today, while obesity rose from about 1% to 36% of the population. Data on Civil War veterans also showed an average BMI of about 23 in the 1890s, compared with about 28 among middle-aged white men in 2000.
items.summary_zh: 文章考察肥胖流行的历史及其成因之谜。它对比指出，美国男性平均体重约一个世纪前为 155 磅，如今约为 195 磅，而肥胖率则从约 1% 上升到 36%。有关南北战争老兵的数据还显示，19 世纪 90 年代他们的平均 BMI 约为 23，而 2000 年中年白人男性约为 28。

items.title_en: One in eight cancers are likely caused by an infection worldwide
items.title_zh: 全球每八例癌症中可能有一例由感染引起
items.summary_en: A new study estimates that infections likely caused about 12% of all cancer cases worldwide in 2024. The research, published in The Lancet Oncology, examined the frequency and causes of different cancers, focusing on the role of infections. Four viruses and one bacterium accounted for the reported share.
items.summary_zh: 一项新研究估计，2024 年全球约 12% 的癌症病例可能由感染引起。该研究发表于《柳叶刀·肿瘤学》，分析了不同癌症的发生频率和病因，重点考察感染的作用。据报告，四种病毒和一种细菌造成了这一比例的病例。

items.title_en: IRA Velinsky – Commodore's Industrial Designer
items.title_zh: 艾拉·维林斯基——Commodore 的工业设计师
items.summary_en: Ira Velinsky was Commodore's industrial designer.
items.summary_zh: 艾拉·维林斯基是 Commodore 的工业设计师。

items.title_en: The Linux 7.4 Merge Window Is Easily the Largest in Kernel History
items.title_zh: Linux 7.4 合并窗口轻松创下内核历史最大规模
items.summary_en: The Linux 7.4 merge window is being measured against major kernel releases from the past 15 years. The kernel source tree is approaching 42 million lines, prompting an analysis of how the current merge window compares with earlier releases.
items.summary_zh: Linux 7.4 的合并窗口正与过去 15 年的主要内核版本进行规模比较。内核源代码树接近 4200 万行，因此有人开始分析当前合并窗口与早期版本相比有多大。

items.title_en: Mass attempted replication of old findings of LLMs with new models
items.title_zh: 大规模尝试用新模型复现 LLM 的旧发现
items.summary_en: Researchers revisited 50 published findings about language models across 20 models. Within 15 months of publication, most tested claims either no longer held or had substantially weaker effects. The results suggest that some empirical knowledge about AI may have a short shelf life.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员在 20 个模型上重新检验了 50 项已发表的语言模型研究发现。发表后 15 个月内，大多数被测试的结论要么不再成立，要么效果明显减弱。结果表明，部分关于 AI 的经验性认识可能具有较短的有效期。

items.title_en: Flawless UI-UX Skill 1.0.0
items.title_zh: Flawless UI-UX Skill 1.0.0
items.summary_en: Flawless UI-UX is a skill for coding agents that helps them build distinctive and usable interfaces. Version 1.0.0 includes an interactive installer and support for twelve agents. The installer can be run with npm, pnpm, or Bun, and lets users choose project or global scope, select agents, review destinations, and confirm file copying.
items.summary_zh: Flawless UI-UX 是一项帮助编程智能体构建具有特色且易用界面的技能。1.0.0 版本提供交互式安装程序，并支持 12 种智能体。用户可以通过 npm、pnpm 或 Bun 启动安装器，选择项目级或全局范围、指定智能体、检查目标位置并确认复制文件。

items.title_en: Panthera: Ampere's CPU Performance Model
items.title_zh: Panthera：Ampere 的 CPU 性能模型
items.summary_en: Panthera is Ampere’s cycle-accurate software performance model for studying prospective CPU features and evaluating microarchitectural trade-offs. It is built by Ampere’s Architecture & Performance team to guide development of high-performance cloud processors. The project includes a user guide for building and using Panthera and its associated tools.
items.summary_zh: Panthera 是 Ampere 的周期精确软件性能模型，用于研究候选 CPU 特性并评估微架构取舍。它由 Ampere 架构与性能团队开发，以指导高性能云处理器的设计。项目还提供了构建和使用 Panthera 及相关工具的用户指南。

items.title_en: 80k Hops per Second Measurement Confirm Starlink Up/Downlink Channel Pairing
items.title_zh: 每秒 8 万次跳频测量确认 Starlink 上下行信道配对
items.summary_en: A hardware-controlled AD9361 frequency-hopping setup achieved 80,000 channel hops per second. This replaces an earlier software-controlled implementation that reached 10,000 hops per second. The measurements were used to confirm Starlink uplink/downlink channel pairing.
items.summary_zh: 一套由硬件控制的 AD9361 跳频系统实现了每秒 8 万次信道跳变。它取代了此前由软件控制、每秒只能达到 1 万次跳变的实现。这些测量用于确认 Starlink 的上行与下行信道配对。

items.title_en: What should we learn now?
items.title_zh: 我们现在应该学习什么？
items.summary_en: The spread of LLMs that write much of the day's code is prompting developers to reconsider how they learn. The author says LLMs are ubiquitous in their corporate coding environment and views them as a potentially useful tooling improvement. They also argue that poor-quality and hallucinated code existed in large quantities before LLMs arrived.
items.summary_zh: LLM 越来越多地代写日常代码，促使开发者重新思考学习方式。作者表示，LLM 在其所在的企业编程环境中已经无处不在，并认为它们可能是有益的工具改进。作者还指出，在 LLM 出现之前，低质量代码和大量幻觉式结果也早已存在。

items.title_en: ZeBridge – PostgreSQL replicas on devices, synchronized over NATS
items.title_zh: ZeBridge：通过 NATS 同步设备上的 PostgreSQL 副本
items.summary_en: ZeBridge is a bidirectional, local-first synchronization engine connecting PostgreSQL with edge SQLite, PGLITE, PostgreSQL, and DuckDB clients over NATS. It keeps a local database on each device and queues writes while the device is offline. When connectivity returns, PostgreSQL remains authoritative by applying rules, resolving conflicts, and returning a result to the application.
items.summary_zh: ZeBridge 是一个双向、以本地优先为理念的同步引擎，通过 NATS 连接 PostgreSQL 与边缘端的 SQLite、PGLITE、PostgreSQL 和 DuckDB 客户端。它在每台设备上保留本地数据库，并在离线时排队保存写入操作。重新连接后，PostgreSQL 仍是权威数据源，负责应用规则、解决冲突并向应用返回结果。

items.title_en: Harmony: Chat like Discord. Federated like email
items.title_zh: Harmony：像 Discord 一样聊天，像电子邮件一样联邦化
items.summary_en: Harmony is an open-source, federated community chat application built on ActivityPub. It provides servers, voice and video, threads, and bots, while allowing anyone to host a server that communicates with other servers. The service is available in a browser and can also be self-hosted with one command.
items.summary_zh: Harmony 是一款基于 ActivityPub 的开源联邦式社区聊天应用。它提供服务器、语音和视频、线程及机器人功能，并允许任何人托管服务器，与其他服务器互通。该服务可直接在浏览器中使用，也支持通过一条命令自行部署。

items.title_en: Open models can do 90 percent of agentic work at a twentieth of the cost
items.title_zh: 开源模型能以二十分之一的成本完成 90% 的智能体工作
items.summary_en: Gartner estimates that nine out of ten agent-workflow steps are routine and can be handled at parity by open-weight models. The firm says these models cost about one-quarter as much as the cheapest closed model, while model makers may compete for the remaining 10% of more valuable steps. The analysis argues that agent harnesses may be more valuable than the underlying models.
items.summary_zh: Gartner 估计，智能体工作流中十分之九的步骤属于常规任务，开放权重模型可以达到同等效果。该机构称，这些模型的成本约为最便宜闭源模型的四分之一，而模型厂商可能会争夺剩余 10% 的高价值步骤。分析认为，智能体运行框架可能比底层模型更有价值。

items.title_en: Show HN: Rustable is an open source database client built in Rust
items.title_zh: Show HN：Rustable——用 Rust 编写的开源数据库客户端
items.summary_en: Rustable is an open-source, native database client for macOS, Windows, and Linux. It is written in Rust.
items.summary_zh: Rustable 是一款面向 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 的开源原生数据库客户端，使用 Rust 编写。

items.title_en: Show HN: Tmux-restore saves tmux windows and agent sessions across reboots
items.title_zh: Show HN：Tmux-restore 可在重启后保存 tmux 窗口和代理会话
items.summary_en: tmux-restore restores tmux sessions, layouts, and scrollback after a reboot. It can also reopen conversations for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, opencode, and pi. The project describes itself as reboot-proof tmux for coding agents.
items.summary_zh: tmux-restore 可在重启后恢复 tmux 会话、布局和滚动缓冲区。它还能够重新打开 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、opencode 和 pi 中此前的对话。该项目将自己定位为面向编程代理的“重启无忧” tmux 工具。

items.title_en: No Intel, no Qualcomm: Huawei unveils its first '100% domestic' desktop
items.title_zh: 不含英特尔和高通：华为推出首款“100% 国产”台式机
items.summary_en: Huawei has unveiled a desktop lineup that it says uses China-made components throughout, from the processor to the memory modules. The company says the systems are the first desktops in China to receive certification as “100 percent domestic,” although the certification's exact scope is unclear. The launch expands HarmonyOS beyond laptops and tablets as Huawei seeks to replace US technology.
items.summary_zh: 华为发布了一系列台式机，称其从处理器到内存模块全部采用中国制造的组件。该公司表示，这些设备是中国首批获得“100% 国产”认证的台式机，但认证的具体范围尚不清楚。此次发布将 HarmonyOS 扩展到笔记本电脑和平板电脑之外，也体现了华为替代美国技术的努力。

items.title_en: Offline survival assistant – local LLM and Kiwix, runs from a USB stick
items.title_zh: 离线生存助手：本地 LLM 与 Kiwix，可从 U 盘运行
items.summary_en: This survival assistant runs fully offline on Windows, Linux, and macOS, including from a laptop or USB drive. It provides sourced guides on water, fire, food, first aid, and other topics in Portuguese, English, and Spanish, alongside a local LLM using llama.cpp or Ollama. Kiwix libraries provide additional offline reference material.
items.summary_zh: 这款生存助手可在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上完全离线运行，也可以从笔记本电脑或 U 盘启动。它提供葡萄牙语、英语和西班牙语的水、火、食物、急救等主题资料，并通过 llama.cpp 或 Ollama 运行本地 LLM。Kiwix 资料库则提供额外的离线参考内容。

items.title_en: America's economy is becoming zero-sum
items.title_zh: 美国经济正变成零和经济
items.summary_en: The piece argues that America’s economy is becoming zero-sum. No further details about the causes or examples are established here.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章认为，美国经济正在变成零和经济。现有信息未提供具体原因或例证。

items.title_en: Trademarks and Symbols, Volume 2: Symbolical Designs (1973)
items.title_zh: 《商标与符号》第二卷：象征性设计（1973）
items.summary_en: This collection catalogs all 1,504 marks from Yasaburo Kuwayama's 1973 book, with designer, company, and chapter information. The marks range from human figures and birds to arrows and hiragana. The collection is available as free SVG and PNG files for noncommercial use.
items.summary_zh: 这个资料库收录了 Yasaburo Kuwayama 1973 年著作中的全部 1,504 个商标，并提供设计师、公司和章节信息。图案涵盖人物、鸟类、箭头和日文平假名等类型。所有内容均以 SVG 和 PNG 格式免费提供，限非商业使用。

items.title_en: Show HN: Agents infer Lego mechanisms from sources, then animate them
items.title_zh: Show HN：代理从资料推断 LEGO 机构并为其制作动画
items.summary_en: LDraw Mecha uses agentic language models to analyze annotated LDraw LEGO model files, infer their submodels and mechanisms, plan animations, and execute them in Blender. It outputs a rigged and animated Blender file from an initial .mpd source file. The project builds on LDraw Nova, an earlier tool for generating LEGO CAD models from LDraw source code.
items.summary_zh: LDraw Mecha 使用代理式语言模型分析带注释的 LDraw LEGO 模型文件，推断其中的子模型和机械结构，规划动画，并在 Blender 中执行。它可以从初始的 .mpd 源文件生成带绑定和动画的 Blender 文件。该项目建立在此前用于从 LDraw 源代码生成 LEGO CAD 模型的 LDraw Nova 之上。

items.title_en: AMD CEO saying it's a "data center first" company and PC sales will plummet
items.title_zh: AMD CEO 称公司“数据中心优先”，PC 销量将暴跌
items.summary_en: AMD CEO Lisa Su described the company as “data center first,” signaling that its priorities are increasingly focused on data centers and AI. The report says this effectively sidelines consumers and predicts that PC sales could fall by a double-digit percentage in 2027.
items.summary_zh: AMD CEO Lisa Su 将公司描述为“数据中心优先”，表明 AMD 的重点正越来越转向数据中心和 AI。报道认为，这实际上使消费者业务退居次要位置，并预测 PC 销量可能在 2027 年出现两位数百分比的下滑。

items.title_en: Only 16% of U.S. fast-charging stations meet federal NEVI standards (open data)
items.title_zh: 只有 16% 的美国快速充电站符合联邦 NEVI 标准（开放数据）
items.summary_en: As of November 6, 2026, 2,547 of 15,927 open public DC fast-charging stations in the 50 states and Washington, D.C., met the federal NEVI station minimums. The dataset also identifies 881 highway stretches where public DC fast chargers are more than 50 miles apart. It provides 20 free files covering charging gaps, reliability, charging deserts, and other EV infrastructure data. The data is rebuilt daily and released under CC BY 4.0, with station facts sourced from the public-domain AFDC.
items.summary_zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月 6 日，美国 50 个州及华盛顿特区的 15,927 个开放式公共直流快充站中，只有 2,547 个符合联邦 NEVI 站点最低标准。数据集还发现 881 段公路上的公共直流快充站间距超过 50 英里。该项目提供 20 个免费文件，涵盖充电缺口、可靠性、充电荒漠及其他电动车基础设施数据。数据每日重建，并以 CC BY 4.0 发布，站点信息来自公共领域的 AFDC。

items.title_en: Cancer at Sea
items.title_zh: 海上癌症
items.summary_en: A mysterious disease affecting California sea lions is being studied to better understand cancer in animals, including humans. Researchers at the Marine Mammal Center examined a sea lion pup that was severely malnourished and only about one-quarter the size of a healthy pup. The young male survived for ten days after arriving but could not be saved.
items.summary_zh: 一种影响加州海狮的神秘疾病，正在帮助科学家更好地理解包括人类在内的动物癌症。海洋哺乳动物中心的研究人员检查了一只严重营养不良的海狮幼崽，它的体型只有健康幼崽的大约四分之一。这只雄性幼崽抵达后存活了 10 天，但最终未能获救。

items.title_en: Postal Service Surveilled Protest Activities Online with Little Rules, Oversight
items.title_zh: 美国邮政服务几乎不受监管地在线监控抗议活动
items.summary_en: U.S. Postal Service records show that the agency used social-media surveillance to monitor and report on protests across the political spectrum. The records were disclosed to the Electronic Frontier Foundation and other requesters involved in Freedom of Information Act litigation. The documents indicate that the surveillance operated with limited rules and oversight.
items.summary_zh: 美国邮政服务的记录显示，该机构利用社交媒体监控并报告不同政治立场的抗议活动。这些记录披露给了电子前沿基金会及其他依据《信息自由法》提出申请的相关方。文件表明，这类监控受到的规则和监督有限。

items.title_en: Funimation Shutdown Fuels Push for DMCA Exemption to Legally Rip Anime Content
items.title_zh: Funimation 关闭推动 DMCA 豁免，以合法翻录动漫内容
items.summary_en: When Funimation shut down its app and website in April 2024 and became part of Crunchyroll, buyers lost access to digital copies bundled with Funimation DVDs and Blu-rays. Anime fans objected to losing access to content they had purchased. The shutdown has fueled calls for a DMCA exemption that would allow legal ripping of those discs.
items.summary_zh: Funimation 于 2024 年 4 月关闭应用和网站并并入 Crunchyroll 后，购买其 DVD 和蓝光光盘的用户失去了随附的数字副本。动漫粉丝对购买的内容无法继续访问表示不满。这次关闭推动了要求修改 DMCA、允许合法翻录这些光盘内容的呼声。

items.title_en: Ask HN: What are forgotten topics in computing that deserve a new revisit?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：哪些被遗忘的计算机主题值得重新审视？
items.summary_en: The discussion asks which neglected areas of computing deserve another look. It includes topics newly enabled by AI coding agents as well as ideas that were previously impractical because computers were not fast enough.
items.summary_zh: 这场讨论询问哪些被忽视的计算机领域值得重新审视。话题既包括 AI 编程代理如今能够实现的方向，也包括过去因计算机速度不足而难以实践的想法。

items.title_en: Shadow of the Sun (2021)
items.title_zh: 太阳的阴影（2021）
items.summary_en: The author reflects on the desire to abandon ordinary work, relationships, property, and stability in order to live as a drifter. Such a life would offer unusual places, adventure, and personal responsibility, but would require giving up safety and conventional sources of happiness. The author compares this imagined existence to the life of Ryszard Kapuscinski.
items.summary_zh: 作者思考了抛弃普通工作、人际关系、财产和稳定生活、成为漂泊者的愿望。这样的生活能够带来陌生的地方、冒险和对自身安全负责的自由，但也意味着放弃安全感与传统意义上的幸福来源。作者将这种想象中的生活与 Ryszard Kapuscinski 的人生相提并论。

items.title_en: Proton's AI manifesto for software engineering
items.title_zh: Proton 的软件工程 AI 宣言
items.summary_en: Proton CTO Bart Butler’s internal memo describes how the company plans to navigate the transition to AI. It argues that code production is particularly suited to AI models and notes that software companies have already laid off more than one million employees in recent years. The memo calls for rapid organizational transformation while emphasizing that employees should remain active participants in the change.
items.summary_zh: Proton 首席技术官 Bart Butler 的内部备忘录介绍了公司应对 AI 转型的计划。备忘录认为，编写和处理代码尤其适合 AI 模型，并指出软件公司近年来已裁员超过 100 万人。它呼吁组织快速转型，同时强调员工应继续成为这一变化的主动参与者。

items.title_en: Show HN: ReBirth 338 in Browser
items.title_zh: Show HN：在浏览器中运行 ReBirth 338
items.summary_en: The project runs the original Windows release of ReBirth RB-338 in a browser using Wine and WebAssembly.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目利用 Wine 和 WebAssembly，在浏览器中运行原版 Windows 版 ReBirth RB-338。

items.title_en: How AI is creating a lopsided US economy
items.title_zh: AI 如何造成美国经济失衡
items.summary_en: Experts warn that AI's dominance of the U.S. stock market is creating its own risks. The discussion points to the concentration of some of the world's wealthiest people around President Donald Trump at the White House AI Summit.
items.summary_zh: 专家警告，AI 对美国股市的主导地位正在制造新的风险。相关讨论提到，在白宫 AI 峰会上，全球一些最富有的人聚集在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周围。

items.title_en: Show HN: Did prediction markets do any predicting this midterms?
items.title_zh: Show HN：预测市场对这次中期选举做出预测了吗？
items.summary_en: The analysis compares prediction markets with polls and Nate Silver’s FLIPR model in the midterm elections. It finds them broadly comparable, with no apparent advantage over a traditional poll-based model, especially in races that were flipped or close according to polls. The author questions whether prediction markets should be treated more as entertainment.
items.summary_zh: 该分析将中期选举中的预测市场与民调及 Nate Silver 的 FLIPR 模型进行了比较。结果显示，预测市场总体上与这些方法相当，在民调显示翻转或势均力敌的选区中，也没有明显优于传统民调模型的优势。作者因此质疑，预测市场是否更应被视为一种娱乐形式。

items.title_en: Don't Call It a Decision Model
items.title_zh: 别称它为决策模型
items.summary_en: TypeSafe AI describes Jev as a System One model rather than a decision model. The company says Jev makes judgments while code makes decisions, even though Jev may appear to choose an option from a list. TypeSafe is explaining why it continues to reject the increasingly common “decision models” label.
items.summary_zh: TypeSafe AI 将 Jev 称为 System One 模型，而不是决策模型。公司认为 Jev 负责做出判断，而代码负责做出决策，尽管 Jev 看起来可能会从列表中选择一个选项。TypeSafe 正在解释其为何继续拒绝日益流行的“决策模型”这一称呼。

items.title_en: Previously untranslated Einstein paper in English
items.title_zh: 一篇此前未被翻译成英文的爱因斯坦论文
items.summary_en: A newly released English translation presents an Einstein paper on a decades-old question concerning Crookes radiometers. The translator completed it during a PhD in 2019 and released it after Einstein’s work entered the public domain on January 1, 2026. The paper is hosted in the Cambridge University repository and has a DOI.
items.summary_zh: 一份新发布的英文译本呈现了爱因斯坦一篇探讨克鲁克斯辐射计数十年未解问题的论文。译者于 2019 年攻读博士期间完成翻译，并在爱因斯坦作品于 2026 年 1 月 1 日进入公有领域后发布。论文托管在剑桥大学知识库中，并拥有 DOI。

items.title_en: GUI64 – GUI for the Commodore 64 running on top of the built-in ROM
items.title_zh: GUI64——运行在 C64 内置 ROM 之上的图形界面
items.summary_en: GUI64 is a graphical layer running on top of the Commodore 64's built-in Kernal rather than a standalone operating system. It provides movable windows for managing floppy-disk files and SD2IEC disk images, and can mount images directly on Ultimate devices. The current version is reported as 2.1 and supports a mouse, joystick, and mouse wheel through a Micromys adapter or the VICE emulator.
items.summary_zh: GUI64 是运行在 Commodore 64 内置 Kernal 之上的图形层，而不是独立操作系统。它通过可移动窗口管理软盘文件和 SD2IEC 磁盘镜像，并可在 Ultimate 设备中直接挂载镜像。据资料显示，当前版本为 2.1，支持鼠标、摇杆，以及通过 Micromys 适配器或 VICE 模拟器使用鼠标滚轮。

items.title_en: Exporting tables from a SQL Server backup (.bak) to Parquet without restoring it
items.title_zh: 无需恢复备份：将 SQL Server .bak 表导出为 Parquet
items.summary_en: FastBCP 1.6 can read tables directly from SQL Server full backups and write them to Parquet without restoring the backup or running a SQL Server instance. On a 320 GB production backup, the first open took 2 minutes 29 seconds, while later opens took 0.3 seconds; a 175-million-row table was exported in 29.6 seconds using 24 threads. FastTransfer can load the resulting files into any SQL Server version or PostgreSQL.
items.summary_zh: FastBCP 1.6 可以直接从 SQL Server 完整备份中读取表并写入 Parquet，无需恢复备份或运行 SQL Server 实例。在一个 320 GB 的生产备份上，首次打开耗时 2 分 29 秒，之后打开仅需 0.3 秒；使用 24 个线程时，一个包含 1.75 亿行的表在 29.6 秒内完成导出。FastTransfer 可将生成的文件加载到任意版本的 SQL Server 或 PostgreSQL。

items.title_en: Study solved a 150-year-old mystery into the identity of the extinct giant crane
items.title_zh: 研究破解了一桩持续 150 年的灭绝巨鹤身份之谜
items.summary_en: A study has solved a 150-year-old mystery about the identity of an extinct giant crane.
items.summary_zh: 一项研究破解了持续 150 年的灭绝巨鹤身份之谜。

items.title_en: NASA's Swift space telescope predicted to crash back to Earth tomorrow
items.title_zh: NASA Swift 太空望远镜预计明天坠回地球
items.summary_en: NASA's Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory, which has been in orbit for 22 years, is expected to reenter the atmosphere tomorrow. Plans to save the defunct space telescope failed, and its descent can be tracked.
items.summary_zh: NASA 的 Neil Gehrels Swift 天文台已在轨运行 22 年，预计将于明天重返大气层。拯救这台失效太空望远镜的计划未能成功，目前可以追踪其下降过程。

items.title_en: When Modernization Breaks Working Code: A Study of LLMs on Legacy PHP
items.title_zh: 现代化破坏可运行代码：LLM 处理遗留 PHP 的研究
items.summary_en: The study asked five LLMs to modernize 100 WordPress 4.0 PHP files to PHP 8.3 without project context or execution feedback. The untouched baseline had 83 files passing all hidden checks, while the best LLM left 59; models broke 32–51 working files and repaired at most 10. Rector performed better on compatibility, and many regressions came from type declarations that PHP rejected.
items.summary_zh: 该研究让五个 LLM 在没有项目上下文和运行反馈的情况下，将 100 个 WordPress 4.0 PHP 文件现代化到 PHP 8.3。未修改的基线有 83 个文件通过全部隐藏检查，而表现最好的 LLM 只剩 59 个；各模型破坏了 32 至 51 个原本可运行的文件，最多只修复 10 个。Rector 在兼容性方面表现更好，许多回归源于 PHP 本身拒绝的类型声明。

items.title_en: GPT-6 Cyber
items.title_zh: GPT-6 Cyber
items.summary_en: OpenAI describes GPT-6 Cyber as a major advance in security research that combines stronger capabilities with improved alignment. The model reportedly powered Linux kernel research and is being used by security teams at Mozilla, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco, and OpenAI. Its stated focus is advancing cybersecurity work while remaining within authorized boundaries.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 将 GPT-6 Cyber 描述为网络安全研究的重要进展，结合了更强的能力与更好的对齐表现。据称，该模型支持了 Linux 内核研究，并被 Mozilla、Palo Alto Networks、Cisco 以及 OpenAI 的安全团队使用。其定位是在遵守授权边界的同时推进网络安全工作。

items.title_en: Fox Bought Roku
items.title_zh: 福克斯收购 Roku
items.summary_en: Fox has completed its $22 billion acquisition of Roku. The deal gives Fox control of Roku’s streaming platform, which reaches more than 100 million US households. The acquisition could lead to more Fox content appearing on Roku.
items.summary_zh: 福克斯已完成对 Roku 的 220 亿美元收购。交易使福克斯获得 Roku 流媒体平台的控制权，该平台覆盖美国超过 1 亿户家庭。这一收购可能会让 Roku 上出现更多福克斯内容。

items.title_en: Show HN: JavaScript web apps with WASM layout and GPU rendering in 280 KB
items.title_zh: Show HN：用 WASM 布局和 GPU 渲染构建 280 KB 的 JavaScript 网页应用
items.summary_en: Uniform is a JavaScript framework for web applications that uses WebAssembly for layout and GPU rendering, with a reported size of 280 KB. Its creator aims to avoid the platform limits of native frameworks, the HTML/CSS constraints of browser-engine approaches, and the size or language requirements of other cross-platform frameworks. The design bundles the UI framework with the application so developers can update it independently of platform release cycles.
items.summary_zh: Uniform 是一个用于网页应用的 JavaScript 框架，使用 WebAssembly 处理布局并通过 GPU 渲染，体积据称为 280 KB。作者希望避免原生框架的平台限制、基于浏览器引擎方案所继承的 HTML/CSS 约束，以及其他跨平台框架的体积或语言要求。该设计将 UI 框架直接与应用打包，使开发者能够独立于平台发布周期更新它。

items.title_en: WebAssembly Specification Release 3.0 (2026-11-04)
items.title_zh: WebAssembly 规范 3.0 发布（2026-11-04）
items.summary_en: The WebAssembly Specification Release 3.0 was published on November 4, 2026.
items.summary_zh: WebAssembly 规范 3.0 于 2026 年 11 月 4 日发布。

items.title_en: NTS: Authenticated Time at Meta
items.title_zh: NTS：Meta 的认证时间服务
items.summary_en: Meta's public time service at nts.meta.com now supports Network Time Security, allowing devices to verify that time packets came from Meta and were not modified in transit. Earlier work improved the service's precision from 10 milliseconds to 100 microseconds and opened it to the public. NTS adds verifiability to that precise time service.
items.summary_zh: Meta 位于 nts.meta.com 的公共时间服务现已支持网络时间安全协议（NTS），设备可以验证时间数据包确实来自 Meta 且未在传输途中被修改。此前的工作已将服务精度从 10 毫秒提升至 100 微秒，并向公众开放。NTS 则在精确时间服务之上增加了可验证性。

items.title_en: Small internet forums are making a comeback in Google Search
items.title_zh: 小型互联网论坛正在 Google 搜索中复兴
items.summary_en: A study examines whether Google is favoring forums over established authority sites. During Google’s September 2026 spam update, which rolled out from September 24 to October 8, many trusted niche websites experienced major declines in rankings and traffic. The study frames this shift as user-generated content gaining visibility in search.
items.summary_zh: 一项研究考察 Google 是否更偏向论坛而非成熟的权威网站。在 2026 年 9 月 24 日至 10 月 8 日推出的垃圾内容更新期间，许多细分领域中受信任的网站排名和流量大幅下降。研究将这一变化描述为用户生成内容在搜索结果中获得更高可见度。

items.title_en: A Bit about Email
items.title_zh: 浅谈电子邮件
items.summary_en: The piece explains the main components involved in delivering email: the mail user agent, submission agent, transfer agent, and local delivery agent. These roles separate composing or reading messages, authenticating senders, transferring mail between servers, and storing messages for recipients. The architecture originated when organizations typically operated a single costly server and network links were slow and unreliable.
items.summary_zh: 文章介绍了电子邮件传递过程中的主要组件：邮件用户代理、提交代理、传输代理和本地投递代理。这些角色分别负责撰写或阅读邮件、验证发件人、在服务器之间传输邮件，以及为收件人存储邮件。这种架构形成于组织通常只能维护一台昂贵服务器、网络连接缓慢且不稳定的年代。

items.title_en: 11 Nanoseconds per Word: Over-Optimizing Anagrams
items.title_zh: 每个单词 11 纳秒：过度优化字谜
items.summary_en: The author built a solver for a Word Ladder variant that allows letter changes, additions, deletions, and anagrams. After the solver took more than a second to run, the author optimized it using a collision-free prime-product identifier for dictionary words packed into a 64-bit integer. The technique is intended for indexing all anagrams in a dictionary rather than just looking up one word’s anagrams.
items.summary_zh: 作者为一种 Word Ladder 变体编写了求解器，允许改变、添加、删除字母以及重新排列字母。求解器运行时间超过一秒后，作者使用一种无碰撞的质数乘积标识符进行优化，将词典单词编码进一个 64 位整数。该技术针对的是为词典中的所有变位词建立索引，而不只是查询某个单词的变位词。

items.title_en: Half of Show HN posts are a bare link. Ones with 500 characters got 2x replies
items.title_zh: 一半 Show HN 帖子只是裸链接；有 500 字符的帖子回复量翻倍
items.summary_en: An analysis of 37,622 Show HN posts published from January through September 2026 found that longer post text, combined with a number or “I built” in the title, was associated with reaching 10 or more comments 2.6 times as often. The study counted replies from other users and compared posts that received comments with those that did not. It reports that roughly half of Show HN posts were bare links.
items.summary_zh: 一项对 2026 年 1 月至 9 月发布的 37,622 条 Show HN 帖子的分析发现，正文更长、标题中包含数字或“I built”的帖子，达到 10 条以上评论的概率是其他帖子的 2.6 倍。研究统计了其他用户的回复，并比较了获得评论与未获得评论的帖子。分析称，约一半的 Show HN 帖子只是裸链接。

items.title_en: Show HN: TubeHaus – an open-source YouTube client with no Google account
items.title_zh: Show HN：TubeHaus——无需 Google 账户的开源 YouTube 客户端
items.summary_en: TubeHaus is a private, self-hosted YouTube client available as a Docker Compose web app and native apps for Android, Windows, macOS, Linux, and iPhone/iPad. It requires no Google account and provides no tracking. The client preserves subscriptions and history on the user's own server or device while retaining a YouTube-like layout and keyboard shortcuts.
items.summary_zh: TubeHaus 是一款私密、自托管的 YouTube 客户端，提供 Docker Compose 网页版，以及 Android、Windows、macOS、Linux 和 iPhone/iPad 原生应用。它无需 Google 账户，也不进行跟踪。用户可以将订阅和历史记录保存在自己的服务器或设备上，同时保留类似 YouTube 的布局和键盘快捷键。

items.title_en: Nintendo's cartridge maker shifts focus to data centers, hurting physical media
items.title_zh: 任天堂卡带制造商转向数据中心，物理媒体受影响
items.summary_en: Macronix, Nintendo’s main ROM supplier for Switch cartridges, is phasing out ROM production, according to its CEO and chairman. ROM chips accounted for only 5 percent of the Taiwanese manufacturer’s memory sales in the third quarter of 2026. The shift could affect the availability of physical game cartridges.
items.summary_zh: 据 Macronix 首席执行官兼董事长称，这家任天堂 Switch 卡带的主要 ROM 供应商正逐步退出 ROM 生产。2026 年第三季度，ROM 芯片仅占这家台湾制造商内存销售额的 5%。这一转向可能影响实体游戏卡带的供应。

items.title_en: PageScribe: Handwriting and offline dictionary audio for KOReader
items.title_zh: PageScribe：面向 KOReader 的手写与离线词典朗读
items.summary_en: PageScribe is a tool for KOReader that provides handwriting features and offline dictionary audio.
items.summary_zh: PageScribe 是一款面向 KOReader 的工具，提供手写功能和离线词典朗读。

items.title_en: WiCi: Connecting GPUs over WiFi
items.title_zh: WiCi：通过 Wi-Fi 连接 GPU
items.summary_en: WiCi is a systems research lab focused on wireless GPU computing and local AI infrastructure. It develops systems for sharing compute across devices while keeping models and data under local control. Its work targets local inference and wireless infrastructure for advanced AI.
items.summary_zh: WiCi 是一个专注于无线 GPU 计算和本地 AI 基础设施的系统研究实验室。它开发让多台设备共享计算资源、同时保持模型和数据本地可控的系统。研究方向包括先进 AI 的本地推理和无线基础设施。

items.title_en: Northstar: A New Booster Engine with More Thrust and Less Mass
items.title_zh: Northstar：推力更大、质量更轻的新型助推器发动机
items.summary_en: Northstar is a new booster engine designed to provide more thrust with less mass.
items.summary_zh: Northstar 是一款旨在以更轻质量提供更大推力的新型助推器发动机。

items.title_en: Asahi Linux Drops MIT, Goes Full GPL After AI Used to Steal Unreleased Code
items.title_zh: Asahi Linux 放弃 MIT，全面转向 GPL：因 AI 被用于窃取未发布代码
items.summary_en: Asahi Linux is moving all of its repositories to GPL v2 or later after unpublished code was allegedly copied and passed through language models to obscure its origin. The project had previously used the MIT license so that other projects, including BSD systems, could reuse its code. The change places all Asahi Linux code under strong copyleft licenses.
items.summary_zh: Asahi Linux 将所有代码仓库改为 GPL v2 或更高版本，此前有人据称复制未发布代码，并通过语言模型处理以掩盖其来源。该项目过去主要采用 MIT 许可证，允许包括 BSD 系统在内的其他项目复用代码。这一变化意味着 Asahi Linux 的全部代码将采用强著作权许可。

items.title_en: UV-5RM-Radio-Mod
items.title_zh: UV-5RM 无线电改装
items.summary_en: This custom firmware for Baofeng UV-5RM radios adds applications including texting and spectrum tools. Its texting feature supports short messages between two radios with delivery confirmation and requires no phone, internet connection, or additional hardware. CHIRP will no longer communicate with the modified device, so channels must be programmed with the included applications.
items.summary_zh: 这套 Baofeng UV-5RM 自定义固件新增了短信和频谱工具等应用。短信功能支持两台无线电之间发送短消息并确认送达，不需要手机、互联网或额外硬件。改装后设备将无法再与 CHIRP 通信，因此必须使用随附应用配置频道。

items.title_en: Hugging Face's CEO Says His P(Doom) Is 'Close to Zero'
items.title_zh: Hugging Face CEO：我的 AI 厄运概率“接近于零”
items.summary_en: Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue said future AI risks are most likely to come from a small number of companies developing systems behind closed doors. He argued that open models can help mitigate those risks by enabling the broader ecosystem to build and scrutinize systems openly. His comments were made at the WIRED World Fair in Miami.
items.summary_zh: Hugging Face 首席执行官 Clément Delangue 表示，未来的 AI 风险最可能来自少数在封闭环境中开发系统的公司。他认为，开放模型可以让更广泛的生态公开构建和审查系统，从而帮助缓解这些风险。他是在迈阿密举行的 WIRED World Fair 上发表这番看法的。

items.title_en: The architecture of open-weight LLMs: MoE, hybrid layers, ternary weights
items.title_zh: 开放权重 LLM 的架构：MoE、混合层与三值权重
items.summary_en: This study examines the architectures of twelve open-weight models ranging from 1.7 billion to 35 billion parameters that can run on an 8 GB GPU. It explains how attention variants reduce KV-cache use, mixture-of-experts reduces computation per token, recurrent layers and short convolutions replace much of attention, and quantization and ternary weights shrink model weights. A request-level walkthrough shows how VRAM and RAM are used during startup, prefill, and decoding, demonstrating why parameter count alone does not determine local performance.
items.summary_zh: 这项研究考察了 12 个可在 8 GB GPU 上运行的开放权重模型，参数量从 17 亿到 350 亿不等。研究解释了注意力变体如何减少 KV 缓存占用、混合专家如何降低每个 token 的计算量、循环层和短卷积如何替代大部分注意力，以及量化和三值权重如何缩小模型权重。它还按请求流程展示启动、预填充和解码阶段对显存与内存的使用，说明参数量本身并不能决定模型在本地硬件上的运行表现。

items.title_en: My parents chose to die together and I was left to grieve alone
items.title_zh: 我的父母选择共同赴死，而我独自留下哀悼
items.summary_en: After 50 years of marriage, Jan and Els sought medical assistance to end their lives together, leaving behind their only child. Their child, Bas, found them in their campervan at a marina in the northern Netherlands one morning in June 2024. The story concerns the consequences of their decision for the family member left behind.
items.summary_zh: 结婚 50 年后，Jan 和 Els 寻求医疗介入，希望共同结束生命，留下了他们唯一的孩子。2024 年 6 月的一个清晨，他们的孩子 Bas 在荷兰北部一处码头的露营车中发现了他们。这个故事讲述了这一决定给留下来的家人带来的影响。

items.title_en: Ant: Can unprecedented revenue growth outrun irresponsibly large investment
items.title_zh: Ant：前所未有的收入增长能否跑赢不负责任的巨额投资？
items.summary_en: It focuses on the company’s claim that scaling leads to further scaling, including access to faster computing. The central question is whether unprecedented revenue growth can outweigh the company’s very large investment requirements.
items.summary_zh: 文章通过 Anthropic 于 2026 年 10 月 26 日提交的 S-1 文件，考察其增长和投资策略。文章聚焦于公司关于扩大规模会带来进一步扩张、包括获得更快计算资源的说法。核心问题是，前所未有的收入增长能否抵消其巨额投资需求。

items.title_en: Show HN: Green tests are not proof – verifier for C/C++ and firmware fixes
items.title_zh: Show HN：绿色测试并不等于证明——用于 C/C++ 和固件修复的验证器
items.summary_en: Unfix independently verifies bug fixes in C, C++, and firmware, including fixes produced by AI coding agents. It reproduces the bug, applies the proposed fix, reruns the tests on the user's tests and real hardware, then removes the fix to check whether the bug returns. The system produces one of three verdicts: VERIFIED, REJECTED, or NOT VERIFIABLE. Unfix does not write the code itself.
items.summary_zh: Unfix 可以独立验证 C、C++ 和固件中的错误修复，包括 AI 编程代理生成的修复。它会重现错误、应用修复，在用户提供的测试和真实硬件上重新运行验证，然后移除修复，检查错误是否再次出现。系统会给出三种结论之一：VERIFIED（已验证）、REJECTED（已拒绝）或 NOT VERIFIABLE（无法验证）。Unfix 本身不会编写代码。

items.title_en: The Qlobe: Rotating Quine (2010)
items.title_zh: 再见，Qlobe：旋转 Quine（2010）
items.summary_en: Qlobe is a rotating quine from 2010. The title identifies it as a self-reproducing program or artifact presented in a rotating form, but no further technical details are available.
items.summary_zh: Qlobe 是一个创作于 2010 年的旋转 Quine。标题表明它是一种以旋转形式呈现的自复制程序或作品，但现有信息没有提供更多技术细节。

items.title_en: Ian Murdock – And we learn about Debian
items.title_zh: 伊恩·默多克——以及我们如何了解 Debian
items.summary_en: The piece concerns Ian Murdock and the history or development of Debian. No further details about its focus or conclusions are available.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章围绕伊恩·默多克以及 Debian 的历史或发展展开。现有信息没有提供文章重点或结论的更多细节。

items.title_en: Pepperwind, a fictional company dataset with 223 tables and 79M rows
items.title_zh: Pepperwind：包含 223 张表和 7900 万行的虚构公司数据集
items.summary_en: Pepperwind is a fictional spice and tea trader with a storefront, subscription club, warehouse, multi-currency ledgers, support, CRM, marketing, analytics, HR, payroll, and company mail. The dataset contains about 223 tables and 79 million rows, stored in roughly 7 GB of Parquet files. It was created to provide a realistic, interconnected test dataset with issues such as entity resolution and financial consistency.
items.summary_zh: Pepperwind 是一家虚构的香料和茶叶贸易公司，包含店面、订阅俱乐部、仓库、多币种账本、客服、CRM、营销、产品分析、人力资源、薪资和企业邮件等系统。数据集约有 223 张表和 7900 万行，存储为约 7GB 的 Parquet 文件。它旨在提供更真实、相互关联的测试数据，并包含实体解析和财务一致性等实际问题。

items.title_en: Juju: Modern Codeforge
items.title_zh: Juju：现代代码托管平台
items.summary_en: Juju is presented as a modern code forge built for speed.
items.summary_zh: Juju 是一个以速度为核心打造的现代代码托管平台。

items.title_en: UbuWeb has been 'tocked (TikTok clone for avant garde art)
items.title_zh: UbuWeb 被“tocked”了（面向先锋艺术的 TikTok 克隆版）
items.summary_en: UbuWeb has been “tocked,” referring to a TikTok-like clone focused on avant-garde art. The title identifies the project but provides no further implementation or content details.
items.summary_zh: UbuWeb 推出了一个面向先锋艺术、类似 TikTok 的克隆项目，被称为“tocked”。标题未提供更多实现方式或内容细节。

items.title_en: Lighting the Skies
items.title_zh: 照亮天空
items.summary_en: The essay examines how military technology shaped views of warfare, including the idea that a mechanical device could determine the outcome of a world conflict. It questions whether nuclear weapons changed World War II as decisively as is often assumed, noting that the technology arrived very late in the war and that the conventional firebombing of Tokyo may have caused as many deaths as the atomic attacks on Hiroshima and Nagasaki.
items.summary_zh: 文章考察了军事技术如何塑造人们对战争的看法，包括“某种机械装置能够决定世界冲突结局”的观念。文章质疑核武器是否像通常认为的那样决定性地改变了第二次世界大战，并指出相关技术在战争末期才出现，而东京的常规燃烧弹轰炸造成的死亡人数可能与广岛、长崎的原子弹袭击相当。

items.title_en: Pliny – Letters – Book 7 Letter 27 (On Ghosts)
items.title_zh: 小普林尼《书信集》第七卷第 27 封：论鬼魂
items.summary_en: In Letter 27 to Sura, Pliny asks whether ghosts truly exist or are products of frightened imagination. He recounts a story about Curtius Rufus, who allegedly encountered a supernatural woman in Africa and received a prophecy about his future offices and death. Pliny says the reported events later came to pass.
items.summary_zh: 小普林尼在致 Sura 的第 27 封信中询问鬼魂是否真实存在，还是恐惧想象的产物。他讲述了 Curtius Rufus 在非洲据称遇到一名超自然女子，并获知自己未来官职与死亡结局的故事。普林尼称，预言中的事件后来确实发生。

items.title_en: Why your Mac may not scan for malware
items.title_zh: 为什么你的 Mac 可能不会扫描恶意软件
items.summary_en: Apple's Malware Removal Tool has remained installed on Macs but has not been updated for more than four years. XProtect Remediator could be run manually until that option was stopped in September 2026. Mac malware scanning is also largely silent: users are not told when scans occur or whether detected malware was successfully removed.
items.summary_zh: 苹果的恶意软件移除工具仍安装在 Mac 上，但已经超过四年没有更新。XProtect Remediator 此前还可以由用户手动运行，但这一选项已于 2026 年 9 月停止。Mac 的恶意软件扫描也基本不会通知用户：用户不知道扫描何时进行，也不知道发现的恶意软件是否成功移除。

items.title_en: SS27 Color Stats
items.title_zh: SS27 色彩统计
items.summary_en: The title identifies a work called “SS27 Color Stats.” It provides no details about the colors, data, or analysis involved.
items.summary_zh: 标题介绍了一项名为“SS27 色彩统计”的内容。标题未说明涉及哪些颜色、数据或分析。

items.title_en: Brave Sells Its Search Index to AI, and Your Website Is Probably in It
items.title_zh: Brave 向 AI 出售其搜索索引，你的网站很可能也在其中
items.summary_en: The New York Times alleges that Brave copied more than 30 billion webpages without identifying its crawler or providing website owners with a way to block it, then sold the content to AI companies. Brave had not responded in the supplied account, so these remain allegations. Brave sells access to its search index through the Brave Search API, which is used by AI companies including Cohere, Mistral, Perplexity, and You.com.
items.summary_zh: 《纽约时报》指称，Brave 未标明爬虫身份，也未提供网站所有者阻止抓取的机制，就复制了超过 300 亿个网页，并将这些内容出售给 AI 公司。在所述时间点，Brave 尚未回应，因此这些仍属于指控。Brave 通过 Brave Search API 向 AI 公司提供搜索索引访问，使用者包括 Cohere、Mistral、Perplexity 和 You.com。

items.title_en: Bomb threats disrupt at least 25 flights across Europe, raising hybrid war fears
items.title_zh: 炸弹威胁扰乱欧洲至少 25 个航班，引发混合战争担忧
items.summary_en: Hoax bomb threats disrupted at least 34 flights across Europe this week. Some aircraft were diverted or forced to make emergency landings, and the incidents occurred two days after another wave of false alerts affected air travel. Authorities are investigating whether the apparently coordinated activity was intended to create widespread disruption.
items.summary_zh: 本周，欧洲各地至少有 34 个航班受到虚假炸弹威胁影响。部分飞机被迫改道或紧急降落，而此前两天另一轮虚假警报也曾扰乱航空出行。有关方面正在关注这起看似协调进行的行动是否意在制造大范围混乱。

items.title_en: Regulators approve generic HIV-prevention drug for low-income countries
items.title_zh: 监管机构批准面向低收入国家的通用 HIV 预防药物
items.summary_en: Regulators have approved a generic HIV-prevention drug for use in low-income countries. The approval is intended to expand access to medication that helps prevent HIV infection.
items.summary_zh: 监管机构批准了一种面向低收入国家的通用 HIV 预防药物。此举旨在扩大人们获得 HIV 预防药物的机会。

items.title_en: Show HN: SafeScript, a safe version of JavaScript for executing untrusted code
items.title_zh: Show HN：SafeScript——用于执行不可信代码的安全版 JavaScript
items.summary_en: SafeScript is a strict computational subset of JavaScript designed to execute untrusted code in multiple environments. It excludes features including eval, new, globals, and prototype access, then compiles to plain JavaScript and PHP. The compiler is about 48 KB minified, or roughly 12 KB gzipped, and uses .safe files intended to be locally verifiable.
items.summary_zh: SafeScript 是 JavaScript 的严格计算子集，旨在让不可信代码能够在多种环境中安全执行。它排除了 eval、new、全局变量和原型访问等功能，并可编译为普通 JavaScript 和 PHP。编译器压缩后约 48 KB、gzip 后约 12 KB，使用 .safe 文件格式，并支持本地验证。

items.title_en: Branching Beyond Leonardo: The Evolution of Tree Architecture Theory
items.title_zh: 超越达·芬奇：树木结构理论的演变
items.summary_en: The piece traces the development of theories about tree architecture, beginning with Leonardo da Vinci’s observations of tree growth. Leonardo’s notebooks included a rule about the combined thickness of branches relative to the trunk. The author connects his Renaissance observations with the continuing interest of scientists and artists in how trees form their canopies.
items.summary_zh: 文章从列奥纳多·达·芬奇对树木生长的观察出发，追溯树木结构理论的发展。达·芬奇在笔记中记录了一条关于树枝总厚度与树干关系的规律。作者将这些文艺复兴时期的观察与科学家和艺术家至今对树冠形成方式的兴趣联系起来。

items.title_en: The Kekulé Problem – Cormac McCarthy
items.title_zh: 《凯库勒问题》——科马克·麦卡锡
items.summary_en: The essay examines the origins of language and the relationship between human expressive ability and the older animal brain. It draws on discussions between novelist Cormac McCarthy and researchers at the Santa Fe Institute about consciousness, the unconscious mind, and the combinatorial grammar underlying human language. McCarthy’s novels are treated as places where these scientific and philosophical questions appear in indirect form.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨语言的起源，以及人类表达能力与更古老的动物大脑之间的关系。它源于小说家科马克·麦卡锡与圣菲研究所研究人员围绕意识、无意识和人类语言组合语法展开的讨论。文章将麦卡锡的小说视为这些科学与哲学问题以间接形式出现的场所。

items.title_en: Kernel.sh Hacked
items.title_zh: Kernel.sh 遭黑客攻击
items.summary_en: Kernel.sh detected a data-security incident on November 2, 2026 and issued a public notice on November 4. The company said an unauthorized party used a compromised KERNEL API key on October 24 to probe for access. Further details about the incident were not included in the supplied notice.
items.summary_zh: Kernel.sh 于 2026 年 11 月 2 日发现一起数据安全事件，并于 11 月 4 日发布公告。公司称，未经授权的一方于 10 月 24 日利用被泄露的 KERNEL API 密钥探测访问权限。公告节选未提供该事件的更多细节。

items.title_en: Stolen AI API keys generated nearly $1M in charges for a single company
items.title_zh: 被盗的 AI API 密钥为单家公司产生近 100 万美元费用
items.summary_en: Mandiant describes LLMJacking attacks in which stolen AI credentials generate fraudulent cloud bills. The attacks can cost victims hundreds of thousands of dollars, while underground markets trade compromised credentials for access to hosted language models.
items.summary_zh: Mandiant 描述了利用被盗 AI 凭证制造虚假云账单的 LLMJacking 攻击。这类攻击可能让受害者损失数十万美元，地下市场则交易被入侵的凭证，以访问托管的大语言模型。

items.title_en: Fake security tools on GitHub push backdoors and infostealers
items.title_zh: GitHub 上的假安全工具传播后门和信息窃取程序
items.summary_en: Cybersecurity professionals are being targeted by malicious GitHub projects disguised as security tools. The repositories deploy backdoors and information-stealing malware; the campaign began about two years ago after initially targeting cryptocurrency-wallet users. Researchers have found that more than 2,000 Windows systems have been compromised.
items.summary_zh: 网络安全专业人士正成为伪装成安全工具的恶意 GitHub 项目的攻击目标。这些仓库会部署后门和信息窃取恶意软件；该活动约两年前开始，最初针对加密货币钱包用户。研究人员发现，已有超过 2,000 台 Windows 系统遭到入侵。

items.title_en: Show HN: AegisKernel – Zero-trust POSIX runtime for AI agents in <0.016ms
items.title_zh: Show HN：AegisKernel——在不到 0.016 毫秒内运行的零信任 POSIX AI agent 环境
items.summary_en: AegisKernel presents a zero-trust POSIX runtime for AI agents. It argues that deterministic capability boundaries can block autonomous tool hijacking in sub-millisecond time, unlike probabilistic LLM guardrails.
items.summary_zh: AegisKernel 提供面向 AI 智能体的零信任 POSIX 运行时。项目认为，与概率式大语言模型防护相比，确定性的能力边界可以在亚毫秒级时间内阻止自主工具劫持。

items.title_en: Why Isn't Retatrutide Approved Yet?
items.title_zh: Retatrutide 为何尚未获批？
items.summary_en: The topic is why retatrutide has not yet received regulatory approval.
items.summary_zh: 主题是 retatrutide 为何尚未获得监管批准。

items.title_en: Microsoft Removes PC-to-PC Migration from Windows 11, Pushes Users to OneDrive
items.title_zh: 微软从 Windows 11 中移除电脑到电脑迁移功能，推动用户使用 OneDrive
items.summary_en: Windows 11 no longer offers direct PC-to-PC file transfers, and Microsoft now directs users to Windows Backup. An updated Microsoft support page says the PC-to-PC Migration feature is no longer available. The removal began with the September optional update KB5124010 and reached regular users in the October 13, 2026 Patch Tuesday update, KB5127648.
items.summary_zh: Windows 11 不再提供电脑之间的直接文件传输，微软现在引导用户使用 Windows Backup。微软更新后的支持页面表示，PC-to-PC Migration 功能已不再可用。该功能从 9 月的可选更新 KB5124010 开始被移除，并在 2026 年 10 月 13 日的补丁星期二更新 KB5127648 中面向普通用户下线。

items.title_en: Datastructures-JS – The JavaScript data structures project
items.title_zh: Datastructures-JS：JavaScript 数据结构项目
items.summary_en: Datastructures-JS is a JavaScript data-structures project with TypeScript support. The project also provides an associated planning board.
items.summary_zh: Datastructures-JS 是一个支持 TypeScript 的 JavaScript 数据结构项目。项目还提供了配套的规划看板。

items.title_en: The planet Vulcan: a cautionary tale
items.title_zh: 行星 Vulcan：一个警示故事
items.summary_en: Vulcan was a proposed planet inside Mercury’s orbit that astronomers first reportedly observed in 1859 and continued to report for roughly four decades. Its properties were described in detail, although scientists are now convinced that the planet does not exist and the observations remain unexplained. The episode illustrates how confident scientific conclusions can later be overturned through falsification.
items.summary_zh: Vulcan 是一颗被认为位于水星轨道以内的假想行星，据称于 1859 年首次被观测到，此后约四十年间不断出现相关报告。天文学家甚至详细描述了它的性质，但如今科学界确信这颗行星并不存在，而当时究竟观测到了什么仍是未解之谜。这个案例说明，充满信心的科学结论也可能通过证伪最终被推翻。

items.title_en: Bruno: The Git-native API client
items.title_zh: Bruno：原生支持 Git 的 API 客户端
items.summary_en: Bruno is a local, open-source API client for REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and WebSocket services. It stores collections as code and integrates with Git, IDEs, and coding agents without cloud synchronization. The project positions itself as a developer-focused alternative to Postman.
items.summary_zh: Bruno 是一款面向 REST、GraphQL、gRPC 和 WebSocket 服务的本地开源 API 客户端。它将集合以代码形式存储，可与 Git、IDE 和 coding agent 集成，并且不进行云端同步。该项目将自己定位为面向开发者的 Postman 替代方案。

items.title_en: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI's systems – OpenAI
items.title_zh: 与 Hacktron 合作发现 OpenAI 系统中的漏洞
items.summary_en: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test integrations with third-party services, and strengthen its defenses. OpenAI engineers and Hacktron researchers will jointly select high-priority areas, with Hacktron receiving expanded access to frontier models through Daybreak Red. The company also said it had begun a security sprint with Cathedral researchers and increased bug-bounty rewards.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 正与 Hacktron 合作发现漏洞、测试与第三方服务的连接，并加强防御。OpenAI 工程师与 Hacktron 研究人员将共同选择高优先级测试领域，Hacktron 还将通过 Daybreak Red 获得对前沿模型的扩大访问权限。OpenAI 同时表示，已启动与 Cathedral 研究人员共同参与的安全冲刺，并提高了漏洞悬赏金额。

items.title_en: GPU-Accelerated Weight Teleportation
items.title_zh: GPU 加速的权重传输
items.summary_en: The project introduces lossless GPU compression and streamed decompression for synchronizing reinforcement-learning weights. In large-scale RL, trainers must send weight updates to samplers, creating a bottleneck involving high-speed networking and potentially terabytes of data. The proposed pipeline is designed for Nvidia Blackwell GPUs and aims to provide faster-than-intra-cluster synchronization in many cases, whether trainers and samplers share a cluster or not.
items.summary_zh: 该项目提出使用无损 GPU 压缩和流式解压来同步强化学习模型权重。在大规模强化学习中，训练器必须向采样器发送权重更新，这会带来高速网络需求和可能达到数 TB 的数据传输瓶颈。该方案针对 Nvidia Blackwell GPU 设计，目标是在许多情况下实现快于集群内部传输的同步速度，无论训练器和采样器是否位于同一集群。

items.title_en: How tall can you build with 54 Jenga blocks?
items.title_zh: 用 54 块 Jenga 积木最高能搭多高？
items.summary_en: The project investigates how tall a tower can be built from 54 Jenga blocks. It focuses on why the tower’s skinniest section determines when it falls. The author began exploring the problem while building towers with their daughter.
items.summary_zh: 该项目研究用 54 块 Jenga 积木最多能搭出多高的塔。重点在于探讨为什么塔身最细的部分会决定倒塌时机。作者是在和女儿搭积木时开始研究这个问题的。

items.title_en: Did the World Just Gain Hundreds of Millions of Alzheimer's Patients?
items.title_zh: 世界是否突然多出数亿名阿尔茨海默病患者？
items.summary_en: A proposed new definition of Alzheimer's disease would include people who have no symptoms. The approach has sharply divided researchers and clinicians, particularly over whether it is appropriate and whether newer drugs meaningfully help people identified this way. The debate could substantially change how the disease is counted and diagnosed.
items.summary_zh: 一种拟议中的阿尔茨海默病新定义将把没有症状的人也纳入其中。研究人员和临床医生对此存在激烈分歧，争议尤其集中在这种定义是否合理，以及新药是否能真正帮助按此标准识别的人群。这场争论可能显著改变该疾病的统计和诊断方式。

items.title_en: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
items.title_zh: 面向更强大、更有益 AI 的更新版模型规范
items.summary_en: OpenAI has updated its public Model Spec around five core values: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care. The revision adds guidance on context, oversight, and agency, while adjusting behavioral defaults and retiring much of the detailed style guidance. The goal is to guide models toward sound judgment while preserving human intent and oversight.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 更新了公开的 Model Spec，将其围绕五项核心价值重新组织：忠实于人类意图、减少伤害、诚实与透明、人类能动性，以及关怀。修订版增加了关于上下文、监督和能动性的指导，调整了一些行为默认设置，并删去了大量详细的风格指导。其目标是在保留人类意图和监督的同时，引导模型作出合理判断。

items.title_en: Smiling can make you happier – unless someone forces you to do it
items.title_zh: 微笑能让你更快乐——除非有人强迫你这么做
items.summary_en: A single smile can briefly increase happiness, but repeatedly forcing smiles can have the opposite effect. Nicholas Coles, who had contributed to research supporting the idea that forced smiling improves mood, began to question his earlier findings. The new framing distinguishes short-term effects from the consequences of repeatedly performing a smile under pressure.
items.summary_zh: 一次微笑可能会短暂提升幸福感，但反复强迫自己微笑可能产生相反效果。Nicholas Coles 曾参与支持“强颜欢笑能改善情绪”这一观点的研究，后来开始质疑自己此前的发现。新的讨论区分了短期效果与在压力下反复做出微笑表情的后果。

items.title_en: Implementing GPT-2 in CSS
items.title_zh: 用 CSS 实现 GPT-2
items.summary_en: The project runs a small GPT-2 model inside a webpage using only CSS and no JavaScript. It relies on CSS techniques and a large collection of variable font files. The author presents it as an experiment in unconventional web implementation.
items.summary_zh: 该项目仅使用 CSS、完全不依赖 JavaScript，就在网页中运行了一个小型 GPT-2 模型。实现依赖 CSS 技巧和大量可变字体文件。作者将其描述为一次非传统网页实现实验。

items.title_en: Ur-Nammu Founder of the Sumerian Renaissance
items.title_zh: 乌尔纳姆：苏美尔复兴的奠基者
items.summary_en: Ur-Nammu ruled Sumer from approximately 2112 to 2094 BCE and founded the Third Dynasty of Ur, initiating the Ur III period known as the Sumerian Renaissance. He is credited with the oldest extant law code, the Code of Ur-Nammu, and with commissioning the Great Ziggurat of Ur. An earlier law code is known only through fragmentary references, leaving Ur-Nammu’s code as the oldest surviving one.
items.summary_zh: 乌尔纳姆约于公元前 2112 年至前 2094 年统治苏美尔，建立了乌尔第三王朝，并开启了被称为“苏美尔文艺复兴”的乌尔第三时期。他被认为制定了现存最古老的成文法典《乌尔纳姆法典》，并主持建造了乌尔大金字塔。更早的乌鲁卡基那法典仅以残片形式为人所知，因此乌尔纳姆法典被视为现存最古老的法典。

items.title_en: Project Sync: The journey to sample-perfect audio/video sync with WebCodecs
items.title_zh: Project Sync：借助 WebCodecs 实现采样级完美音视频同步
items.summary_en: The project investigates why audio-video synchronization can fail and how an oversight in WebCodecs’ design leaves synchronization disabled by default. Mediabunny achieved sample-perfect synchronization despite the issue. The work emphasizes that even small mistakes anywhere in a media pipeline can break otherwise delicate AV sync.
items.summary_zh: 该项目研究了音视频同步为何会失效，以及 WebCodecs 设计中的一个疏漏为何导致同步功能默认关闭。尽管存在这一问题，Mediabunny 仍实现了采样级的精确同步。项目指出，媒体处理链路中的任何细小错误，都可能破坏本就十分脆弱的音视频同步。

items.title_en: Budget offers $50B jolt to help Canada double its electricity grid
items.title_zh: 预算案提供 500 亿美元资金，助加拿大将电网规模翻倍
items.summary_en: Canada's budget offers a $50 billion boost intended to help double the country's electricity grid. The funding is aimed at expanding national electricity infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 加拿大预算案提供 500 亿美元资金，旨在帮助该国将电网规模扩大一倍。这笔资金将用于扩建全国电力基础设施。

items.title_en: Bluefin Server
items.title_zh: Bluefin Server
items.summary_en: Bluefin Server is a home-lab platform built around image-based, automatically updated systems. It provides a single management suite for nodes, services, and containers running at home, with the goal of requiring no routine maintenance.
items.summary_zh: Bluefin Server 是面向家庭实验室的服务器平台，采用基于镜像并自动更新的系统。它提供统一的管理套件，用于管理家中的节点、服务和容器，目标是实现免维护运行。

items.title_en: International Reply Coupons are ending
items.title_zh: 国际回信券即将终止
items.summary_en: International Reply Coupons will end on December 31, 2026, after nearly 120 years of helping people pay for replies from abroad. Japan Post stopped selling them on September 30, 2026, and worldwide exchanges will end at the close of 2026. People and businesses that rely on the system will need another way to cover the cost of international replies.
items.summary_zh: 国际回信券将在 2026 年 12 月 31 日终止，此前它已帮助人们支付海外回信费用近 120 年。日本邮政已于 2026 年 9 月 30 日停止销售，全球兑换也将在 2026 年底结束。依赖这一系统的个人和企业需要寻找其他方式来承担国际回信费用。

items.title_en: The MoE Training Handbook
items.title_zh: MoE 训练手册
items.summary_en: This hands-on guide explains how to train Mixture-of-Experts models. It provides a navigable table of contents and covers the practical steps involved in building and training MoE systems.
items.summary_zh: 这份实践指南介绍了如何训练混合专家模型。页面提供可点击的目录，并涵盖构建和训练 MoE 系统所需的实际步骤。

items.title_en: Show HN: My compact, bio inspired distributed edge detection algorithm
items.title_zh: Show HN：我的紧凑型仿生分布式边缘检测算法
items.summary_en: The project is a bio-inspired edge-detection algorithm modeled on the visual cortex. Its current benchmark results fall between traditional methods such as Canny and Sobel and modern deep neural networks, while retaining the interpretability of the former. The author plans to improve video frame rates and performance across different hardware, and is seeking collaborators.
items.summary_zh: 该项目是一种受视觉皮层启发的仿生边缘检测算法。目前的基准测试结果介于 Canny、Sobel 等传统方法与现代深度神经网络之间，同时保留了传统方法的可解释性。作者计划提升视频处理帧率和不同硬件上的性能，并寻找合作伙伴。

items.title_en: The SBND collaboration releases first neutrino results
items.title_zh: SBND 合作组发布首批中微子结果
items.summary_en: The Short-Baseline Near Detector collaboration has published its first results after years of preparation. The new result improves modeling of neutrino interactions and demonstrates the capabilities of the liquid-argon detector at Fermilab. The findings are intended to support the future Deep Underground Neutrino Experiment and were published on arXiv while being submitted to Physical Review Letters.
items.summary_zh: 经过多年准备，短基线近探测器合作组发布了首批结果。新结果改进了中微子相互作用模型，并展示了费米实验室液氩探测器的能力。这些发现将为未来的深地下中微子实验提供支持；论文已发表于 arXiv，并提交给《Physical Review Letters》审阅。

items.title_en: Everyone sits in the same traffic now
items.title_zh: 如今所有人都堵在同一条网络车流里
items.summary_en: The essay presents the internet as a global village made up of countless neighborhoods and places to explore. It reflects on how the internet’s topology has changed toward a more uniform, traffic-filled environment, a process the author calls “Robert Mosesification.”
items.summary_zh: 文章将互联网描述为由无数街区和可探索之地组成的全球村庄。作者反思了互联网拓扑如何变得更加同质化、拥挤，并将这一过程称为“罗伯特·摩西化”。

items.title_en: Show HN: Better Together – AI agents team up against spam calls and texts
items.title_zh: Show HN：Better Together——AI 智能体联手对抗垃圾电话和短信
items.summary_en: Better Together lets personal AI agents collaborate on problems that are difficult to solve individually. Its first target is detecting and handling spam calls and text messages.
items.summary_zh: Better Together 让个人 AI 智能体协作解决单个智能体难以处理的问题。项目的首个目标是应对垃圾电话和短信。

items.title_en: Implicit futures for C – the first access to a buffer is the await
items.title_zh: C 的隐式 future：首次访问缓冲区就是 await
items.summary_en: Async-a-sync is a compiler and runtime system built on Fil-C that lets ordinary blocking-looking C code run asynchronously underneath. It introduces implicit asynchronous futures without adding syntax, with the first access to a buffer acting as the await point.
items.summary_zh: Async-a-sync 是构建在 Fil-C 之上的编译器和运行时系统，让表面上阻塞的普通 C 代码在底层异步运行。它无需新增语法即可引入隐式异步 future，并将首次访问缓冲区作为 await 点。

items.title_en: ING Said to Be Seller of $500M Data Center Loan Portfolio
items.title_zh: 据称 ING 将出售 5 亿美元数据中心贷款组合
items.summary_en: ING is reportedly the seller of a $500 million portfolio of data-center loans. The loans are associated with financing for data-center projects.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，ING 将出售一组总额 5 亿美元的数据中心贷款。相关贷款用于数据中心项目融资。

items.title_en: Multi-Token Prediction Done Right
items.title_zh: 正确实现多 Token 预测
items.summary_en: The paper identifies a problem in standard multi-token prediction training: a noisy residual in the gradient increasingly interferes with next-token and multi-token learning as models scale. It decomposes the gradient into a useful KL self-distillation term and a low-signal residual. The authors introduce KL gradient recovery and use it in Soft Multi-Token Prediction, which requires no vocabulary-sized logit matrices and can work with standard fused cross-entropy kernels. The method is presented as a one-line code change to MTP.
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文指出，标准多 Token 预测训练中的一个梯度噪声问题，会随着模型规模扩大而越来越干扰下一个 Token 和多 Token 学习。研究人员将该梯度分解为有用的 KL 自蒸馏项和低信号残差项。论文提出了 KL 梯度恢复方法，并将其用于 Soft Multi-Token Prediction；该方法无需构造与词表等大的 logit 矩阵，也能兼容标准融合交叉熵内核。作者称，Soft-MTP 只需对 MTP 做一行代码修改。

items.title_en: Show HN: Flide: Make Jev-like decision models up to 9.5x faster
items.title_zh: Show HN：Flide，让 Jev 类决策模型最高提速 9.5 倍
items.summary_en: Flide is an inference engine designed specifically for Jev-like decision models. The project claims up to a 9.5x speedup over vLLM and SGLang and currently supports more than 30 popular local Jev-like models. It can be installed with pip using the package name flide.
items.summary_zh: Flide 是一款专为 Jev 类决策模型设计的推理引擎。项目称其速度最高可达 vLLM 和 SGLang 的 9.5 倍，目前支持 30 多种热门本地 Jev 类模型。用户可以通过 pip 安装名为 flide 的软件包。

items.title_en: Cryptocurrencies slide to two-month lows after US midterms
items.title_zh: 美国中期选举后，加密货币跌至两个月低点
items.summary_en: Cryptocurrency prices fell to their lowest levels in two months after the U.S. midterm elections. The available information does not specify which cryptocurrencies were affected or explain the precise reasons for the decline.
items.summary_zh: 美国中期选举后，加密货币价格跌至两个月来的低点。现有信息没有说明具体受影响的加密货币，也没有解释下跌的确切原因。

items.title_en: Show HN: Jot – Select text anywhere on macOS, tap Shift twice, get Markdown
items.title_zh: Show HN：Jot——在 macOS 任意位置选中文本，连按两次 Shift 即可获得 Markdown
items.summary_en: Jot is a local-first notes inbox for Mac. Pressing a keystroke captures content as a plain Markdown file in a folder owned by the user. It is sold with one-time pricing tiers for one, three, or ten Macs, and offers a seven-day refund period.
items.summary_zh: Jot 是一款以本地存储为优先的 Mac 笔记收件箱。用户按下快捷键即可捕获内容，并将其保存为自己目录中的纯 Markdown 文件。软件按一次性费用提供单台、三台或十台 Mac 的套餐，并支持七天退款。

items.title_en: Are big problems more difficult to solve?
items.title_zh: 大问题更难解决吗？
items.summary_en: The essay argues that large, complex problems usually become harder because of their complexity and interconnected parts, not simply because of their size. It says some major problems become effectively unsolvable because of the bureaucratic structures built around them. The author presents decentralization and place-based work as a bet on making problems small enough to address.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，大型复杂问题通常是因为复杂性和相互关联的部分而更难解决，而不只是因为规模更大。有些重大问题之所以实际上难以解决，是因为围绕它们建立的官僚结构。作者将去中心化和基于地方的工作方式视为一种尝试，即把问题缩小到可处理的范围。

items.title_en: Show HN: HackerRepos – HackerTube for repos mentioned on HN
items.title_zh: Show HN：HackerRepos——收集 HN 提及仓库的 HackerTube
items.summary_en: HackerRepos indexes repositories mentioned on Hacker News and currently contains 57,316 repositories and 667,508 mentions. It includes all-time, most-recommended, trends, and trending-now sections, with the latter showing a color-coded sentiment map. Selecting a repository provides a summary of the discussion and labels it as favorable, critical, debated, or informational.
items.summary_zh: HackerRepos 用于索引 Hacker News 提到的代码仓库，目前收录 57,316 个仓库和 667,508 次提及。它提供历史热门、最常推荐、趋势和“当前趋势”等栏目，其中“当前趋势”通过颜色编码的地图展示讨论情绪。点击仓库后，还能查看讨论摘要，并看到“支持、批评、争议或信息性”等标签。

items.title_en: Show HN: Maple – Sub-2-BPW Moe Pruning to Run Gemma 4 26B at 45 TPS on a 6GB GPU
items.title_zh: Show HN：Maple——次于 2 BPW 的 MoE 剪枝，让 Gemma 4 26B 在 6GB GPU 上达到 45 TPS
items.summary_en: Maple is a structural-compression method for mixture-of-experts language models. It compresses Gemma 4 26B-A4B from 9.92 GB to 4.75 GB, equivalent to 1.48 effective bits per parameter. The project reports 100% in-VRAM execution on 6 GB laptop GPUs at 45.4 tokens per second.
items.summary_zh: Maple 是一种面向混合专家语言模型的结构化压缩方法。它将 Gemma 4 26B-A4B 从 9.92 GB 压缩到 4.75 GB，相当于每参数 1.48 个有效比特。项目报告称，该模型可在 6GB 笔记本 GPU 上完全载入显存运行，速度达到每秒 45.4 个 token。

items.title_en: The Unwilding of Patagonia's Pollinators
items.title_zh: 巴塔哥尼亚传粉者的“去野化”
items.summary_en: In Patagonia, native bumblebees are being replaced by industrial honeybees. The change is affecting the region's ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: 在巴塔哥尼亚，原生熊蜂正被工业化饲养的蜜蜂取代。这一变化正在影响当地生态系统。

items.title_en: Udpstp and the packets that never left
items.title_zh: Udpstp 与那些从未离开的数据包
items.summary_en: Udpstp measures network capacity, packet loss, and delay under load, using a Rust sender and receiver at both ends of a network path. It supports authenticated tests in either direction, terminal tables, and JSON output for comparing paths and configurations. The article explains how partial operating-system sends and late timers affect the sender's measurements.
items.summary_zh: Udpstp 用于在负载下测量网络容量、丢包率和延迟，需要在网络路径两端运行 Rust 编写的发送端和接收端。它支持双向身份验证测试、终端表格输出以及 JSON 输出，便于比较路径和配置。文章解释了操作系统只接受部分发送计划，以及计时器延迟唤醒如何影响发送端的测量结果。

items.title_en: The Scarlet Letter for the Honest: A Short Pamphlet on the New Witch Hunt
items.title_zh: 给诚实者的“红字”：关于新一轮猎巫的短册
items.summary_en: The pamphlet criticizes statistical watermarks embedded in text to identify AI-generated writing. It argues that paraphrasing or translation can remove the mark from human-written text, while generated text can be made to appear unmarked after passing through paraphrasers. The result, it says, is an unreliable distinction between human and machine-produced writing.
items.summary_zh: 这篇短册批评了通过嵌入文本的统计水印来识别 AI 生成内容的做法。它指出，人类写作经过改写或翻译就可能去除标记，而生成文本经过多个改写器处理后也能看起来没有标记。作者认为，这会导致人类写作与机器生成写作之间形成不可靠的区分。

items.title_en: Sailing Solo Around Britain
items.title_zh: 独自环航英国
items.summary_en: The sailor prepared the more-than-40-year-old fiberglass Leisure 27 Dark Star for a solo voyage around Britain. After owning the boat for more than 29 years, they replaced its engine, saildrive, fuel tank, rudder, mast, rigging, and sails. They considered the boat fundamentally well prepared for the journey.
items.summary_zh: 船主准备驾驶一艘船龄超过 40 年的玻璃钢 Leisure 27 双龙骨帆船 Dark Star，独自环航英国。船主拥有这艘船 29 年以上，近年来更换了发动机、帆船传动装置、油箱、舵、桅杆、索具和帆。船主认为，Dark Star 的基本状况已经足以应对这次航行。

items.title_en: Here Be Monsters
items.title_zh: 这里有怪物
items.summary_en: The author examines why monsters appeared so frequently in politics, entertainment, and everyday life during 2025. This led to research into monster studies and a conversation with Michael Chemers, director of the Center for Monster Studies at UC Santa Cruz. Chemers described monster theory as a way to examine contemporary problems, including environmental collapse.
items.summary_zh: 作者探讨了为什么“怪物”在 2025 年频繁出现在政治、娱乐和日常生活中。由此，作者开始研究怪物研究领域，并采访了加州大学圣克鲁兹分校怪物研究中心主任迈克尔·切默斯。切默斯认为，怪物理论可以用来审视包括环境崩溃在内的当代问题。
